**We offer respects to you, who shoot sharp arrows of impassioned Cupid from your moving brows, who restrict the wicked, who have lotus eyes, who liberated Agha,who are offered respects by the devatas, who are worthy of worship by all beings, who possess a splendor fragrance, who are absorbed in the golden gopis, who have soft bud-like feet, whose playful gait, most rare is desired by Airavata.**

**Комментарий:**

You shoot sharp (sanita) arrows (sayakd) of impassioned Cupid (.rati-naydka) from your moving brows. You offer arrows of love to the young girls by the bows of your brows. You restrict the wicked natured (uddhata). You destroy their prowess. You are offered respects by the devatas (amarali) since you are worthy of worship (gauravam) by all beings. This means you are the supreme Lord. Your mind is most attracted to the golden gopis (pasuplsd). Your playful gait is rarely attained, though desired by Airavata, Indra’s elephant (abhramu-vallabhasya). Airavata cannot attain this gait even in his mind. How can he attain it by his feet? The rest is clear.

### Text 4

*bhuja-mūrdhni viśaṅkaṭam adhigata-śaṅkaṭa-nata-kaṅkaṭam aṭavīṣu calaṁ navanīpa-karambita-vana-rolambitam avalambita-kala-kaṇṭha-kalam \|*  
*durjana-tṛṇa-pāvakam anucara-śāvaka-nikarāvakam aruṇoṣṭha-dalaṁ*  
*nija-vikrama-carcita-bhuja-guru-garvita-gandharvita-danujārdi-balam \|\|4\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**We offer respects to you, who have broad shoulders, who act as shield for the devotees you know are in fear, who wander in the forests, who are bee in the kadamba forest, who have the voice of a cuckoo, who are a fire for burning the grasslike demons, who protect all the cowherd boys accompanying you, who have red petal-like lips, who show prowess to afflict the extremely proud, ferocious demons by your arms anointed with valor.**

**Комментарий:**

You have broad (visankatam) shoulders (bhuja-murdhni) which are a shield (kankatam) for the surrendered (nata) have been understood (adhigata) to be fearful (sarikata). You are their hero. You wander about in the forests (atavisu). You are a bee (rolambitam) in the forest filled with fresh kadambas (nlpa). You smell their fragrance. You have a sweet voice (kdlam) like that of the cuckoo (kalakantha). You sound like the cuckoo. You are a fire for the grass-like demons. You burn them like grass. You protect the cowherd boys (savaka) who play with you (anucara). You protect them from the forest fire. You have the prowess to afflict the extremely (guru) proud demons by your arms smeared with valor.

Gandhara is an aggressive animal like the sarabha according to Medini. A person who acts in this way is gandharvita.

### Text 5

*śruti-ratna-vibhūṣaṇa-ruci-jita-pūṣaṇam alidūṣaṇa-nayanānta-gatiṁ*  
*yamunā-taṭa-talpita-puṣpam analpita-mada-jalpita-dayitāpta-ratim \|*  
*vandemahi vandita-nandam amandita-kulam andhita-khala-kaṁsa-matiṁ*  
*tvām iha dāmodara haladhara-sodara hara no daram anubaddha-ratim \|\|5\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**О Damodara! We offer respects to you, who are attracted to your devotees, who conquer the sun by the beauty of your jeweled ear ornaments, who defeat the bee by the movement of your eye, who make flower beds on the bank of the Yamuna, who take delight in the most proud words of your lover, who praise Nanda, who elevate your family, who restrict the influence of Kamsa’s mind. О brother of Balarama! Destroy our fear of samsara.**

**Комментарий:**

You conquer the sun (piisa) by the beauty of your jeweled ear ornaments. The movements of the edge of your eyes defeat the bee. You insult the bees by your shining blackness of your side glances. You make flower beds on the bank of the Yamuna in a bower. You derive pleasure from your lover who speaks most (analpita) proudly (mada). You have devotion to your father: Krsna praises and offers respects (vandita) to Nanda. You elevate (amandita) your family. You curtailed influence of the mind of wicked Kamsa. О Damodara! О brother of Balarama! We should offer respects (vandemahi) to you. Destroy (hara) our fear of samsara (daram). You are described. You are attracted to your devotees (anubaddha-ratim).

The matras of tribhangl are described.

*dvātriṁśatkalikā yasyāṁ pratipādaṁ prakīrtitāḥ \|*  
*sā syāktribhaṅgī vicchinnā \[…\] daśāṣṭakaiḥ \|\|*

**Tribhangl has thirty-two matras in each line with caesura at tenth, the eighth following, the sixth following and eighth matra following that. (Chandah kaustubha)**

Thus, the tribhangl chandah stavaka has been explained.

## Unknown players

### Text 1

*viracaya mayi daṇḍaṁ dīna-bandho dayāṁ vā*  
*gatir iha na bhavattaḥ kācid anyā mamāsti \|*  
*nipatatu śatakoṭir nirmalaṁ vā navāmbhas*  
*tad api kila payodaḥ stūyate cātakena \|\|1\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**О friend of the miserable! Show mercy or punish me. I have no other shelter than you. May a million thunderbolts or fresh rain fall from the cloud. Still the cloud is praised by the cataka bird.**

**Комментарий:**

Though unqualified for surrendering himself completely to Krsna, he states his desire by relating qualities of Krsna. О friend of the miserable! Show mercy or punish me. I have no other shelter (gatih) than you. May a million thunderbolts or fresh rain fall from the cloud. But still the cloud is praised by the cataka in separation. The cataka is a type of bird according to Haima. The alankara is arthantara-nyasa. Just as the cataka cannot relieve its thirst by rivers, etc., without the cloud, I cannot get relief from samsara without you, by Brahma, Siva, etc.

*tameva viditvātimṛtyumeti nānyaḥ panthā vidyate ayanāya*

**Knowing the supreme person, most effulgent, beyond darkness, one surpasses samsara. There is no other path for attaining liberation. (Svetasvatara Upanisad 3.8)**

*varaṁ vṛṇīṣva bhadraṁ te ṛte kaivalyamadyamaḥ \|*  
*eka eveśvarastasya bhagavān viṣṇuravyayaḥ \|\|*

**All good fortune to you! Now please choose a benediction from us—anything but liberation, since only the infallible Supreme Lord, Visnu, can bestow that. (SB 10.51.20)**

Because it is a cause of increase of bhakti, liberation in the form of destruction of suffering is desired.

The meter is mdlini (na na ma ya), described previously.

### Text 2

*prācīnānāṁ bhajanam atulaṁ duṣkaraṁ śṛṇvato me*  
*nairāśyena jvalati hṛdayaṁ bhakti-leśālasasya \|*  
*viṣvadrīcīm aghahara tavākarṇya kāruṇya-vīcīm*  
*āśā-bindūkṣitam idam upaity antare hanta śaityam \|\|2\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**When I hear of the difficult worship of ancient devotees, my heart bums in hopelessness. I am lazy even for a particle of bhakti. O destroyer of Agha! Hearing of your wave of mercy that reaches from Brahma to the lowest creature, I have achieved peace within, which is sprinkled with a drop of hope.**

**Комментарий:**

When I hear of the difficult worship of ancient devotees like Suka and Ambarisa, my heart burns in hopelessness. The person is described. I am lazy even for a particle of bhakti. But O destroyer of Agha! Having heard from scriptures of your wave of mercy, I become soothed in my heart. Hanta expresses joy. The wave of mercy is described. The mercy extends from Brahma to the lowest creature (visvadrlcim). The soothing coolness is described. It is sprinkled with a drop of hope. Bindu means a drop according to Medini. This is lalasamayi vijnapti.

The meter is mandakranta.

*mandākrāntāmbudhirasahayairmo bhanau tau gayugmam*

**Mandakranta is 111 Iss sss Ils Ils 11 (ma, bha, na, ta, ta, gu, gu) with caesura after fourth syllable, six syllables following and seven syllables following that.**

## mukunda-muktāvalī

*śrīvrajanāgarāya namaḥ \|*

**Перевод:**

**I offer respects to the clever boy of Vraja.**

### Text 1

*nava-jaladhara-varṇaṁ campakodbhāsi-karṇaṁ*  
*vikasita-nalināsyaṁ visphuran-manda-hāsyam \|*  
*kanaka-ruci-dukūlaṁ cāru-barhāva-cūlaṁ*  
*kam api nikhila-sāraṁ naumi gopī-kumāram \|\|1\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**I offer respects to the clever boy of Vraja, the essence of everything, the extraordinary son of Yasoda, endowed with the complexion of a fresh cloud, whose ears shine with campaka flowers, whose face is a blossoming lotus, whose cloth is the color of gold, who reveals a soft smile, who wears a peacock feather crown.**

**Комментарий:**

The author praises Mukunda by these verses called in various meters. 1 praise (naumi) the extraordinary (kam) son of Yasoda (gopi-kumdram) with campaka flowers on his ears. His face is like a blossoming lotus. He protects (avd) or wears a crown with an attractive peacock feather: he wears a crown made of peacock feathers. The rest is clear.

### Text 2

*mukha-jita-śarad-induḥ kel-lāvaṇya-sindhuḥ*  
*kara-vinihita-kandur ballavī-prāṇa-bandhuḥ \|*  
*vapur upasṛta-reṇuḥ kakṣa-niḥkṣipta -veṇur*  
*vacana-vaśaga-dhenuḥ pātu māṁ nanda-sūnuḥ \|\|2\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**May the son of Nanda, whose face conquers the autumn moon, who is a beautiful ocean of pastimes, who holds a ball in his hand, who is the life-giving friend of the gopis, whose body is covered with dust, who carries a flute under his arm, who controls the cows by his voice, protect me.**

**Комментарий:**

He holds a ball in his hand. Cow dust is held on his body (upasrta-renuh). The rest is clear. Meter is malinl, which was previously described.

### Text 3

*dhvasta-duṣṭa-śaṅkha-cūḍa ballavī-kulopagūḍha*  
*bhakta-mānasādhirūḍha nīla-kaṇṭha-piñcha-cūḍa \|*  
*kaṇṭha-lambi-mañju-guñja keli-labdha-ramya-kuñja*  
*karṇa-varti-phulla-kunda pāhi deva māṁ mukunda \|\|3\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**О Mukunda! О killer of evil Sankhacuda! О Krsna embraced by the gopis! О Krsna who appears in the minds of the devotees! О Krsna wearing a peacock feather in your hair, a necklace of gunja berries hanging on your neck! О Krsna, going to a pleasant bower with jasmine flowers in your ears! О playful boy! Protect me.**

**Комментарий:**

О Mukunda! Protect me. О killer of evil Sankhacuda! Because of this, out of joy, he is embraced (upagudha) by the group of gopis. He has a peacock feather (nila-kantha-pincha) in his hair (cuda). Nllakantha means peacock according to Amara-kosa. He has a necklace of attractive (manju) gunja berries hanging on his neck. He has an attractive bower for pastimes. The rest is clear.

### Text 4

*yajña-bhaṅga-ruṣṭa-śakru-nunna-ghora-megha-cakra*  
*vṛṣṭi-pūra-khinna-gopa-vīkṣaṇopajāta-kopa \|*  
*kṣipra-savya-hasta-padma-dhāritocca-śaila-sadma*  
*gupta-goṣṭha rakṣa rakṣa māṁ tathādya paṅkajākṣa \|\|4\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**О lotus-eyed Krsna, who became angered on seeing the suffering cowherds covered with rain by the fierce assembly of clouds ordered by Indra, offended because his sacrifice was stopped! О Krsna who quickly protected the cowherds by making a house out of towering Govardhana by holding it in your left lotus hand! О lotus-eyed Lord! Therefore, please protect me, protect me today!**

**Комментарий:**

Though the protection was caused by lifting the hill, in the verse it is written that the left hand is the cause since the hill and the hand are nondifferent (as cause and effect). This is explained in Kavya-kaustubha. О lotus-eyed Krsna, as you protect the cows, please protect me. The meter is citra.

*citrasaṁjñam īritaṁ samānikā pada dvayam*

**Citra is two lines of samdnika.**

Samdnika is defined:

*glau-rajau samānikā tu \|\|*

**Samdnika: 1 s Isl sis (gu, la, ra, ja)**

### Text 5

*muktā-hāraṁ dadhad-uḍu-cakrākāraṁ*  
*sāraṁ gopī-manasi manojāropī \|*  
*kopī kaṁse khala-nikurambottaṁse*  
*vaṁśe raṅgī diśatu ratiṁ naḥ śārṅgī \|\|5\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**May the holder of the bow, wearing an excellent pearl necklace shining like constellations, who places love in the gopis’ hearts, who becomes angry at Kaihsa, the chief of all the wicked, who indulges in flute playing, bestow priti to us.**

**Комментарий:**

May the holder of the bow (sarngi), Krsna, give pfiti (ratini) to us. What does he do? He wears a necklace of pearls on his chest. Even though the word hara by itself means a pearl necklace, as defined in Visva-prakdsa with haro muktdvali, the word mukta in this verse removes any doubt, as explained by Bharata Muni:

*karṇāvataṁsādipade karṇādidhvaninirmitiḥ \|*  
*sannidhānādibodhāya sthiteṣvetatsamarthanam \|\|*

**In phrases like karndvatamsa even though the word karna is superfluous (since avatamsa means an ear ornament), it is possible to add such words for clearer understanding.**

The necklace is further described. It has the splendor of a host of constellations (udu-cakra). It is most excellent (sdram) since the pearls are perfectly round, etc. Krsna is further described. He causes love (manoja) to rise in the hearts of the gopis. He is angry at Kamsa. Karhsa is described as the chief (uttamse) of all the wicked. This is an example of alliteration (vrttyanuprasa).

### Text 6

*līloddāmā jaladhara-mālā-śyāmā*  
*kṣāmāḥ kāmād abhiracayantī rāmāḥ \|*  
*sā mām avyād akhila-munīnāṁ stavyā*  
*gavyā-pūrtiḥ prabhur aghaśatror mūrtiḥ \|\|6\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**May that form of the enemy of Agha, the master, independent in pastimes, endowed with the complexion of a string of clouds, who makes the gopis thin from love, who is praised by all sages, who satisfies all the cows, protect me.**

**Комментарий:**

May that form of the enemy of Agha protect me. That form is described. He is independent in his pastimes (liloddama). He is dark like a garland of clouds (jaladhara-mala). He makes (abhiracayanti) the gopis (ramah) slender (ksamah) from their love for him. He is praised by all the sages like Sukadeva, who are detached. They meditate upon him. He makes all the cows satisfied (pUrtih). The word cow (gavya) indicates all the cows according to khala-go-rathadyat: the affix ya comes in the sense of ‘collection thereof, after the words khala, go, and ratha. (Panini Sutras 4.2.50)

Jaladhara-mala is the meter.

*abddhaṅgaiḥ sā jaladharamālāmbhasmā*

**Jaladharamala: 111 Iss ssl 111 (ma, bha, sa, ma)**

The alankara is mudra (since jaladhara-mala is used in the verse too).

### Text 7

*parva-vartula-śarvarī-pati-garva-rīti-harānanaṁ*  
*nanda-nandanam indirākṛta-vandanaṁ dhṛta-candanam \|*  
*sundarī-rati-mandirīkṛta-kandaraṁ dhṛta-mandaraṁ*  
*kuṇḍala-dyuti-maṇḍala-pluta-kandharaṁ bhaja sundaram \|\|7\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**O heart! Worship the beautiful son of Nanda, whose face steals the pride of the full moon, who is worshipped by Laksmi, who wears sandalwood, who makes a palace out of a cave to enjoy with the gopis, who held up Govardhana huge as Mandara Mountain, whose shoulders are spread with a halo from the light of his earrings.**

**Комментарий:**

O heart! Worship the son of Nanda! He is described. His face steals the limit of pride of the full (parva-vartula) moon (sarvari-pati). Though the moon is full, not being equal to Krsna, it wanes. He makes the cave into a palace (mandirlkrta) to enjoy with the beautiful gopis. He held up Govardhana, similar to Mandara mountain (dhrta-mandaram). His neck is spread with a halo of light from his earrings. Kandhara means neck according to Amara-kosa.

### Text 8

*gokulāṅgana-maṇgalaṁ kṛta-pūtanā-bhava-mocanaṁ*  
*kunda-sundara-dantam ambuja-vṛnda-vandita-locanam \|*  
*saurabhākara-phulla-puṣkara-visphurat-kara-pallavaṁ*  
*daivata-vraja-durlabhaṁ bhaja ballavī-kula-vallabham \|\|8\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**O heart! Worship Krsna dear to all the gopis, who is auspicious for all the gopis, who delivered Putana from material life, whose teeth are like jasmine buds, whose eyes are worshipped by lotuses, whose bud-like hands, mines of fragrance, shine like blossoming lotuses, who is difficult for the devatas to attain.**

**Комментарий:**

О heart! Worship Krsna dear to all the gopis (ballavl-kula-vallabham). He is described. His two bud-like hands shine (visphurat) like blossoming lotuses, mines (akara) of fragrance. He is difficult to attain by the host (vraja) of devatas.

The rest is clear. The meter is ranginl. The form with eighteen syllables is not seen in Vrtta-ratnakara and other works. It is seen in Vanl-bhiisana. It is described as follows:

*rasjajairatha bhena reṇa ca raṅgiṇīti samīritam*

**Isl ssl sis sis Iss Isl (ra, sa, ja, ja, bha, ra) is known as ranginl.**

### Text 9

*tuṇḍa-kānti-daṇḍitoru-pāṇḍurāṁśu-maṇḍalaṁ*  
*gaṇḍa-pālitāṇḍa-vāliśāli-ratna-kuṇḍalam \|*  
*phulla-puṇḍarīkhaṇḍa-kḷpta-mālya-maṇḍanaṁ*  
*caṇḍa-bāhu-daṇḍam atra naumi kaṁsa-khaṇḍanam \|\|9\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**In this world I praise Kaihsa’s killer, who derides the full moon by the beauty of his face, who makes his jeweled earrings dance on the edge of his cheeks, who is decorated with garlands made of blossoming white lotuses, and who has ferocious arms.**

**Комментарий:**

I praise the killer of Kamsa in the world (atra'). Krsna is described. He derides (dandita) the disk of the full (uru) moon (pandurathsu) by the beauty of his face (tunda). The edges of his cheeks become dancing places for his jeweled earrings. Pali means edge according to Haima. His makara earrings move at the end of his cheeks. He is decorated with garlands made from groups of blossoming white lotuses (pundarika-khanda). Khanda refers to a group of lotuses according to Amara-kosa. The rest is clear. Because the verse suggests valor, the letters used are full of energy.

### Text 10

*uttaraṅgad-aṅga-rāga-saṅgamāti-piṅgalas*  
*tuṅga-śṛṅga-saṅgi-pāṇi-raṅganātimaṅgalaḥ \|*  
*dig-vilāsi-malli-hāsi kīrti-valli-pallavas*  
*tvāṁ sa pātu phulla-cāru-cillir adya ballavaḥ \|\|10\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**May the young cowherd, pale from applying cosmetics which act like waves, who holds an excellent horn in his hand, who is auspicious for the gopis, who is a sprout on the vine of fame, smiling like a jasmine in all directions, whose attractive brows expand with beauty, protect you today.**

**Комментарий:**

May the young cowherd (ballava) protect you. He is described. He becomes very yellow from application of cosmetics, as if flooding him with wave (uttaranga). Pingala means yellowish according to Amara-kosa. He holds an excellent (tunga) horn in his hand. He is a bud on the vine of fame which smiles brightly like jasmine flowers (malli) spreading (yilasa) in all directions. His attractive brows are joyful with beauty.

The meter is tunaka:

*tūṇakaṁ samānikāpadadvayaṁ vināntimam*

**Tunaka is two lines of samamka without the last syllable.**

*Isl sis Isl sis Isl (ra, ja, ra, ja, ra, gu)*

**Samanika is Isl sis 1 s (ra, ja, gu, la) x 2= Isl sis Is 1 sis Isl (minus last s)**

### Text 11

*indra-nivāraṁ vraja-pati-vāraṁ*  
*nirdhuta-vāraṁ hṛta-ghana-vāram \|*  
*rakṣita-gotraṁ prīṇita-gotraṁ*  
*tvāṁ dhṛta-gotraṁ naumi sa-gotram \|\|11\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**I praise the son of Nanda, who angered Indra, who dried up the rain, who removed water from the clouds, who protected the land, who pleased the cows, who held up the mountain, who was accompanied by friends.**

**Комментарий:**

I praise you, the son of Nanda (vraja-pati-varam). He is described. You angered Indra by stopping his sacrifice. You are very skillful. You dried up (nirdhuta) the rain (varam) by your decision. “But again the clouds will shower rain.” You removed the water from the clouds. Thus you protected the land of Vraja (gotra), driving Indra away. By this you pleased the cows (prinita-gotram). You lifted the hill, Govardhana. You are accompanied by your joyful friends (sagotram).

Gotra means mountain, forest, land and cows according to Haima. Yamaka is the dlankara in the last two lines (repetition of gotra).

### Text 12

*kaṁsa-mahīpati-hṛd-gata-śūlaṁ*  
*santata-sevita-yāmuna-kūlam \|*  
*vande sundara-candraka-cūlaṁ*  
*tvām aham akhila-carācara-mūlam \|\|12\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**I offer respects to you who are a lance in king Kamsa’s heart, who serve the bank of the Yamuna always, who wear a beautiful peacock feather on your head, who are the cause of the universe.**

**Комментарий:**

I offer respects to you. Krsna is described. You are the cause (mulam) of all moving and nonmoving beings. You are the cause of the universe. You do not have a cause, since the root does not have a root. The rest is clear. Because it is pleasing, he praises Krsna using pajjhatika twice. This is mdtra-vrtlam.

*pratipadayamakitaṣoḍaśamātrā navamagurutvavibhūṣitagātrā \|*  
*pajjhaṭikā punaratra vivekaḥ kvāpi na madhyagato gururekaḥ \|\|*

**A meter which echoes similar sound arising from the repetition of similar words and containing sixteen matras in every foot with the ninth matra long and having no ja-gana (sis) is known as pajjhatika. (Chandah kaustubha)**

Those who know meters deviate concerning the long ninth syllable.

*malayaja-ruciras tanu-jita-mudiraḥ*  
*pālita-vibudhas toṣita-vasudhaḥ \|*  
*mām atirasikaḥ kelibhir adhikaḥ*  
*sita-subhaga-radaḥ kṛpayatu varadaḥ \|\|13\|\|*

**Комментарий:**

He protects the learned and the devatas (vibudhah). He satisfies the earth (vasudhah). His teeth (radah) are bright like jasmines (sita) and attractive like buds (subhaga). The rest is clear.

He manifests (urarikrta') waves (bhatigam) of flute sound. His limbs shine with the rays of a fresh cloud. He dances (rangam.) on the bank of the Yamuna. Offer respects (pranamata) to Krsna. The meter is pajjhatika, which was explained previously.

By nature, or by actions (sllam) he satisfies the universe. Sila means nature or pure occupation according to Visva. He has a flute touching his mouth (mukha-sangi). The rest is clear.

I worship Krsna, lord of the cowherds (ballavesam'). He is described. He destroys suffering (klesa-haram). His power (sara) is glorified in the universe. Sara means power according to Visva. He wears necklaces having huge gems. He is an ocean of mercy (krpabhir nadesam).

The meter is bhujanga-prayatam.

*bhujaṅga-prayātaṁ bhaved yaiś caturbhiḥ*

**Bhujanga-prayatam is composed of four yas: sll sll sll sll (ya, ya, ya ya)**

**Sragvini is composed of four ras: Isl Isl Isl Isl (ra, ra, ra, ra).**

He has accepted a morsel of yogurt rice (upatta-kavalam). He is colorful (sabalam) with flower pollen (paraga). Gabala means colorful according to Amara-kosa.

Worship Krsna (tam). He is described. He inspires love in the gopis (pranita-madanam). He has the line of Laksmi (kamalam) on his chest. He holds a play lotus in his hand (karatta). The meter is jaloddhata-gati.

*rasairjasajasā jaloddhatagatiḥ*

**Jaloddhatagati: sis ssl sis ssl (ja, sa, ja, sa) with caesura after the sixth syllable.**

**Комментарий:**

May Krsna who has a peacock feather in his hair protect me. He is described. He performs pastimes, which are praised (navyam) blissfully in the Vrndavana forest.

He speaks jokes (narmodgarl). When, in order to take their clothes they must come out of the water to the bank, while hiding their private parts with their hands, he jokes and tells them that since they have offended the deity of the water, they must place their hands on their heads and offer respects to the sun in order to atone for their offense. The rest is clear. The meter is sdlini.

*māttau gau cecchālinī vedalokaiḥ*

**Malini: 111 Ils Ils 11 (ma, ta, gu, gu) with caesura after the fourth and the seventh following that.**

О friend! Perform bhakti (bhajana-tatim), with hearing, etc., at the feet of the Lord.

The bhakti is described. It produces bhava (valita-ratim). The devotee is described. He is constantly active (aviratih). He moves quickly. This means he gives up his body in a moment. Tvarita-gati also indicates the meter. This is the alankara of mudra.

(sucih) or is the form of madhurya-rasa. The rest is clear. The meter is tvarita-gati:

*tvaritagatiśca najanagaiḥ*

**Tvarita-gati: sss sis sss 1 (na,ja, na, gu)**

О intelligent people! Immediately hold Mukunda in your hearts. Mukunda is described. He has placed an attractive peacock feather in his locks. His forehead defeats the waxing moon of the eighth tithi. The beauty of his teeth derides the jasmine buds (mudrita-kundam).

### Text 28

*yaḥ parirakṣita-surabhī-lakṣas*  
*tad api ca surabhī-mardana-dakṣaḥ \|*  
*muralī-vādana-khuralī-śālī*  
*sa diśatu kuśalaṁ tava vana-mālī \|\|28\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**May the wearer of the garland, Krsna, who protects hundreds of thousands of cows, who is expert at destroying the devatas’ fears, who is accustomed to playing his flute, offer you auspiciousness.**

**Комментарий:**

May the wearer of the garland, Krsna, offer you auspiciousness (kusalam). He is described. He protects hundreds of thousands of cows. He expertly crushes the fear (bhl) of the devatas (surd). This is a pun if the word is divided differently as sura-bhi. The words tad api suggest a contradiction (he protects cows but crushes cows). This creates a confusion in poetic expression (until the word is analyzed as sura-bhi). He is accustomed to practice (khurali) playing the flute. Khurall means practice according to Trikanda-sesa.

### Text 29

*ramita-nikhila-ḍimbe veṇu-pītoṣṭha-bimbe*

*bhavatu mahita-nande tatra vaḥ keli-kande*  
*jagad-avirala-tunde bhaktir urvī mukunde \|\|29\|\|*

**Комментарий:**

May you have great (urvi) bhakti for Mukunda. He is described.

He gives pleasure (ramitd) to all the cowherd boys (dimbe). Dimba means baby according to Amara-kosa. His bimba lips are drunk by the flute. This means his mouth is decorated with the flute. He kills a host (nikurambe) of demons like Putana. Nikuramba means a group according to Haima. He is kissed by the gopis. He worships Nanda. He is devoted to his father. He performs various pastimes (keli-kande). His stomach is packed (avirala) with universes. Tundam means stomach according to Amara-koSa.

*nava-jala-dhara-dhāmā pātu vaḥ kṛṣṇa-nāmā*  
*bhuvana-madhura-veśā mālinī muktir eṣā \|\|30\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**May that form called Krsna, whose beautiful lips are kissed by all the young gopis, whose eyes are restless with love, who showers the gopis with bliss, who appears like a fresh cloud, whose dress gives sweetness to the world, who wears a garland, protect you.**

**Комментарий:**

May that form called Krsna protect you. He is described. His beautiful lips are kissed by the group of young gopis. His eyes are restless (tarala) with love, stimulated by the kisses. By that he showers them with the happiness of enjoyment. The rest is clear. The meter is malini, which was previously explained.

Though Krsna’s qualities are repeatedly mentioned, it is not a fault, since they are repeated out of deep attachment. This is the quality of the devotee.

Thus Mukunda-muktavall has been explained.

*sri-sri-radhakrsnabhyam namah*

**Перевод:**

**I offer respects to Sri Radha and Sri Krsna.**

## Unknown player

*aṅga-śyāmalima-cchaṭābhir abhito mandīkṛtendīvaraṁ*  
*jāḍyaṁ jāguḍa-rociṣāṁ vidadhataṁ paṭṭāmbarasya śriyā \|*  
*vṛndāraṇya-vilāsinaṁ hṛdi lasad-dāmābhirāmodaraṁ*  
*rādhā-skandha-niveśitojjvala-bhujaṁ dhyāyema dāmodaram \|\|*

**Перевод:**

**We should meditate on Damodara, who derides the blue lotus completely by the darkness of his successive limbs, who stuns kunkuma by the beauty of his garment, who plays in Vrndavana, who is made fragrant by a garland shining on his chest, whose radiant arm rests on Radha’s shoulder.**

**Комментарий:**

The author desires to meditate on the couple together. He derides (mandikrta) blue lotuses by the succession (cchatabhih) of his dark limbs. He stuns the beauty of kunkuma by the beauty of his cloth. He is fragrant with garlands shining on his chest. The rest is clear.

One should consider this. “Since Krsna has a svariipa of complete bliss, it is not proper to say that he has a desire for bliss from enjoying sense objects like form and touch of the gopis. This is contrary to his full bliss. Yet Sukadeva describes him as enjoying form and touch, etc. This will cause people to absorb their minds in enjoyment and thus degrade people. That is the conclusion.”

This is not so.

*na pāraye'haṁ niravadya saṁyujāṁ svasādhukṛtyaṁ vibudhāyuṣāpi vaḥ \|*  
*yāmābhajandurjaragehaśṛṅkhalāḥ saṁvṛścya tadvaḥ pratiyātu sādhunā \|\|*

**I am not able to repay my debt for your spotless service, even within a lifetime of Brahma. Your connection with me is beyond reproach. You have worshiped me, cutting off all domestic ties, which are difficult to break. Therefore, please let your own glorious deeds be your compensation. (SB 10.32.22)**

*dharayanty ati-krcchrena*  
*prayah pranan kathancana*  
*pratyagamana-sandesair*  
*ballavyo me madātmikāḥ*

**Simply because I have promised to return to them, my fully devoted cowherd girlfriends struggle to maintain their lives somehow or other. (SB 10.46.6)**

One can perceive the conclusion by such statements. People’s degradation takes place from wicked actions being enacted by their followers. The gopis are forms of himself. If Krsna enjoys touching them, etc., this does not spoil his nature as atmarama. Worry of being contaminated is completely rejected. This is understood from the commentary on kamadhikarana. The conjugal pastimes of the Lord with the gopis may be that of a husband but not that of an upapati .If one were to criticize Krsna and the gopis for improper conduct, it is said: Nourishing oneself with mouthfuls of grass of studying dharma-sastras is useless.

He is the excellent rasika of madhurya-rasa, the Supreme Lord, and atmdrama. His very decision comes true. From his beginningless decision, without touching others he performs pastimes with his beloveds, who are one with him, manifesting without beginning. This does not damage his status as atmarama. Devoted Sukadeva described this while criticizing Pariksit. The king with folded hands listened.

Even in this world love between couples who have mutual attraction, between princes and princesses shining with great brilliance, whose minds are pure, deep with qualities, and most generous, is excellent. There is no trace of fault in this. Since the couple mutually desire the highest benefit, there is no fault of attachment to material objects. Absorption of people’s minds becomes perfected. There is no fault at all.

## ānanda-candrikā

**ananda candrikakhyam radha dasa nama stotram - Ten names of Radha, called Ananda-candrika**

*śrīrādhāyai namaḥ \|*

**Перевод:**

**I offer respects to Sri Radha.**

The son of Nanda, the form of bliss, the Supreme Lord, attaining her, experiences her as the supreme happiness. Placing Radha, profound with qualities in the abode of my heart, I begin this commentary of praises of Radha.

Thus, in eleven stotras Krsna the Supreme Lord has been praised. In the area of Mathura called Gokula, in Vrndavana, within thousand petalled lotus, at the base of a desire tree, in the filaments of the eight petals, Govinda, dark in complexion, wearing yellow cloth, with two arms, a peacock feather on his head and flute and stick in his hand, devoid of qualities, endowed with qualities, devoid of form, endowed with form, devoid of action and endowed with action, shines.

At his two sides are Candravali and Radhika. In the Atharva sruti, in the portion starting with laksmi-durgadika saktih (there are saktis like Laksmi and Durga) it is then said:

*tasyādyā prakṛtī rādhikā nitya-nirguṇā sarvālaṅkāra-śobhitā*

**Radha, the original prakrti, is eternally beyond the material gunas and is glorious with all ornaments.**

Gautamiya-tantra says:

*satyaṁ tatvaṁ paratvaṁ ca tatvatrayamahaṁ kila \|*  
*tritatvarūpiṇī sāpi rādhikā mama vallabhā \|\|*  
*prakṛteḥ para evāhaṁ sāpi macchakti rūpiṇī \|*

**I am the three principles: sattva (effect), tattva (cause) and paratva (spiritual energy). The form of these three is Radhika my consort. I am beyond prakrti and she is my sakti.**

*devī kṛṣṇamayī proktā rādhikā paradevatā \|\|*  
*sarvalakṣmīmayī sarvakāntiḥ saṁmohinī parā \|\|*

**Radha, non-different from Krsna, is the supreme devatd. All Laksmis reside within her. She has all beauty, bewilders everyone and is supreme.**

Radha, the supreme goddess, taught by Krsna Caitanya as Mahalaksmi and nondifferent from Krsna, is now praised. The author now speaks the ten names of Radha.

### Text 1

*rādhā dāmodara-preṣṭhā rādhikā vārṣabhānavī \|*  
*samasta-ballavī-vṛnda-dhammillottaṁsa-mallikā \|\|1\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**Radha is she who fulfills Krsna’s desires. Radha is dearest to Damodara. She worships Krsna. She is the daughter of Vrsabhanu. She is the jasmine garland in the hair for all the gopis.**

**Комментарий:**

Radha means she who accomplishes (radhnoti) the desires of Krsna who is supreme. She produces intense affection (presthd) in the son of Yasoda (damodara). Radhika also means she who worships (radhayati) Krsna with the mood that he is her master. She is the daughter of King Vrsabhanu (varsabhanavi). She is the jasmine ornament in the hair, among all the gopis. She is a garland in the hair. She is offered respects by all the gopis as the queen since she is endowed with all good qualities such as friendliness, and is the daughter of King Vrsabhanu.

### Text 2

*kṛṣṇa-priyāvalī-mukhyā gāndharvā lalitā-sakhī \|*  
*viśākhā-sakhya-sukhinī hari-hṛd-bhṛṅga-mañjarī \|\|2\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**She is the chief of all Krsna’s gopis, she is expert at singing, she is friends with Lalita, she is happy with Visakha’s friendship, she is a flower bud for the bee of Krsna’s heart.**

**Комментарий:**

According to the Sruti quoted, she is the chief of all the dear women of Krsna. She is called Gandharva because of her great skill in singing, etc. She is friends with Lalita. She is happy with the friendship of Visakha who follows her like a shadow.

She is like a flowering creeper for the mind of Krsna, who is like a bee, deriving joy from the flowers.

### Text 4

*imāṁ vṛndāvaneśvaryā daśa-nāma-manoramām \|*  
*ānanda-candrikāṁ nāma yo rahasyāṁ stutiṁ paṭhet \|\|3\|\|*

*sa kleśa-rahito bhūtvā bhūri-saubhāgya-bhūṣitaḥ \|*  
*tvaritaṁ karuṇā-pātraṁ rādhā-mādhava vayor bhavet \|\|4\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**The person who recites the confidential stuti called Ananda-candrika, attractive with ten names of Radha, becoming free of ignorance, ornamented with great auspiciousness, quickly becomes the object of mercy of Radha and Madhava.**

**Комментарий:**

Two verses show the result of reciting the stotra. Klesa-rahitah means having destroyed ignorance.

Ten names of Radha, called Ananda-candrika has been explained.

## prema-sudhāsatram

**śrīprema-sudhāsaktrākhyaṁ śrīvṛndāvaneśvarī-nāmāṣṭottara-śatanāma-stotram \|**

**This is a hundred and eight names of Radha, named Prema-sudha-satra: Sacrifice of sweet prema.**

*namo vṛndāvaneśvaryai \|*

**Перевод:**

**I offer respects to Radha, queen of Vrndavana.**

### Text 1

*mānasaṁ mānasaṁ tyāgād utkaṇṭhārtaṁ nirundhatīm \|*  
*rādhāṁ saṁvidya vidyāḍhyā tuṅgavidyedam abravīt \|\|1\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**Understanding that Radha had restrained her mind which was pained with longing, because she had given up anger, Tungavidya, full of knowledge, spoke to her.**

**Комментарий:**

The author praises Radha by a hundred and eight names. In four verses he first describes the birth of the stotra.

Proud Radha, angry at Krsna who had come to pacify her, remained uninterested. When Krsna departed because of her lack of interest, her heart overwhelmed by his many qualities, experienced regret. Because of ceasing her anger completely (mana-saihtyagat), checking her mind which was pained by longing, she thought, “By my rough words I have rejected Krsna, who is the essence of all good qualities. How will he come to me now?” Understanding that Radha, with great thirst, had changed her mind, Tungavidya, knowing everything, spoke to her friend.

### Text 2

*vimuñca bandhure mānaṁ nirbandhaṁ śṛṇu mad-vacaḥ \|*  
*purā kandarpa-sundaryair yāny utkaṇṭhita-cetase \|\|2\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**O attractive Radha! Give up your anger. Please hear my restraining words, which were instructed previously to Kandarpa-sundari, when her heart was filled with longing.What she said is explained. O attractive Radha (bandhure)! Give up your anger at Krsna. Hear my restraining (nirbandham) words. Do not feel hopeless thinking that he will not come to you because you neglected him. Sensing your permission, he will come.**

### Text 4

*bhagavatyopadiṣṭāni tava sakhyopalabdhaye \|*  
*iṅgitābhijñayā tāni sindūreṇādya vṛndayā \|\|3\|\|*

*vilikhya sakhi dattāni sa jīvita-suhṛttamaḥ \|*  
*virahārtas tavemāni japan nāmāni śāmyati \|\|4\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**The names were instructed by Paurnamasi to her since she desired your friendship. These were recorded by Vrnda, who understood the hint, using sindura as ink. O friend! She wrote the names down and gave them to Krsna. The friend of your life, he chants these names when he feels pain of separation and then becomes pacified.**

**Комментарий:**

The names were previously taught by Paurnamasi (bhagavatya) to Kandarpa-sundari, a gopi. who longed to be your friend. Krsna, your life-giving friend, chants these names when he feels pain in separation from you, and becomes pacified. He gets relief from his pain of separation. How did Krsna obtain these names? By indications from Paurnamasi, they were written down by Vrnda, a forest goddess, and given to Krsna. They were written using sindura, as is the custom of a sorcerer.

Chanting your names in order to meet you, he will gain your permission.

### Text 5

*rādhā kṛṣṇa-vanādhīśā mukunda-madhu-mādhavī \|*  
*govinda-preyasī-vṛnda-mukhyā vṛndāvaneśvarī \|\|5\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**She is Radha. She is the controller of Vrndavana. She is the madhavi creeper for the spring which is Krsna. She is the chief of all Krsna’s beloveds. She is the queen of Vrndavana.**

**Комментарий:**

The names are described. The name Radha was explained previously. She is the controller of Vrndavana, Krsna’s forest. Since she is the queen of that forest, she is the controller. She is the madhavi creeper for the spring (madhu) which is Krsna (mukunda). She broadcasts his qualities. And she becomes joyful only because of him. She is the chief of all Krsna’s beloveds. Though vrndavanesvari repeats the meaning of krsna-vanadhisa, it is not a fault since in chanting all names, Radha is the only subject of all the names.

### Text 6

*brahmāṇḍa-maṇḍalottaṁsa-kīrtiḥ kārtika-devatā \|*  
*dāmodara-priya-sakhī rādhikā vārṣabhānavī \|\|6\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**Her fame is the crown for the whole universe. She is the presiding deity of Kartika month. She is dear to Krsna because of her friendship. She is Radhika, worshipper of Krsna and the daughter of Vrsabhanu.**

**Комментарий:**

Her fame is spread everywhere. She is the presiding deity of Kartika month.

She is dear to Krsna with her friendly nature (priya-sakhi). Thus, in Kartika they should be worshipped together. The last two names were explained previously.

### Text 7

*bhānu-bhakti-bharābhijñā vṛṣabhānu-kumārikā \|*  
*mukharā-prāṇa-dauhitrī kīrtidā-kīrti-dāyinī \|\|7\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**She is expert at worshipping the sun god. She is the young daughter of Vrsabhanu. She is the granddaughter of Mukhara. She gives fame to Kirtida.**

**Комментарий:**

She is skillful at worship of the sun god (bhanu), the Lord’s eternal vibhUti.

She is the daughter of Vrsabhanu. She is the granddaughter (dauhitri) of Mukhara (her maternal grandmother). She gives fame to her mother, Kirtida, wife of Vrsabhanu.

### Text 8

*kṛṣṇa-premābdhi-makarī vatsalācyuta-mātṛkā \|*  
*sakhī-maṇḍala-jīvātur lalitā-jīvitādhikā \|\|8\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**She is a makari in the ocean of prema for Krsna. Yasoda has steady parental affection for her. She is the life of all the sakhis. Lalita takes her as her very life.**

**Комментарий:**

She is a makari in the ocean olprema for Krsna. She is submerged in that prema, like a fish. Mother Yasoda is fixed in parental affection for her. She is the life (jivatuh) of all the sakhis. Taking shelter of her, the group lives. Lalita considers her more than her life.

### Text 9

*viśākhā-prāṇa-sarvasvaṁ kāruṇyāmṛta-medurā \|*  
*paurṇamāsī-pṛthu-prema-pātrī subala-nanditā \|\|9\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**She is everything for Visakha’s pranas. She is thick with sweet mercy. She is the object of Paurnamasi’s great prema. She is overjoyed by messages from Subala.**

**Комментарий:**

Visakha’s pranas become overwhelmed. She is everything for Visakha’s pranas. She is thick (medura) with sweet mercy for all Vraja. She is the object of great prema of Paurnamasi, mother of Sandipani. She is made joyful by Subala, who gives messages about Krsna.

### Text 10

*kuñjādhirāja-mahiṣī vṛndāraṇya-vihāriṇī \|*  
*viśākhā-sakhya-vikhyātā lalitā-prema-lālitā \|\|10\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**She is the queen of Krsna who owns the bowers. She plays in Vrndavana forest. She is famous as the friend of Visakha. She is nourished by Lalita’s prema.**

**Комментарий:**

She is the queen, enthroned by Krsna, who owns the bowers of Vrndavana (kunja-adhiraja). She plays in Vrndavana. She is famous as Visakha’s friend. She does not remain for a second without Visakha. This is well known. She is nourished by Lalita’s prema.

### Text 11

*sadā kiśorikā goṣṭha-yuvarāja-vilāsinī \|*  
*govinda-prema-śikṣārtha-naṭī-kṛta-nijāṁśakā \|\|11\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**She is eternally of kaisora age. She plays with the prince of Vraja. She makes a fortunate jiva dance to teach prema for Govinda.**

**Комментарий:**

She is eternally of kaisora age. She remains at that age. She plays with the prince of Vraja. In order to teach prema of Govinda her master, she lowers her shoulder.

Just as the path of bhakti is spread by Govinda the Supreme Lord, by entering a the great jiva who is his amsa, similarly some great jiva amsa is made by her, the supreme goddess, to show humility through his absorption for teaching that path of prema which will manifest by singing about the pastimes of Govinda and dancing, etc.

### Text 12

*prabodhanī-niśānṛtya-māhātmya-bhara-darśinī \|*  
*candrakānti-carī sarva-gandharva-kula-pāvanī \|\|12\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**Becoming Candrakanti, she showed the great glories of Krsna by dancing on the night of the Prabodhini Ekadasi and purified the families of all Gandharvas.**

**Комментарий:**

This is explained. On the night of Prabodhani Ekadasi, staying awake in front of Krsna, Candrakanti showed the greatness of Krsna through dancing, in the mood of being his companion. Through dancing she describes him. Previous to attaining a similar spiritual form, her amsa jiva was born as Candrakanti. Even on Gandharva-loka, as an amsa, she showed singing and dancing about the Lord. She purifies all the families of Gandharvas. This is explained in Skanda Purana and the three nights’ vrata for tulasl in Bhavisyottara Purana. It is understood that comprehending the main meaning is not achieved through any knower of truth, but by the previously mentioned srutis and smrtis. Just by accepting statements of observers one cannot say that Narada, the nitya parsada, is different from the Narada who was the son of a maidservant.

### Text 13

*svajanma-bhūṣitottuṅga-vṛṣabhānu-kula-sthitiḥ \|*  
*lāsya-vidyā-vrata-snātā rāsa-krīḍādi-kāraṇam \|\|13\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**By her birth she decorated the exalted family of Vrsabhanu. She studied all arts of dancing. She is the cause of the rasa dance.**

**Комментарий:**

By her birth, she decorated the family of Vrsabhanu, most exalted by the influence of the dynasty of the sun. By the birth of Mahalaksmi the family became glorious.

She studied all arts of dancing (lasya-vidya-vrata) with her associates. Without her, the rasa dance could not be accomplished.

### Text 14

*rāsotsava-puro-gaṇyā kṛṣṇa-nīta-rahaḥ-sthalā \|*  
*govinda-baddha-kavarī kṛṣṇottaṁsita-kuntalā \|\|14\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**She is the best in the rasa dance. She was brought by Krsna to a solitary place. Her braid was tied by Krsna. Her locks were decorated by Krsna.**

**Комментарий:**

She is the best (puro-ganya) in the rasa dance. Four names explain this. She was brought by Krsna to a solitary place, when he gave up the others, since he was attracted only to her. The rest is clear.

### Text 15

*vyakta-goṣṭhāravindākṣi vṛndotkarṣāti-harṣiṇī \|*  
*anna-tarpita-durvāsā gāndharvā śruti-viśrutā \|\|15\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**She is joyful on receiving more favors from Krsna than he gave to other famous gopis. She satisfied Durvasa. She is knowledgeable in music. She is famous in the srutis.**

**Комментарий:**

She is joyful because of Krsna’s favors to her, more than to other famous gopis.

She satisfied Durvasa by her offering of food like payasa. He was very pleased with her. He was silent when she gave him the food but when she asked him about Krsna he spoke with pleasure. This is related in Gopala-tapani Upanisad. She is called Gandharva because of her acquisition of knowledge of music. She is famous in the srutis as Mahalaksmi.

### Text 16

*gāndharvikā sva-gāndharva-vismāpita-balācyutā \|*  
*śaṅkhacūḍāri-dayitā gopī-cūḍāgra-mālikā \|\|16\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**She sings fine music. She astonished Balarama and Krsna by her musical skills. She is dear to the enemy of Sankhacuda. She is the jasmine garland on the gopis tied hair.**

**Комментарий:**

She sings music (gandharvika). Ka stands for kayati. This is explained. She astonished Balarama and Krsna by her music during the horika festival. Pleased by this, Balarama gave her the Syamantaka jewel as a prize. The rest is clear.

### Text 17

*cāru-gorocanā-gaurī gārutmata-nibhāmbarā \|*  
*vicitra-paṭṭa-camarī-cāru-veṇī-śikhā-ruciḥ \|\|17\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**She is golden like fine gorocana. She wears cloth colored like emeralds. She is beautiful because of attractive hair decorated with colorful cloth and gems.**

**Комментарий:**

She wears a dark cloth resembling emeralds. She has beauty because of her attractive hair woven with colorful cloth (patta-caman) with clusters of gems such as pearls. Veni-sikha means the front portion of the hair on the head. Sikha means hair tied on the head according to Visva.

### Text 18

*padmendu-jaitra-vaktra-śrī-niruddha-mura-mardanā \|*  
*cakorikā-camatkārī-hari-hāri-vilocanā \|\|18\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**She captures Krsna by the beauty of her face which conquers the lotus and the moon. She astonishes the cakora birds. Her eyes bewilder Krsna.**

**Комментарий:**

She captures Krsna by the beauty of her face which conquers the lotus and the moon. She astonishes the cakora birds, which become attached to looking at her (instead of the moon). She has eyes which bewilder (hari) Krsna (hari).

The cakora bird is fond of moonlight according to Haima.

### Text 19

*kāliya-damanotkampi-bhaṅgura-bhrū-bhujaṅgamā \|*  
*nāsikā-śikharālambi-lavalī-sthala-mauktikā \|\|19\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**Her crooked, snake-like brows cause Krsna to tremble. She wears a huge pearl at the tip of her nose.**

**Комментарий:**

Her snake-like, crooked (bhangura) brows cause Krsna to tremble. She has a huge, pale pearl at the tip of her nose. Lavali means pale.

### Text 20

*bandhurādhara-bandhūka-vikṛṣṭa-madhusūdanā \|*  
*danta-nirdhūta-śikharā śikharīndra-dhara-priyā \|\|20\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**She attracts Krsna by her bandhuka-like charming lips. Her teeth are like ripe pomegranate seeds. She is dear to Krsna who lifted the king of mountains.**

**Комментарий:**

She attracts Krsna, a bee (madhusudana) by her charming lips resembling bhandhuka flowers.

This is the alankdra of successive rupaka. Her teeth conquer ripe pomegranate seeds. This is the meaning of sikhara according to writer of Medini.

### Text 21

*kapola-maṇḍalāndoli-maṇi-kuṇḍala-maṇḍitā \|*  
*pītāṁśuka-śukākarṣi-nistala-stana-dāḍimā \|\|21\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**She is decorated with jeweled earrings which swing on her cheeks. Her rounded pomegranate breasts attract Krsna who is like a parrot.**

**Комментарий:**

She is decorated with jeweled earrings which swing (andoli) on her cheeks. Her rounded (nistala) pomegranate breasts attract Krsna (pitamsuka) who is like a parrot. Nistalam means round according to Halayudha.

### Text 22

*maṇi-kiṅkiṇy-alaṅkāra-jhaṅkāri-śroṇi-maṇḍalā \|*  
*sthalāravinda-viñcholī-nirmañchita-pada-dyutiḥ \|\|22\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**Her hips jingle with a belt of bells and jewels. The beauty of her feet is worshipped by a host of land lotuses.**

**Комментарий:**

The beauty of her feet is worshipped (nirmanchita) by a host (vincholi) of land lotuses (sthaldravinda).

### Text 23

*ariṣṭa-vadha-narmārtha-nirmāpita-sarovarā \|*  
*gandhonmādita-govindo mādhava-dvandvatāṅkitā \|\|23\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**She had Krsna create a lake because of her joking when Krsna killed Arista. She drives Krsna insane with the fragrance of her limbs. She is paired with Krsna.**

**Комментарий:**

She had Syama-kunda built because of her joking words to Krsna after Krsna killed Arista. She said, “How can you touch us?” He built the kunda so that he could touch her. He built the pond because she said he had killed a cow (Arista). Uttering the names of the famous tirthas such as Ganga, when they manifested, Krsna bathed in the water and being pure, touched Radha. This is famous in the Purdnas. She drives Govinda insane by the fragrance of her limbs. She is marked (aiikita) by being paired with Madhava.

*rādhayā mādhavo devo mādhavenaiva rādhikā \|*  
*vibhrājante janeṣu*

**Madhava is with Radha. Radha is with Madhava. In this way they shine among people. (Rk-parisista)**

### Text 24

*kālindī-kūla-kuñja-śrīr bhāṇḍīra-taṭa-maṇḍanā \|*  
*dhṛta-nandīśvara-sthemā govardhana-darī-priyā \|\|24\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**She is the Laksmi of the bowers on the bank of the Yamuna. She acts as the ornament at the side of Bhandira. She creates stability in Nandisvara. She is fond of Govardhana’s caves.**

**Комментарий:**

She is the Laksmi or ornament (srih) of the bowers on the bank of the Yamuna.

She ornaments the side of the Bhandira tree by her pastimes. She produces stability in Nandisvara. She is fond of Govardhana’s caves. Or the caves are pleased because she walks in the caves with her feet.

### Text 25

*vaṁśī-baḍiśikā-viddha-rasottarṣa-mano-jhaṣā \|*  
*vaṁśikā-dhvani-viśraṁsi-nīvī-bandha-grahāturā \|\|25\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**The fish of her mind thirsty for rasa is pierced by the hook of his flute. She is afflicted when the knot tying up her dress is loosened by the sound of the flute.**

**Комментарий:**

Her mind like a fish, thirsting for rasa, is pierced by the hook of the flute. Just as a fish becomes greedy for food, and is pierced by a fishing hook, Radha, thirsty for association with Krsna’s limbs, is pierced internally by the sound of his flute.

She becomes agitated (atura) when the knot on her dress becomes loose because of the sound of his flute.

### Text 26

*mukunda-netra-śapharī vihārāmṛta-dīrghikā \|*  
*nija-kuṇḍa-kuḍuṅgāntas tuṅgānaṅga-rasonmadā \|\|26\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**She is a pond of nectar for the sporting of Mukunda’s saphari fish eyes. She becomes frenzied by great love within the bower on the bank of her kunda.**

**Комментарий:**

She is a pond of nectar for the pastimes of the Saphari fish eyes of Krsna. She gives happiness to his two eyes. She becomes frenzied by the great rasas of love within the bowers (kudunga) on the bank of her kunda.

### Text 27

*kṛṣṇa-bhrūc-caṇḍa-kodaṇḍoḍḍīna-dhairya-vihaṅgamā \|*  
*anurāga-sudhā-sindhu-hindolāndolitācyutā \|\|27\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**The bird of her composure flies up by the fierce bow of Krsna’s brow. She sways Krsna in the swing of a sweet ocean of love.**

**Комментарий:**

The bird of her composure flies up by the fierce bow of Krsna’s brow. Kodanda means a bow according to Haima. She rocks Krsna in the swing (hindola) of the sweet ocean of love (anuraga).

### Text 28

*vrajendra-nandanāsyendu-tuṅgitānaṅga-sāgarā \|*  
*anaṅga-saṅgarottṛṣṇa-kṛṣṇa-luñcita-kañcukā \|\|28\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**Her ocean of love swells by the moon of Krsna’s face. Her bodice is ravished by Krsna, thirsty in the war of love.**

**Комментарий:**

She is a swelling (tungita) ocean of love because of the moon of Krsna’s face (asyd). Her bodice is ravished by Krsna, thirsty (uttrsnd) in the war of love.

### Text 29

*līlā-padma-hatoddāma-narma-lampaṭa-keśavā \|*  
*hari-vakṣo-hari-grāva-haritālīya-rekhikā \|\|29\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**She strikes him with a play lotus when in greed he jokes with her without restraint. She resides as a golden line on the sapphire slab of his chest.**

**Комментарий:**

When greedy Krsna jokes without restraint (uddama) she strikes him with a play lotus (lila-padma). She adheres to his sapphire slab (hari-grava) chest as a golden line and appears glorious there.

### Text 30

*mādhavotsaṅga-paryaṅkā kṛṣṇa-bāhūpadhānikā \|*  
*rati-keli-viśeṣoha-sakhī-smita-vilajjitā \|\|30\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**She makes a bed of Krsna’s lap and a pillow of his arm. She is embarrassed by her sakhis’ smiles when they guess her role in amorous play with Krsna.**

**Комментарий:**

She makes her bed (paryahka) on the lap (utsanga) of Madhava.

Utsanga means lap and paryahka means a bed according to Halayudha.

She makes Krsna’s arm her pillow. Upadhana means pillow according to Halayudha. His arm becomes a pillow and his lap is her bed. She becomes embarrassed by the smiles of her sakhis who guess (uha) that she played the dominant role in amorous play with Krsna (rati-keli).

### Text 31

*ālī-puro-rahaḥ-keli-jalpotka-hari-vandinī \|*  
*vaijayantī kalābhijñā vana-srak-śilpa-kalpinī \|\|31\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**She offers respects to Krsna when, desiring him, she describes intimate pastimes with him to her friends. She is skillful at making Vaijayanti garlands. She makes garland from forest flowers.**

**Комментарий:**

She offers respects to Krsna when, desiring him, she describes intimate pastimes with him to her friends. She offers respects to him while saying, “I swear to you, do not speak like this. If you do, I will never do what you request.” The rest is clear.

### Text 32

*dhātu-citrātivaicitrī-visṛṣṭi-parameṣṭhinī \|*  
*vaidagdhī-prathamācāryā cāru-cāturya-citritā \|\|32\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**She is another form of Brahma in making various designs using mineral colors. She is the first acarya for arts. She has various attractive skills.**

**Комментарий:**

She is another form of Brahma (paramesthinl) in making various designs using mineral colors. She is the first acarya for arts like dancing (vaidagdhi). She first revealed these arts. She has various attractive (earn) skills (caturya) such as cooking and applying perfumes.

### Text 33

*asādhāraṇa-saubhāgya-bhāgyāmṛta-taraṅginī \|*  
*maugdhya-pragalbhatā-ramyā dhīrādhīrāṅka-bhūṣitā \|\|33\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**She is a sweet river of extraordinary, worshippable good fortune. She is attractive as intermediate between maugdhya and pragalbha gopis. She is ornamented with dhiradhira nature.**

**Комментарий:**

She is a river (taranginl) of nectar consisting of extraordinary, worshippable (bhagya) good fortune (saubhdgya) of receiving Krsna’s favors. he has gained his respect. She is attractive by being submissive and bold. This means she is a madhyama gopi. She is decorated with dhira and adhira symptoms. She is a dhiradhira gopi. By these names she is said to be a dhiradhira-madhyama gopi.

### Text 34

*śyāmala-pracchada-paṭī mūka-nūpura-dhāriṇī \|*  
*nikuñja-dhāma-saṁskāra-mādhavādhvekṣaṇa-kriyā \|\|34\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**She wears a dark cloth. She wears silent ankle bells. She arranges the bower and peers on the path for his coming.**

**Комментарий:**

She is given names according to her states like abhisarika, etc. She covers herself with a black cloth. This describes her when she goes for a meeting in the dark night. Pracchada means an upper piece of cloth according to Halayudha. She wears soundless (muka) ankle bells. She prepares (samskard) the bower, making canopies, etc. Coming out of the bower she looks at the path where Krsna will appear. This state is called vasaka-sajja.

### Text 35

*prādurbhūta-ghanotkaṇṭhā vipralambha-viṣaṇṇa-dhīḥ \|*  
*prātar utprāsitopendrā candrāvali-kaṭākṣiṇī \|\|35\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**She manifests intense longing. She becomes depressed on being cheated. In the morning she scolds Krsna. She glances at Candravali with disdain.**

**Комментарий:**

She manifests intense longing (ghanotkantha) when Krsna is late. This is the utkanthita woman. Not attaining Krsna after making an appointment she feels disappointment (vipralambha). This is the state called vipralabdha (being cheated). She boldly scolds Krsna (upendra) when morning comes. This is the khandita (devastated) woman. She glances disdainfully at Candravali. Her glances mean, “You have a concealed mind. How can she, full of desire, know about your happiness?” and “You are like her.”

### Text 36

*anākarṇita-kaṁsāri-kāku-vādā manasvinī \|*  
*cāṭukāra-hari-tyāga-jātānuśaya-kātarā \|\|36\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**She does not listen to Krsna’s humble pleas. She is fixed in her mind. She is pained with regret on rejecting Krsna’s pleasing words.**

**Комментарий:**

She does not listen to Krsna’s pleas (kakuvada). He says, “I am devoted only to you. Meeting some obstacle, 1 could not come to you. If you reject me, I cannot exist.” This is because she is fixed in her mind (manasvini) because of pride in love. Doing this, she becomes crooked. “Let him become very happy.” She feels pain and regret (anusaya) by rejecting Krsna as he speaks words while offering respects (cdtukdra). This is the kalahantarita woman. Anusaya means repentance according to Halayudha.

### Text 37

*dhṛta-kṛṣṇekṣaṇautsukyā lalitā-bhīti-māninī \|*  
*viprayoga-vyathā-hāri-hari-sandeśa-nanditā \|\|37\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**She is anxious to see Krsna. She remains proud because of fear of Lalita. She becomes joyful on receiving news of Krsna, which takes away her pain of separation.**

**Комментарий:**

She is anxious (autsukya) to see Krsna. Though dissipating her anger, she remains proud (manini), out of fear of Lalita. She becomes joyful at receiving news of Krsna, which takes away (han) the pain of separation (yiprayogd). Then she meets him.

### Text 38

*madālpa-jalpitādhīna-puṇḍarīkākṣa-maṇḍitā \|*  
*bhrū-līlā-mohitopendra-hastāgra-hṛta-vaṁśikā \|\|38\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**She is decorated with lotus-eyed Krsna who has become obedient on hearing her half-spoken words arising from youthful intoxication. She steals the flute from his hand when he is bewildered by her playfully moving brow.**

**Комментарий:**

She is decorated with lotus-eyed Krsna who has become obedient on hearing her half-spoken words (alpita-jalpita) arising from youthful intoxication (madd). This is the svadhina-bhartrka woman. She steals the flute from his hand when he is bewildered by her moving brow.

### Text 39

*atulācyuta-mādhurya-svādanādvaita-bhāgya-bhūḥ \|*  
*niyuddha-śrānti-nidrāṇa hari-hārāpahāriṇī \|\|39\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**She is the shelter of the worshippable incomparable form of experiencing incomparable, infallible sweetness. She steals Krsna’s necklace when he sleeps, exhausted from amorous combat.**

**Комментарий:**

She is the shelter of the worshippable (bhagya), incomparable (advaitd) entity, the very form of experiencing incomparable, infallible sweetness. She steals the necklace of Krsna as he sleeps, exhausted from close combat.

### Text 40

*dyūta-nirjita-vaṁśārthi-kaṁsāri-parihāsinī \|*  
*nija-prāṇārbuda-preṣṭha-kṛṣṇa-pāda-nakhāñcalā \|\|40\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**She laughs when Krsna requests return of his flute that she won in gambling. She takes the tip of his toenail to be dearer than ten million of her lives.**

**Комментарий:**

She laughs when Krsna requests return of his flute that she won in gambling. She jokes, “Somewhere today your flute which gives suffering has been crushed and went into the ocean by the flow of the Yamuna.” She takes the tip of his toenail to be dearer that ten million of her lives. This shows that she is the best of devotees. In this way Krsna chanted her names which were forms of her pastimes.

### Text 41

*iti rādhā sakhī-vācam ācamya pulakāñcitā \|*  
*chadmanā padmanābhasya latā-sadmāntikaṁ gatā \|\|41\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**Hearing her sakhi’s words, with hairs standing on end, Radha, on the pretext of picking flowers went to the creeper bower of Krsna.**

**Комментарий:**

The result of Krsna chanting the names is stated. Sipping her sakhi’s words woven with the names previously described, hearing with respect, Radha, due to the chanting of these names, went to the creeper bower of Krsna on the pretext of picking flowers. She fulfilled his desire.

### Text 42

*yaḥ sevate jano rādhā-nāmnām aṣṭottaraṁ śatam \|*  
*nāmnā prema-sudhā-saktraṁ lihyāt prema-sudhām asau \|\|42\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**The person who recites the hundred and eight names of Radha, called prema-sudha-satra, will taste the nectar of prema.**

**Комментарий:**

The result of reciting the stotra is described. That person who recites (sevate) with affection will taste with his tongue the nectar of prema.

Thus, the hundred and eight names of Radha called prema-sudha-satra have been explained.

## śrī-rādhāṣṭakam

*namaḥ śrīvṛndāvaneśvaryai \|*

**Перевод:**

**I offer respects to Radha, queen of Vrndavana.**

### Text 1

*diśi diśi racayantīṁ sañcaran-netra-lakṣmī-*  
*vilasita-khuralībhiḥ khañjarīṭasya khelām \|*  
*hṛdaya-madhupa-mallīṁ ballavādhīśa-sūnor*  
*akhila-guṇa-gabhīrāṁ rādhikām arcayāmi \|\|1\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**I worship Radha who plays in all directions as a khanjana bird with repeated skillful glances, moving playfully with wealth of beauty, who is a jasmine flower for the bee of Krsna’s heart, who is deep with all good qualities.**

**Комментарий:**

He praises Radha with eight verses.

I worship Radha. She is described. She plays in all directions as a khanjana bird with repeated (khuralibhih) skillful glances, moving playfully with wealth of beauty. Khanjrita means khanjana bird according to Amara-kosa. When she glances with her eyes the directions appear to be filled with a flock of khanjana birds. She is a jasmine flower for the bee of Krsna’s heart. She causes bliss in his heart.

“How should a male worship Radha, Krsna’s young girl?” One should do so with female form. “How can a male have a female form?” He can do so by meditation. Please understand this. This meditation is not contradictory. The svariipa of the jiva is a small particle of consciousness. It is not male. Only its material body is male.

*naiva strī na pumāneṣa na caivāyaṁ napuṁsakaḥ \|*  
*yadyaccharīramādatte tena tena sa yujyate \|\|*

**The jiva is not female, nor male, not neuter. When he assumes a body, he develops characteristics of male or female. (Svetasvatara Upanisad 5.10)**

On giving up the body, according to one’s meditation, by the will of the Lord, one can attain a female form of knowledge and bliss. It is not impossible.

*yathā kraturasmilloke puruṣo bhavati tathetaḥ pretya bhavati*

**As a man worships in this world, on dying he becomes similar in the next world. (Chandogya Upanisad 3.14.1)**

**yādṛśī bhāvanā yasya siddhirbhavati tādṛśī**

According to one’s meditation one achieves perfection. (Pancatantra 5.98)

*striyo vā puruṣo vāpi bhartṛbhāvena keśavam \|*  
*hṛdi kṛtvā gatiṁ yānti śrutīnāṁ nātra saṁśayaḥ \|\|*

**Whether a woman or man, if one meditates on Kesava as one’s husband, one will attain that goal of the srutis without doubt. (Brhad-vamana Parana)**

### Text 2

*pitur iha vṛṣabhānor anvavāya-praśastiṁ*  
*jagati kila samaste suṣṭhu vistārayantīm \|*  
*vraja-nṛpati-kumāraṁ khelayantīṁ sakhībhiḥ*  
*surabhiṇi nija-kuṇḍe rādhikām arcayāmi \|\|2\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**I worship Radha, who spreads the glory of Vrsabhanu’s dynasty throughout the whole world by her birth, and who plays with Krsna along with her sakhls in her fragrant kunda.**

**Комментарий:**

The author describes Radha as the producer of glory for her father’s family.

By her birth she spreads the praise of her father Vrsabhanu’s dynasty (anvavaya-prasastirri) in the whole world. Anvavaya means family lineage according to Amara-kosa. She plays with Nanda’s son along with her friends such as Lalita in her kunda, fragrant with pollen. She splashes water.

### Text 3

*śarad-upacita-rākā-kaumudī-nātha-kīrti-*  
*prakara-damana-dīkṣā-dakṣiṇa-smera-vaktrām \|*  
*naṭad-aghabhid-apāṅgottuṅgitānaṅga-raṅgāṁ*  
*kalita-ruci-taraṅgāṁ rādhikām arcayāmi \|\|3\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**I worship Radha, whose smiling face is skillful at initiating absolute control over the fame of the spotless full moon which has increased in size in autumn, whose pastimes of love increase by the dancing glance of Krsna and who radiates waves of beauty.**

**Комментарий:**

He describes the flood of sweetness from her face. Her smiling face is skillful (daksina) at initiating great (prakara) control over the fame of spotless full moon which has increased in size (upacita) in autumn. Daksina means skillful according to Haima. Her pastimes of love increase by the dancing glance of Krsna. She produces waves of beauty.

### Text 4

*vividha-kusuma-vṛndotphulla-dhammilla-ghāṭī-*  
*vighaṭita-mada-ghūrṇat-keki-piccha-praśastim \|*  
*madhuripu-mukha-bimbodgīrṇa-tāmbūla-rāga-*  
*sphurad-amala-kapolāṁ rādhikām arcayāmi \|\|4\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**I worship Radha who derides the tails of peacocks whirling about in passion with the assault of her hair blossoming with various flower clusters, whose spotless cheek gleams with the color of betel nut from Krsna’s bimba-red lips.**

**Комментарий:**

The beauty produced after enjoyment is described. She derides the tails of peacocks whirling about in passion by the assault (dhati) by her hair blossoming with various flower clusters. She derides the peacock tails by her flowered hair loosened because of amorous play with Krsna. Dhati means forceful attack according to Amara-kosa. Her spotless cheek gleams with the color of betel nut from Krsna’s mouth. Her cheek shines with the color of betel nut stuck there caused by his kissing.

### Text 5

*amalina-lalitāntaḥ-sneha-siktāntaraṅgām*  
*akhila-vidha-viśākhā-sakhya-vikhyāta-śīlām \|*  
*sphurad-aghabhid-anargha-prema-māṇikya-peṭīṁ*  
*dhṛta-madhura-vinodāṁ rādhikām arcayāmi \|\|5\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**I worship Radha, whose heart is sprinkled with the affection of Lalita’s spotless heart, whose character is made famous by the friendship of Visakha expressed in all ways, who is a treasure box of shining rubies of Krsna’s prema, who is filled with sweet pastimes.**

**Комментарий:**

She is the object of exclusive love from her sakhis and Krsna. Her heart (antarangam) is soaked with the affection of Lalita’s heart (antah), which shines with pure friendship (amalina). Her character is famous because of the friendship of Visakha, expressed in various ways. She is a treasure box of shining rubies of Krsna’s prema. Petl means a box according to Haima.

### Text 6

*atula-mahasi vṛndāraṇya-rājye’bhiṣiktāṁ*  
*nikhila-samaya-bhartuḥ kārtikasyādhidevīm \|*  
*aparimita-mukunda-preyasī-vṛnda-mukhyāṁ*  
*jagad-aghahara-kīrtiṁ rādhikām arcayāmi \|\|6\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**I worship Radha who was coronated in the kingdom of Vrndavana, of incomparable greatness and incomparable joy, who is the presiding deity of Kartika month, the chief of all seasons, who is the chief among all the unlimited beloveds of Krsna, and whose fame destroys all the sins of the world.**

**Комментарий:**

Coronation of Radha as the queen of Vrndavana is described. At the order of Paurnamasi, mistress of great powers, through a voice from the sky, the five goddesses Ekanamsa, Samjna, Chaya, Sauri and Ganga and Brahma’s wife came. Sarasvati gathered lotuses, garlands, gold, a throne, jeweled ornaments, an umbrella, camara, and cloth. In the sky devatas played drums and Gandharvas like Tumburu sang while Apsaras danced. At the auspicious moment, in the great assembly she was bathed in the kingdom of Vrndavana, belonging to the Supreme Lord Krsna. The five goddesses placed her on a golden pedestal and sprinkled her with water mixed with celestial herbs in jeweled pots. She was given tilaka indicating the rights to rule and was presented with gifts by Brahma’s wife, etc., on the request of Sarasvati. Responsibilities were given to Vrnda. Krsna’s friends became assistants. She became queen of Vrndavana. The message from the sky was caused by Krsna. In order to discard the doubt about the greatness of Radha, best of the gopis to rule just five yojanas of Vrndavana as a kingdom, the kingdom of Vrndavana is described.

She was coronated in the kingdom of Vrndavana, having a festival (mahasi) since she was made the queen with her beloved, full of bliss, and since it was served by spring at all times and has incomparable power (mahasi), since it is superior to Mathura which is superior to Vaikuntha which makes millions of universes seem like a speck. Mahas means festival and power according to Nanartha-varga.

Thus, it is outstanding, the ultimate, greater than such kingdoms. One can consult Dana-kell Kaumudi for this story.

Being the queen of the Lord is described next.

*yathā dāmodaro bhakta-vatsalo vidito janaiḥ \|*  
*tasyāyaṁ tādṛśo māsaḥ svalpam apy urukārakaḥ \|\|*

**Just as Damodara is known to be affectionate to the devotees by people, his month is similar. A small deed rendered in this month gives great results. (Padma Purana)**

**Similar to the month is the devata of that month, Urjesvari. Thus, during Kartika month, when worshipping Damodara, one should worship Radha with him.**

*yathā rādhā priyā viṣṇotasyāḥ kuṇḍaṁ priyaṁ tathā \| sarvagopīṣu savaikā viṣṇor atyanta-vallabhā \|\|*

**Just as Radha is dear to Krsna, her kunda is dear to him. Among all the gopis Radha is dearest to him. (Padma Purana)**

*yasyā aṁśe lakṣmī-durgādika-śaktir*

**Her amsas are Laksmi, Durga and other saktis. (Purusa-bodhinl-sruti)**

Sruti thus says that she is Mahalaksmi and gives examples of all her expansions.

### Text 7

*hari-pada-nakha-koṭī-pṛṣṭha-paryanta-sīmā-*  
*taṭam api kalayantīṁ prāṇa-koṭer abhīṣṭām \|*  
*pramudita-madirākṣī-vṛnda-vaidagdhya-dīkṣā-*  
*gurum ati-guru-kīrtiṁ rādhikām arcayāmi \|\|7\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**I worship Radha who takes the very tips and surfaces of Krsna’s toenails to be dearer than millions of her lives, who is the acarya for teaching skillful arts to all the joyful gopis, whose fame is vast.**

**Комментарий:**

Her loyalty to Krsna is shown. She accepts (kalayantim) the very tip and surface of his toenails to be dearer (abhistam.) than millions of her lives. She is the acarya in teaching (dlksa) the arts (vaidagdhya) for all the joyful gopis.

### Text 8

*amala-kanaka-paṭṭoddhṛṣṭa-kāśmīra-gaurīṁ*  
*madhurima-laharībhiḥ samparītāṁ kiśorīm \|*  
*hari-bhuja-parirabdhāṁ labdha-romāñca-pāliṁ*  
*sphurad-aruṇa-dukūlāṁ rādhikām arcayāmi \|\|8\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**I worship Radha whose golden form is like kunkuma ground on a spotless golden slab, whose kaisora form is surrounded by waves of sweetness, who is embraced by Krsna’s arms, whose hairs stand on end, who shines with red cloth.**

**Комментарий:**

Her sweetness is described. She is golden like kunkuma crushed on a golden slab (kanaka-patta). Patta means a slab from grinding according to Visvalocana. Her youthful form is surrounded by waves of sweetness. Her form shines like a lightning. Kisori means she is eternally of kaisora age. The rest is clear.

### Text 9

*tad-amala-madhurimṇāṁ kāmam ādhāra-rūpaṁ*  
*paripaṭhati variṣṭhaṁ suṣṭhu rādhāṣṭakaṁ yaḥ \|*  
*ahima-kiraṇa-putrī-kūla-kalyāṇa-candraḥ*  
*sphuṭam akhilam abhīṣṭaṁ tasya tuṣṭas tanoti \|\|9\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**The auspicious moon Krsna residing on the bank of the Yamuna, satisfied, bestows all desires clearly to the person who recites this excellent Radhastaka, the complete shelter of her pure, charming qualities.**

**Комментарий:**

The result of reciting the eight verses is described. Krsna, dear to Radha, satisfied with that person who recites daily the Radhastaka happily (susthu) gives (tanoti) him everything he desires (abhistam). The astaka is described. It is the shelter (adhara-rupam) of pure (amala) charm (madhurimnam) of the abundant qualities of her svariipa. The astaka reveals her qualities. It reveals Krsna in his extraordinary features. He is the auspicious moon in Vrndavana on the bank of the Yamuna (ahima-kirana-putri). He is always the full moon. The meter is mdlinl.

Thus Radhastaka has been explained.

## prārthanā-paddhatiḥ

*śrīrādhikāyai namaḥ \|*

**Перевод:**

**I offer respects to Sri Radha.**

### Text 1

*śuddha-gāṅgeya-gaurāṅgīṁ kuraṅgī-laṅgimekṣaṇām \|*  
*jita-koṭīndu-bimbāsyām ambudāmbara-saṁvṛtām \|\|1\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**I implore you whose limbs are more golden than pure gold, whose eyes are those like a deer’s, whose face conquers millions of moons, who is covered by a cloud-colored cloth.**

**Комментарий:**

The author pleases Radha by prayer. O queen of Vrndavana! This person implores you. This is understood in the five verses. She is described. Her limbs are more golden than pure gold (garigeya). Anything greater is rejected. Her eyes are attractive like those of a deer (kurangi). Her face conquers millions of moons. She is covered by cloth similar to a cloud.

### Text 2

*navīna-ballavī-vṛnda-dhammillottaṁsa-mallikām \|*  
*divya-ratnādy-alaṅkāra-sevyamāna-tanu-śriyam \|\|2\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**I implore you, who are the jasmine ornament in the hair of the young gopis, whose beauty is served by attractive jeweled ornaments.**

**Комментарий:**

The meaning is clear.

### Text 3

*vidagdha-maṇḍala-guruṁ gaṇa-gaurava-maṇḍitām \|*  
*atipreṣṭha-vayasyābhir aṣṭābhir abhiveṣṭitām \|\|3\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**I implore you, who are the guru of the group of skillful gopis, who are decorated with great qualities, who are surrounded by eight dear friends.**

**Комментарий:**

She has qualities like friendliness and kindness.

### Text 4

*cañcalāpāṅga-bhaṅgena vyākulīkṛta-keśavām \|*  
*goṣṭhendra-suta-jīvātu-ramya-bimbādharāmṛtām \|\|4\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**I implore you, who agitate Krsna by your fickle glance, whose attractive sweet bimba lips are the life of Nanda’s son.**

**Комментарий:**

You agitate Krsna by the waves of your fickle glance (cancalapanga-bhangena).

### Text 5

*tvām asau yācate natvā viluṭhan yamunā-taṭe \|*  
*kākubhir vyākula-svānto jano vṛndāvaneśvari \|\|5\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**О queen of Vrndavana! This person, bowing down, rolling on the bank of the Yamuna, agitated in heart, implores you with choked words.**

**Комментарий:**

This person (the author) implores you with choked words (kakubhih).

### Text 6

*kṛtāgaske’py ayogye’pi jane’smin kumatāv api \|*  
*dāsya-dāna-pradānasya lavam apy upapādaya \|\|6\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**Bestow a particle of the gift of charity of servitude to this person, who is an offender, devoid of good qualities and having crooked intelligence.**

**Комментарий:**

What do you request? That is explained.

Though I am an offender (krtagaske), without good qualities (ayogye), and with crooked intelligence (kumatau), give (upapadaya) a particle of the gift of bestowal of servitude. The alanhara is visesokti. Though the candidate is not qualified, there is a cause for giving in the total statement since without asking, the result would not exist.

*viśeṣoktir akhaṇḍeṣu kāraṇeṣu phalāvacaḥ*

**Visesokti means not mentioning some effect, when the causes are present. (Kavya-prakasa)**

### Text 7

*yuktas tvayā jano naiva duḥkhito’yam upekṣitum \|*  
*kṛpād-dyota-dravac-citta-navanītāsi yat sadā \|\|7\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**You should not neglect this suffering person since your heart is always like melted butter, shining with mercy.**

**Комментарий:**

“How can I give mercy to an unqualified person?” You should not neglect this suffering person, since you have qualities like mercy. Mercy means desire to destroy others’ suffering. I am suffering and thus should not be rejected. The verse shows kavya-lingam.

Thus the prarthana-paddhati has been explained.

## cāṭu-puṣpāñjaliḥ

**Handful of flowers of graceful words**

*śrīrādhikāyai namaḥ \|*

**Перевод:**

**I offer respects to Sri Radha.**

### Text 1

*nava-gorocanā-gaurīṁ pravarendīvarāmbarām \|*  
*maṇi-stavaka-vidyoti-veṇī-vyālāṅganā-phaṇām \|\|1\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**I offer respects to you, who are more golden than fresh gorocana, whose cloth is the color of a blossoming blue lotus, and whose hair with a braid, decorated with jewels and flower clusters, resembles a snake hood.**

**Комментарий:**

*catumatrena ya manksu. svaminl nija-sammukhe \|*  
*prasidati jane staumi tarn aham radhikam param \|\|*

**I praise supreme Radha, the controller, who is very pleased with the person in front of her by his offerings of graceful words.**

О queen of Vrndavana! 1 offer respects to you. Twelve verses are connected. She is described. Your limbs are more golden than fresh gorocana. Your cloth is like a blue lotus (indivara), most attractive, having freshly blossomed (pravaram). You have the hood of a female snake (yyalahgana), which is your hair shining with clusters of jewels. Her braid is compared to a snake. The hair part in front is the hood of the snake. The jewel clusters are the jewels on the hood of the snake. This is the alankara of riipaka.

### Text 2

*upamāna-ghaṭamāna-prahāri-mukha-maṇḍalām \|*  
*navendu-nindi-bhālodyat-kasturī-tilaka-śriyam \|\|2\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**I offer respects to you, whose face defeats all objects of poetic comparisons, whose beautiful, shining musk tilaka rises on your forehead which defeats the new moon.**

**Комментарий:**

You have a face that defeats the pride of things compared to, such as the moon or the lotus. Her face has no compare. You have beauty with musk tilaka in the form of the Lord’s foot, appearing on your forehead which criticizes the new moon.

### Text 3

*bhrū-jitānaṅga-kodaṇḍāṁ lola-nīlālakāvalim \|*  
*kajjalojjvalatā-rājac-cakorī-cāru-locanām \|\|3\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**I offer respects to you whose brow conquers the bow of Cupid, whose black locks of hair gently sway, and whose charming cakori eyes glow with bright collyrium.**

**Комментарий:**

Your brows defeat Cupid’s bow. Your locks are black and trembling. Your eyes more charming than cakori birds thirsting for their beloveds, shine with bright collyrium.

### Text 4

*tila-puṣpābha-nāsāgra-virājad-vara-mauktikām \|*  
*adharodbhūta-bandhūkāṁ kundālī-bandhura-dvijām \|\|4\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**I offer respects to you, who have a lustrous round pearl on the tip of your sesame flower nose, whose lips deride the bandhuka flower and whose teeth are as beautiful as jasmine flowers.**

**Комментарий:**

A pearl within small rubies excellent with roundness and luster shines at the tip of your sesame flower nose. Below two big pearls are many small pearls according to some.

### Text 5

*sa-ratna-svarṇa-rājīva-karṇikā-kṛta-karṇikām \|*  
*kastūrī-bindu-cibukāṁ ratna-graiveyakojjvalām \|\|5\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**I offer respects to you, with ornaments of lotuses made of gold and gems in your ears, with a musk dot on your chin, and with a shining, jeweled throat necklace.**

**Комментарий:**

You have ear ornaments made of lotus centers made of gold and gems. Karnika means a seed vessel according to Halayudha. Cibuka is below the lips (chin) according to Halayudha. Graiveyaka is a neck ornament according to Amara-kosa.

### Text 6

*divyāṅgada-pariṣvaṅga-lasad-bhuja-mṛṇālikām \|*  
*balāri-ratna-balaya-kalālambi-kalāvikām \|\|6\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**I offer respects to you, whose lotus stem arms are embraced by attractive armbands, and whose forearms jingle with sapphire bangles.**

**Комментарий:**
