You have two lotus stem arms embraced by attractive armbands (ahgada). Your two forearms (kaldvikam) support sweet sounding (kala) bracelets made of sapphires (baldri). Kalavika means the part of the arm, below the wrist (manibandha) according to Haima (thus the forearm). Manibandha means wrist according to Halayudha.

### Text 7

*ratnāṅgurīyakollāsi-varāṅguli-karāmbujām \|*  
*manohara-mahā-hāra-vihāri-kuca-kuḍmalām \|\|7\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**I offer respects to you who have lotus hands with fine fingers dancing with jeweled rings, with a huge attractive necklace playing on your lotus-bud breasts.**

**Комментарий:**

You have lotus hands whose excellent fingers dance with rings embedded with jewels. Ahguliyaka means finger ornaments according to Halayudha. The alahkara is parinama.

*pariṇāmaḥ kriyārthaścedāropyo viṣayātmanā*

**Parinama means properties of an object are transferred to the subject of comparison.**

The dancing with the rings on the fingers is accomplished when the properties of the lotus are transferred to the hands. You have bud-like breasts, the playground of attractive huge necklaces.

### Text 8

*romāli-bhujagī-mūrdha-ratnābha-taralāñcitām \|*  
*vali-trayī-latā-baddha-kṣīṇa-bhaṅgura-madhyamām \|\|8\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**I offer respects to you, who are decorated with a center jewel at the top of your snake-like line of hair, whose thin, curved waist is bound by a creeper of three lines.**

**Комментарий:**

You are beautiful with a center jewel (tarala), the Syamantaka, at the top of a snake-like line of hair ascending from the navel. Tarala means jewel in the center of a necklace according to Amara-kosa. You have a curved, thin waist bound by a creeper of three lines. The waist is bound by the creeper because it is thin, loaded with the weight of her breasts.

### Text 9

*maṇi-sārasanādhāra-visphāra--śroṇi-rodhasam \|*  
*hema-rambhā-madārambha-stambhanoru-yugākṛtim \|\|9\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**I offer respects to you, who wear a jeweled belt around your broad hips, and whose thighs stun the pride of golden banana stalks.**

**Комментарий:**

You have a broad waist (sroni-rodhasam), the receptacle of bells made of jewels. Sarasana means a small bell according to Halayudha. The beauty (akrtim) of your thighs stuns the great pride (madarambha) of golden banana stalks in roundness and thickness. Akrtim means beauty according to Visva.

### Text 10

*jānu-dyuti-jita-kṣulla-pīta-ratna-samudgakām \|*  
*śaran-nīraja-nīrājya-mañjīra-viraṇat-padām \|\|10\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**I offer respects to you whose knees defeat two small topaz caskets, and whose feet with jingling ankle bells are worshipped by the autumn lotus.**

**Комментарий:**

By the beauty of your knees you defeat a small (ksulla) topaz casket(samudgakam).

Ksulla means small according to Haima. Your two feet jingling with ankle bells are worshipped (nlrajya) by two lotuses growing in autumn.

### Text 11

*rākendu-koṭi-saundarya-jaitra-pāda-nakha-dyutim \|*  
*aṣṭābhiḥ sāttvikair bhāvair ākulī-kṛta-vigrahām \|\|11\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**I offer respects to you, the beauty of whose toenails defeats the beauty of thousands of full moons, and whose body is agitated by the eight sattvika-bhavas.**

**Комментарий:**

The beauty of your toenails defeats (jaitrd) millions of full moons. The rest is clear.

### Text 12

*mukundāṅga-kṛtāpāṅgām anaṅgormi-taraṅgitām \|*  
*tvām ārabdha-śriyānandāṁ vande vṛndāvaneśvari \|\|12\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**О queen of Vrndavana! I offer respects to you, blissful with beauty, who glance at Krsna’s limbs and who have developed billowing waves of love.**

**Комментарий:**

You glance at Mukunda from the edge of your eye (apangam). By looking at Mukunda, you develop billowing (urmi) waves of love. О queen of Vrndavana, Radha! I offer respects to you.

### Text 13

*ayi prodyan-mahā-bhāva-mādhurī-vihvalāntare \|*  
*aśeṣa-nāyikāvasthā-prākaṭyādbhuta-ceṣṭite \|\|13\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**О Radha, whose heart is overwhelmed with the sweetness of intense mahabhava, who displays astonishing actions as unlimited types of heroine!**

**Комментарий:**

Ayi indicates a humble question according to Halayudha. Your heart is overwhelmed by the sweetness of intense mahabhava. Your actions are astonishing with states of unlimited heroines such as mugdha, etc. Just as Krsna, Svayam Bhagavan manifests qualities of all types of heroes according to the situation, so Radha who is Svayam Laksmi manifests the qualities of all heroines.

### Text 14

*sarva-mādhurya-viccholī-nirmanchita-padāmbuje \|*  
*indirā-mṛgya-saundarya-sphurad-aṅghri-nakhāñcale \|\|14\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**О Radha, whose lotus feet are worshipped by all types of sweetness, and whose beauty in the shining tips of your toenails is sought by Laksmi.**

**Комментарий:**

Your lotus feet are worshipped by the splendor within the sweetness of all heroines. The beauty of the tips of your shining toenails are sought by Laksmi.

According to the srutis mentioned previously, Radha is Maha-laksmi. Thus, the beauty of her toenails is sought by all the Laksmis who are her vilasamsas or kolas.

Sankarsana worships Vasudeva’s beauty. The two lords of Badari worship the beauty of the lord of Svetadvipa. Pradyumna, Balarama and others worship Krsna’s beauty. There is no lack of proof about this.

But others explain as follows. The mistress of Vaikuntha seeks the beauty of Radha since Radha is accepted by Krsna. But she cannot attain it since she is not fully devoted to him.

*yad vāñchayā śrī-lalanācarattapo vihāya kāmān suciraṁ dhṛtavratā*

**For this end, the goddess of fortune performed austerities for centuries, giving up all other desires and taking austere vows. (SB 10.16.36)**

### Text 15

*gokulendu-mukhī-vṛnda-sīmantottaṁsa-mañjari \|*  
*lalitādi-sakhī-yūtha-jīvātu-smita-korake \|\|15\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**О Radha, flower bud in the hair of all Krsna’s chief groups, and whose bud-like smile is the life of Lalita and other sakhis.**

**Комментарий:**

The meaning of the first line is clear. The bud of your gentle smile is the life of group of sakhis headed by Lalita.

### Text 16

*caṭulāpāṅga-mādhurya-bindūnmādita-mādhave \|*  
*tāta-pāda-yaśaḥ-stoma-kairavānanda-candrike \|\|16\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**О Radha, blissful moonlight for the lotuses of your father’s fame, whose side glance, even slight, drives Krsna insane!**

**Комментарий:**

You drive Madhava insane by a drop of sweetness of the fickle edge of your eye.

You are moonlight (candrike) causing bliss to the lotus of Vrsabhanu’s great (stoma) fame. As the moonlight reveals the night lotus, you reveal the fame of your father.

### Text 17

*apāra-karuṇā-pūra-pūritāntar-mano-hrade \|*  
*prasīdāsmiñ jane devi nija-dāsya-spṛhā-juṣi \|\|17\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**О Radha, whose lake-like heart is filled with unlimited mercy! О devi! Please be merciful to this person who desires to be your servant.**

**Комментарий:**

О merciful Radha whose lake-like heart is filled with a flood of unlimited mercy.

Be merciful to this person (me). The mercy is described: give the mercy of being your servant.

### Text 18

*kaccit tvaṁ cāṭu-paṭunā tena goṣṭhendra-sūnunā \|*  
*prārthyamāna-calāpāṅga-prasādā drakṣyase mayā \|\|18\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**When will I see you, as you give a fickle side glance, which Krsna requests using clever words?**

**Комментарий:**

There is desire for some details in the bestowal of mercy. Kaccit indicates a question according to Halayudha. If the question of details is asked, in response, the author speaks.

When will you be seen by me when Krsna prays with skillful, affectionate words?

You, to whom I am dedicated completely, should remain alone after your angry mood has subsided. Along with sakhis, Krsna will then enter with affectionate words and plead for the mercy of your side glance while you stare at him directly. When will I see you in that mood?

### Text 19

*tvāṁ sādhu mādhavī-puṣpair mādhavena kalāvidā \|*  
*prasādhyamānāṁ svidyantīṁ bījayiṣyāmy ahaṁ kadā \|\|19\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**When will I fan you, perspiring, as Krsna, expert in arts, decorates you with madhavi flowers nicely?**

**Комментарий:**

When will I fan you, who are decorated (prasadhyamanam) with madhavi flowers by Madhava, learned at decorating (kalavida)'! You are perspiring (svidyantim) because of the touch of his hand.

### Text 20

*keli-visraṁsino vakra-keśa-vṛndasya sundari \|*  
*saṁskārāya kadā devi janam etaṁ nidekṣyasi \|\|20\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**О beautiful devi! When will you order me to tidy your crooked hair, disarrayed by pastimes?**

**Комментарий:**

When will you order this person (me) situated nearby, to braid your crooked locks (samskaraya), which have come undone because of playing with Madhava who had decorated you?

### Text 21

*kadā bimboṣṭhi tāmbūlaṁ mayā tava mukhāmbuje \|*  
*arpyamāṇaṁ vrajādhīśa-sūnur ācchidya bhokṣyate \|\|21\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**О bimba-lipped Radha! When will Krsna snatch and eat the betel nut which I have offered to your lotus mouth?**

**Комментарий:**

О Radha with bimba-red lips! Krsna will forcibly snatch the betel nut which I offered to your lotus mouth and eat it. When will you give me the fortune of seeing this pastime?

### Text 22

*vraja-rāja-kumāra-vallabhā-kula-sīmanta-maṇi prasīda me \|*  
*parivāra-gaṇasya te yathā padavī me na davīyasī bhavet \|\|22\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**О Radha, main jewel among all Krsna’s gopis! Be merciful to me so that the path of your associates will not be far from me.**

**Комментарий:**

How will 1 attain such fortune? But still, please make it possible. О you who are the jewel in the simanta of all the gopis of Krsna. Mani means gem or pearl according to Medini. Be merciful to me so that the path of your followers will not be far away, but close.

### Text 23

*karuṇāṁ muhur arthaye paraṁ tava vṛndāvana-cakravartini \|*  
*api keśaripor yathā bhavet sa caṭu-prārthana-bhājanaṁ janaḥ \|\|23\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**О queen of Vrndavana! I beg always only for your mercy so that I may offer skillful prayers to you on behalf of Krsna.**

**Комментарий:**

О empress of Vrndavana! О Radha, who have been coronated to rule Vrndavana! 1 constantly pray only (param) for your mercy so that I am requested by Krsna using affectionate words when he has dissipated your anger by mercy.

Entering without the sakhis or servants, he begs me, “O merciful, beautiful friend! Send my request to Radha.”

The meter of the two verses is sundari, ardha-sama variety.

*ayujoryadi sau jagau yujoḥ sabharālgau yadi sundarī matā*

**It is sundari if in first and third lines there is ssl ssl sis 1 (sa, sa, ja, gu)**

**And in second and fourth lines there is ssl Iss Isl si (sa, bha, ra, la, gu)**

### Text 24

*imaṁ vṛndāvaneśvaryā jano yaḥ paṭhati stavam \|*  
*cāṭu-puṣpāñjaliṁ nāma sa syād asyāḥ kṛpāspadam \|\|24\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**The person who recites these verses for Radha called catu-puspanjali will become the object of her mercy.**

**Комментарий:**

The meaning is clear. One becomes the object of mercy (krpaspadam) of Radha (asyah).

Thus, Catu-puspanjali has been explained.

## gāndharvā-prārthanāṣṭakam

*śrīgāndharvikāyai namaḥ \|*

**Перевод:**

**I offer respects to Gandharva.**

### Text 1

*vṛndāvane viharator iha keli-kuñje*  
*matta-dvipa-pravara-kautuka-vibhrameṇa \|*  
*sandarśayasva yuvayor vadanāravinda-*  
*dvandvaṁ vidhehi mayi devi kṛpāṁ prasīda \|\|1\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**Show the lotus faces of you two playing in Vrndavana in a pastime bower, with joyous abandon, like two intoxicated elephants. О devi! Be merciful to me. Be pleased with me.**

**Комментарий:**

The author prays to Radha, Gandharva, in eight verses. О devi, О Radha! Give mercy to me. That mercy is described. Show the lotus faces of you two. Showing the faces is dependent on you. The couple is described. You both play, with joyous abandon, like two fine, intoxicated elephants in a pastime bower (keli-kunja) in Vrndavana.

### Text 2

*hā devi kāku-bhara-gadgadayādya vācā*  
*yāce nipatya bhuvi daṇḍavad udbhaṭārtiḥ \|*  
*asya prasādam abudhasya janasya kṛtvā*  
*gāndharvike nija-gaṇe gaṇanāṁ vidhehi \|\|2\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**О devi! Falling on the ground like a stick, filled with pain I pray with choked, plaintive words. О Gandharvika! Count me as one of your associates, being merciful to an unintelligent person.**

**Комментарий:**

Ha indicates lamentation according to Haima. О devi! Falling on the ground with choked voice I pray to you with plaintive words. He describes himself. I am filled with pain (udbhatartih).

“What do you ask for?” О Gandharvika! Count me, an ignorant person, as one of your associates.

### Text 3

*śyāme ramā-ramaṇa-sundaratā-variṣṭha-*  
*saundarya-mohita-samasta-jagaj-janasya \|*  
*śyāmasya vāma-bhuja-baddha-tanuṁ kadāhaṁ*  
*tvām indirā-virala-rūpa-bharāṁ bhajāmi \|\|3\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**О Syama! When will I serve you, possessing beauty rare for Laksmi, your body bound by left arm of Krsna, who enchants the whole world by his beauty which exceeds that of Visnu?**

**Комментарий:**

О Syama, Radha! When will I serve (bhajami) you, bound by Krsna’s (sydmasya) left arm. Kada with the present indicates the future according to vibhasa kadarhyoh: The affix lat (present) is optionally employed after a root with the force of the futurity, when it has in construction with it, the adverbs kada and karhi. (Panini Sutras 3.3.5)

Krsna is described. He enchants the whole world by his beauty as a Parabrahman with human form, superior in beauty to Narayana, with four arms, the husband of Laksmi. This is stated in the Tenth Canto:

*gopyastapaḥ kimacaranyadamuṣya rūpaṁ lāvaṇyasāramasamordhvamananyasiddham \|*  
*dṛgbhiḥ pibantyanusavābhinavaṁ durāpamekāntadhāmayaśasaḥ śriya aiśvarasya*

**What austerities must the gopis have performed! With their eyes they always drink the nectar of Lord Krsna’s form, which is the essence of loveliness and is not to be equaled or surpassed. That loveliness is the only abode of beauty, fame and opulence. It is self-perfect, ever fresh and extremely rare. (SB 10.44.14)**

Ananya-siddham means the form exists only in the gopis. Durapam means that their form is rare because they are vilasa, svamsa and kalas (expansions) for Krsna’s pastimes. Radha is described. She has an intense beauty rare for Laksmi. It was already said that her beauty is sought by Laksmi. (Catu-puspanjali 14)

### Text 4

*tvāṁ pracchadena mudira-cchavinā pidhāya*  
*mañjīra-mukta-caraṇāṁ ca vidhāya devi \|*  
*kuñje vrajendra-tanayena virājamāne*  
*naktaṁ kadā pramuditām abhisārayiṣye \|\|4\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**О devi! When will I arrange a meeting for you at night with Krsna in a shining bower, after dressing you in cloth the color of a dark cloud and removing your ankle bells?**

**Комментарий:**

О devi! When at night will I lead you to the bower shining with Krsna? What do I do? I will dress you in cloth the color of a dark cloud (mudira) and take off your ankle bells so that no other person will recognize you.

### Text 5

*kuñje prasūna-kula-kalpita-keli-talpe*  
*saṁviṣṭayor madhura-narma-vilāsa-bhājoḥ \|*  
*loka-trayābharaṇayoś caraṇāmbujāni*  
*saṁvāhayiṣyati kadā yuvayor jano’yam \|\|5\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**When will this person massage the lotus feet of you two who ornament the three worlds, as you partake of sweet, joking pastimes while you lie on a pastime bed made of many flowers in a bower?**

**Комментарий:**

When will this person massage the lotus feet of you two who are resting (samvistayoh) in the bower? The rest is clear.

### Text 6

*tvat-kuṇḍa-rodhasi vilāsa-pariśrameṇa*  
*svedāmbu-cumbi-vadanāmbu-ruha-śriyo vām \|*  
*vṛndāvaneśvari kadā taru-mūla-bhājau*  
*saṁvījayāmi camarī-caya-cāmareṇa \|\|6\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**О queen of Vrndavana! When will I fan you two with a yak tail fan as you sit beneath a tree, beautiful with lotus faces kissed by drops of perspiration, because of exertion in pastimes on the bank of your kunda?**

**Комментарий:**

О queen of Vrndavana! When will I fan you two, situated in a jeweled cottage at the base of a desire tree (taru-mtila-bhajau) on the bank of your pond, with a fan made of creepers? Camara refers to a sprout according to Medini. Others say it refers to a yak tail fan with a jeweled handle. The couple is described. Their beautiful lotus faces are kissed with perspiration because of fatigue from pastimes.

### Text 7

*līnāṁ nikuñja-kuhare bhavatīṁ mukunde*  
*citraiva sūcitavatī rucirākṣi nāham \|*  
*bhugnāṁ bhruvaṁ na racayeti mṛṣāruṣāṁ tvām*  
*agre vrajendra-tanayasya kadā nu neṣye \|\|7\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**When will I bring you in front of Krsna as you feign anger, as you hide within a bower and I say, “Citra hinted to Mukunda, not me, О beautiful eyed Radha! Do not frown at me.”**

**Комментарий:**

For fun you hide in a bower. You were indicated to Krsna by joyful Citra. Pretending to be angry with me for giving indications to Krsna, when will you be brought to Krsna?

### Text 8

*vāg-yuddha-keli-kutuke vraja-rāja-sūnuṁ*  
*jitvonmadām adhika-darpa-vikāsi-jalpām \|*  
*phullābhir ālibhir analpam udīryamāṇa*  
*stotrāṁ kadā nu bhavatīm avalokayiṣye \|\|8\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**When will I see you, praised profusely by joyful sakhis, when you boast in plenty, exalting at defeating Krsna as you eagerly engage in a playful battle of words?**

**Комментарий:**

When will I see you? Radha is described. Having defeated Krsna who received an answer in the pastime of arguing in jest, Radha speaks with great pride and joy (unmadam). The sakhis, with joyful faces, praise her because of her victory.

### Text 9

*yaḥ ko’pi suṣṭhu vṛṣabhānu-kumārikāyāḥ*  
*samprārthanāṣṭakam idaṁ paṭhati prapannaḥ \|*  
*sā preyasā saha sametya dhṛta-pramodā*  
*tatra prasāda-laharīm urarīkaroti \|\|9\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**Radha along with Krsna will be pleased with a surrendered person who recites the eight prayers to her and will agree to bestow a wave of mercy to him.**

**Комментарий:**

The results of reciting the astaka are described. Radha (sd) will spread (urafi karoti) a wave of mercy to that person who, surrendering, recites this astaka prayer, of Radha. She will have Krsna beside her. Great mercy is the result.

Vasanta-tilaka is the meter.

*jñeyaṁ vasantatilakaṁ tabhajā jagau gaḥ*

**Vasanta-tilaka consists of Ils Iss sis sis 11 (ta, bha, ja, ja, gu,gu)**

Thus, Gandharva-prarthanastakam has been explained.

## nāma-yugāṣṭakam

*śrīrādhākṛṣṇābhyāṁ namaḥ \|*

**Перевод:**

**I offer respects to Radha and Krsna.**

### Text 1

*rādhā-mādhavayor etad vakṣye nāma-yugāṣṭakam \|*  
*rādhā-dāmodarau pūrvaṁ rādhikā-mādhavau tataḥ \|\|1\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**I recite eight pairs of names of the couple Radha and Madhava. The first names are Radha-Damodara and then Radha-Madhava.**

**Комментарий:**

The author has praised Krsna and Radha separately. Now he praises them as a pair. He recites their names combined. First there is Radha and Damodara. Then there is Radha and Madhava.

### Text 2

*vṛṣabhānu-kumārī ca tathā gopendra-nandanaḥ \|*  
*govindasya priya-sakhī gāndharvā-bāndhavas tathā \|\|2\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**She is the young daughter of Vrsabhanu, and he is the son of Nanda. She is the dear friend of Govinda, and he is the friend of Gandharva.**

**Комментарий:**

The meaning is clear.

### Text 3

*nikuñja-nāgarau goṣṭha-kiśora-jana-śekharau \|*  
*vṛndāvanādhipau kṛṣṇa-vallabhārādhikā-priyau \|\|3\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**They are the heroine and hero of the bowers. They are the crest jewels among all the youths. They are the rulers of Vrndavana. She is dear to Krsna and he is dear to Radha.**

**Комментарий:**

They are heroine of the bower and the hero of the bower (nikunja-nagarau) following the sutra, puman-striya: when a word in the masculine gender (puman) is conjoined with the same word in the feminine gender (striya) the masculine alone subsists. (Panini Sutras 1.2.67)

They are the head ornaments (sekharau) of all the young men and women cowherds.

Thus, the nama-yugdstaka has been explained.

## vraja-navīna-yuva-dvandvāṣṭakam

*śrīrādhākṛṣṇau jayataḥ \|*

**Перевод:**

**Radha and Krsna remain glorious!**

### Text 1

*adurvidha-vidagdhatāspada-vimugdha-veśa-śriyor*  
*amanda-śikhi-kandharā-kanaka-nindi-vāsas tviṣoḥ \|*  
*sphurat-puraṭa-ketakī-kusuma-vibhramābhra-prabhā*  
*nibhāṅga-mahasor bhaje vraja-navīna-yūnor yugam \|\|1\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**I serve the fresh youthful couple of Vraja, whose attractive beautiful garments are abode of complete cleverness, whose colorful garments deride unlimited peacock necks and gold, whose splendorous limbs are like the beauty of a blossoming golden ketaki flower and the effulgence of a cloud.**

**Комментарий:**

The author praises the couple with an astaka. I serve (.bhaje) the pair of fresh youths of Vraja. Yilnoh refers a young woman and young man. The couple is every fresh (navina). They are described. Their attractive (vimugdha) beauty (vesa-sriyoh) is the abode (aspada) of complete (adurvidha) cleverness (vidagdhata). Durvidha means poor according to Amara-kosa. The color of their garments criticizes a peacock’s neck (sikhi-kandhara) and heaps of gold. They wear blue and yellow cloth. The effulgence of their limbs is like the splendor of a cloud and the brilliance of a blossoming golden ketaki flower. Vibhrama means beauty according to Halayudha. Mahas means brilliance according to Amara-kosa.

### Text 2

*samṛddha-vidhu-mādhurī-vidhuratā-vidhānoddhurair*  
*navāmburuha-ramyatā-mada-viḍambanārambhibhiḥ \|*  
*vilimpad iva karṇakāvali-sahodarair dik-taṭī*  
*mukha-dyuti-bharair bhaje vraja-navīna-yūnor yugam \|\|2\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**I serve the fresh youthful couple of Vraja, whose faces anoint the directions with streaming effulgence, which is equal to abundant unguents, which proudly rivals the sweetness of the full moon, which scolds the pride of the beauty of fresh lotuses.**

**Комментарий:**

Again, he describes them. They seem to anoint the directions with streaming effulgence of their faces. That streaming effulgence is described. It is equal to (sahodaraih) abundant (kavalij kuhkuma and musk ointments (varna). It proudly (uddhuraih) competes with (vidhurata vidhana) the abundant sweetness of the moon. It scorns the pride of new lotuses’ beauty. By the two descriptive phrases the brightness and the blossoming joy of the effulgence of their faces are described.

### Text 3

*vilāsa-kalahoddhati-skhalad-amanda-sindūra-bhāg-*  
*akharva-madanāṅkuśa-prakara-vibrhamair aṅkitam \|*  
*madoddhuram ivobhayor mithunam ullasad-vallarī-*  
*gṛhotsava-rataṁ bhaje vraja-navīna-yūnor yugam \|\|3\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**I serve the fresh youthful couple of Vraja, joyful as a couple of proud elephants, marked plentifully with sindura scattered by their intense quarrels in play, marked with amorous marks from many goads of Cupid, as they absorb themselves in a festival within the creeper bower.**

**Комментарий:**

Again, he describes the couple. They shine like a couple of proud elephants. They are like a female and male elephant. They are colored with plentiful sindura which has been scattered by their intense (uddhati) quarrels in play. They are marked with the pastimes of nail marks of many goads of Cupid. They are absorbed (ratam) in the festival within the creeper bower. The elephants, when fighting, produce marks like those of sindura or a goad.

### Text 4

*ghana-praṇaya-nirjhara-prasara-labdha-pūrter mano*  
*hradasya parivāhitām anusaradbhir asraiḥ plutam \|*  
*sphurat-tanu-ruhāṅkurair nava-kadamba-jṛmbha-śriyaṁ*  
*vrajattad aniśaṁ bhaje vraja-navīna-yūnor yugam \|\|4\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**I constantly serve the fresh youthful couple of Vraja, who are covered with tears entering rivers which flow from their lakelike minds, which are filled with bursting rivers of intense affection, while they display beauty of freshly blossoming kadamas as their trembling hairs stand on end.**

**Комментарий:**

The couple are described with tears of bliss, hairs standing on end. They are covered (plutam) with tears of joy. The tears are described. They enter rivers from the lake of the heart. The lake of the heart is described. It is filled with floods (nirjhara) of their concentrated mutual affection (pranaya). Their hearts are filled with the water of prema. Nirjhara means a river according to Haima. The couple has attained the beauty of blossoming fresh kadambas by the manifestation of trembling hairs standing on end on their bodies.

### Text 5

*anaṅga-raṇa-vibhrame kim api bibhrad-ācāryakaṁ*  
*mithaś cala-dṛg-añcala-dyuti-śalākayā kīlitam \|*  
*jagaty atula-dharmabhir madhura-narmabhis tanvator*  
*mitho vijayitāṁ bhaje vraja-navīna-yūnor yugam \|\|5\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**I serve the fresh youthful couple of Vraja who spread victory over each other by sweet jokes of incomparable qualities in this world, who possess indescribable authority in pastimes of amorous battles, who are pierced by arrows of beauty from the fickle tips of their eyes.**

**Комментарий:**

Their enjoyment is described. I serve the couple of youths (yiinoh). They are described. They spread (tanvatoh) victory over each other by sweet jokes. The jokes are described. The jokes have qualities of puns, etc., which are unequalled in the world.

The couple (yugam) is described. They each possess (bibhrat) indescribable (kim api) authority (acaryakam) in the pastimes of amorous battles. To explain the formation of acaryaha there is the following sutra, ya-upadhad guru-upottamad vun: the affix vun (ha in acaryaha) comes in the sense of “nature or action there of”, after a polysyllabic stem whose penultimate letter is ya and whose penultimate syllable is prosodically heavy. (Panini Sutras 5.1.132) They pierce (kilitam) each other with arrows of beauty of their restless glances.

### Text 6

*adṛṣṭa-cara-cāturī-caṇa-caritra-citrāyitaiḥ*  
*saha praṇayibhir janair vihara-mānayoḥ kānane \|*  
*paraspara-mano-mṛgaṁ śravaṇa-cāruṇā carcarī-*  
*cayena rajayad bhaje vraja-navīna-yūnor yugam \|\|6\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**I serve the fresh youthful couple of Vraja, who play in the forest with their affectionate friends who are amazing with actions famous for cleverness, unseen in this world, and who enjoy the deer of each other’s hearts by various carcari beats, charming to hear.**

**Комментарий:**

Playing in the forest is described. I serve the fresh youthful couple of Vraja. The youths (yiinoh) are described. They play (viharamanayoh) in the forest with Lalita and other friends. These friends are described. They are astonishing (citrayitaih) with famous (сапа) actions which are clever (caturi-cana), and never before seen. Tena vittarii cancup canapau: the affixes cancu and сапа come after a word in the third case in construction, in the sense of‘celebrated through this.’ (Panini Sutras 5.2.26)

The couple (yugam) is described. They enjoy (rajayat) each other’s deer-like heart by various types of carcari beats. They delight the deer of the heart of their lover. Concerning rajayat it is said raftjes ca: the nasal of rafij is also elided before first conjugational vowels. (Panini Sutras 6.4.26)

### Text 7

*maranda-bhara-mandira-prati-navāravindāvali-*  
*sugandhini vihārayor jala-vihāra-visphūrjitaiḥ \|*  
*tape sarasi vallabhe salila-vādya-vidyā-vidhau*  
*vidagdha-bhujayor bhaje vraja-navīna-yūnor yugam \|\|7\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**I serve the fresh youthful couple of Vraja as they play in the summer, manifesting water pastimes at dear Radha-kunda, fragrant with fresh lotuses, abodes of abundant honey, while their arms display skill in the art of producing music by beating the water.**

**Комментарий:**

Water play is described. They play by manifesting (visphiirjitaih) water pastimes at dear (vallabhe) Radha-kunda (sarasi) in the summer season (tape), breaking their garlands. Their arms are skillful at making music by beating the water. The kunda is described. It is fragrant with fresh lotuses which are palaces of abundant honey.

### Text 8

*mṛṣā-vijaya-kāśibhiḥ kalita-cāturīr āśībhir*  
*glahasya haraṇaṁ haṭhāt prakaṭayadbhir uccair girā \|*  
*tad-akṣa-kali-dakṣayoḥ kalita-pakṣayoḥ sākṣibhiḥ*  
*kulaiḥ sva-suhṛdāṁ bhaje vraja-navīna-yūnor yugam \|\|8\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**I serve the fresh youthful couple of Vraja, skillful at quarrelling while gambling, surrounded by their friends who act as witnesses and who claim false victory with great cleverness, with loud words while suddenly grabbing the wager.**

**Комментарий:**

Their gambling is described. The youths (yUnoh) are described. They are skillful (ddksayoh) at quarrelling while gambling (aksa-kali). At their sides are the groups of witnesses of their friends, Lalita, Madhumahgala, etc. Those groups are described. They make cries of false victory (mrsa-vijaya-kasibhih). Vijaya-kasi means proclaiming victory according to Amara-kosa. They manifest loud words while suddenly grabbing the wager established in the match, such as a necklace.

### Text 9

*idaṁ valita-tuṣṭayaḥ paripaṭhanti padyāṣṭakaṁ*  
*dvayor guṇa-vikāśi ye vraja-navīna-yūnor janāḥ \|*  
*muhur navanavodayāṁ praṇaya-mādhurīm etayor*  
*avāpya nivasanti te pada-saroja-yugmāntike \|\|9\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**Those who, with satisfaction, recite this astaka revealing qualities of the fresh young couple of Vraja, attaining the couple’s sweet affection, which constantly manifests ever freshly, remain close to their lotus feet.**

**Комментарий:**

The result of reciting the astaka is described. Those who recite this astaka revealing qualities (guna-vikasi) of the fresh young couple of Vraja, remain close to their lotus feet. The rest is clear.

### Text 10

*koṇenākṣṇoḥ pṛthu-ruciḥ mitho hāriṇā lihyamānāv*  
*ekaikena pracura-pulakenopaguḍhau bhujena \|*  
*gaurī-śyāmau vasana-yugalaṁ śyāma-gauraṁ vasānau*  
*rādhā-kṛṣṇau smara-vilasitoddāma-tṛṣṇau smarāmi \|\|10\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**I meditate on Radha and Krsna, intensely thirsty for pastimes of love, who lick each other with the attractive corner of their eyes with great relish, who embrace each other using one attractive arm, with hairs standing on end intensely, who wear yellow and blue clothing, who are covered with black and gold complexions.**

**Комментарий:**

Meditation on the couple, following the meaning of the eight verses, is explained in one verse. They experience each other’s beauty. They are covered (vasanau) with black and gold. Vasa means a covering. It belongs to the second class of roots. The rest is clear. They lick each other by the attractive (harina) corner (konena) of their eyes, with great relish (prthu-rucih).

Thus, Vraja-navina-yuva-dvandvastaka has been explained.

## kārpaṇya-pañjikā-stotram

*śrīvṛndāvaneśau jayataḥ \|*

**Перевод:**

**The two rulers of Vrndavana remain victorious.**

### Text 1

*tiṣṭhan vṛndāṭavī-kuñje vijñaptiṁ vidadhāty asau \|*  
*vṛndāṭavīśayoḥ pāda-padmeṣu kṛpano janaḥ \|\|1\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**This miserable person, remaining in the bower of Vrndavana, makes a request to the lotus feet of the ruling couple of Vrndavana.**

*namo bhavaka-bhupaya sri-rupaya dayalave \|*  
*kdrpanya-panjika-duhkha-bhanjika labhyateyatah \|\|*

**I offer respects to Sri-Rupa, the king of affection, the abode of mercy from whom the Karpany a-panjika. which destroys suffering is obtained.**

The author pleases the couple by an offering of humility. This miserable person (krpanah) remaining in the bower of Vrndavana, makes a request to the lotus feet of the ruling couple of Vrndavana. Krpana means a suffering person according to Dhananjaya. This plea made by me, suffering, situated at the edge of the dhama, should be heard by the couple. It is well known that those who are rulers or controllers hear the pleas of suffering people who shout near their palace.

### Text 2

*navendīvara-sandoha-saundaryāskandana-prabham \|*  
*cāru-gorocanā-garva-gaurava-grāsi-gaurabhām \|\|2\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**This person prays to you whose blue complexion dries up the beauty of a group of fresh blue lotuses and whose golden complexion devours the great pride of attractive gorocana.**

**Комментарий:**

Nine verses are connected. О controller of Vrndavana! О queen of Vrndavana! This person prays to you two. The two, being the object of his prayer, are described, each with a line of each verse.

His blue complexion (prabham) dries up the beauty of a group of fresh blue lotuses. Her golden complexion devours (grasi) the great pride of attractive gorocana.

### Text 3

*śātakumbha-kadamba-śrī-viḍambi-sphurad-ambaram \|*  
*haratā kiṁśukasyāṁśūn aṁśukena virājitām \|\|3\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**This person prays to you whose shining cloth derides the beauty of golden kadambas, to you who shine with cloth that derides the rays of the kimsuka flower.**

**Комментарий:**

Satakumbha means gold. Ambaram is cloth. She shines (virajitam) with cloth that criticizes (harata) the rays of the kimsuka flower (red). Her cloth is red.

### Text 4

*sarva-kaiśoravad-vṛnda-cūḍārūḍha-harin-maṇim \|*  
*goṣṭhāśeṣa-kiśorīṇāṁ dhammillottaṁsa-mallikām \|\|4\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**This person prays to you who are the emerald atop the head of all young men of Vraja and to you who are the jasmine crown in the hair of unlimited girls of Vraja.**

**Комментарий:**

This person prays to you who are the emerald (harin-manim) atop the head of all young men (kaisoravat) of Vraja. The rest is clear.

### Text 5

*śrīśa-mukhyātma-rūpāṇāṁ rūpātiśayi-vigraham \|*  
*ramojjvala-vraja-vadhū-vraja-vismāpi-sauṣṭhavām \|\|5\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**This person prays to you whose beauty is supreme among all the appearances of your forms headed by Narayana, and to you whose excellence of form qualities and activities astonishes all the most attractive women of Vraja, who shine like Laksmi.**

**Комментарий:**

You are the form, two-armed and performing human pastimes whose beauty is supreme among all the appearances of your forms headed by Narayana with four arms, who performs pastimes as the Supreme Lord.

*gopyas tapah him acaran yad amusya rupam*  
*lavanya-saram asamordhvam ananya-siddham*  
*drgbhih pibanty anusavabhinavam durapam*  
*ekanta-dhama yasasah sriya aisvarasya*

**What austerities must the gopis have performed! With their eyes they always drink the nectar of Lord Krsna’s form, which is the essence of loveliness and is not to be equaled or surpassed. That loveliness is the only abode of beauty, fame and opulence. It is self-perfect, ever fresh and extremely rare. (SB 10.44.14)**

The glory of Radha’s form, qualities and actions (sausthavam) astonishes the groups of exceedingly beautiful women of Vraja such as Candravali, who are brilliant like Laksmi.

### Text 6

*saurabhya-hṛta-gāndharvaṁ gandhonmādita-mādhavām \|*  
*rādhā-rodhana-vaṁśīkaṁ mahatī-mohitācyutām \|\|6\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**This person prays to you who attract Radha by your fragrance, and to you who intoxicate Madhava by your fragrance. This person prays to you whose flute stuns Radha and to you whose vina enchants Krsna.**

**Комментарий:**

You attracted Radha (gandharva) by your fragrance. Radha drives Krsna insane (unmadita) by her fragrance. Your flute stuns Radha. Radha enchants Krsna by her vina playing (mahati).

### Text 7

*rādhā-dhṛti-dhana-stena-locanāñcala-cāpalam \|*  
*dṛg-añcala-kalā-bhṛṅgī-daṣṭa-kṛṣṇa-hṛd-ambujām \|\|7\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**This person prays to you, whose fickle side glance steals the wealth of Radha’s composure, and to you, whose bee-like side glance bites Krsna’s lotus heart.**

**Комментарий:**

Your fickle side glance steals the wealth of Radha’s composure. The bee (bhrngi) of Radha’s side glance bites the lotus heart of Krsna. Krsna’s heart is pierced by her side glance.

### Text 8

*rādhā-gūḍha-parīhāsa-prauḍhi-nirvacanī-kṛtam \|*  
*vrajendra-suta-narmokti-romāñcita-tanū-latām \|\|8\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**This person prays to you, who cannot answer when Radha boldly utters profound jokes, and to you whose creeper-like body horripilates from Krsna’s jokes.**

**Комментарий:**

You cannot answer Radha’s boldness in profound jokes. This will be seen in Dana-keli-kaumudi. The rest is clear.

### Text 9

*divya-sad-guṇa-māṇikya-śreṇī-rohaṇa-parvatam \|*  
*umādi-ramaṇī-vyūha-spṛhaṇīya-guṇotkarām \|\|9\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**This person prays to you, who are Rohana Mountain, filled with rubies of attractive, virtuous qualities, and to you who are a heap of qualities desired by a host of woman like Uma.**

**Комментарий:**

You are a Rohana mountain composed of many rubies of attractive, virtuous qualities. Rohana is the name of a mountain, where when it thunders, jewels increase in quantity. Thus, when devotees praise the Lord his qualities increase.

*ananta-halyana-gundtmako ’sau*

**The Lord has the unlimited auspicious qualities. (Visnu Purana)**

*ime cānye ca bhagavannityā yatra mahāguṇāḥ*

**The Lord has many other eternal, great qualities. (SB 1.16.29)**

Radha has many qualities desired by a host of women such Uma, Siva’s wife.

*durgārādhyā ramārādhyā*

**Radha is worshipped by Durga. Radha is worshipped by Laksmi.**

*sarasvatīśā durgeśā*

**Radha controls Sarasvati. Radha controls Durga.**

*ananta-guṇa-saṁpannā*

**Radha is endowed with unlimited qualities. (Radhd-sahasra-nama-stotra, Naradiya Purana)**

### Text 10

*tvāṁ ca vṛndāvanādhīśa tvāṁ ca vṛndāvaneśvari \|*  
*kākubhir vandamāno'yaṁ mandaḥ prārthayate janaḥ \|\|10\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**O controller of Vrndavana, Krsna! O queen of Vnidavana, Radha! This ignorant person offering respects to you Krsna and to you Radha, prays with voice distorted by lamentation.**

**Комментарий:**

O controller of Vrndavana, Krsna! O queen of Vrndavana, Radha! This ignorant person offering respects (yandamanah) to you Krsna and to you Radha, prays with voice distorted by lamenation (kakubhih). Kaku means distortion of sound because of lamentation or fear according to Amara-kosa. These ten verses together are a kulaka.

*dvabhyam yugmakamity uktam tribhistu syad visesakam \|*  
*kalapakam caturbhis tu sandanitakam ucyate \|*  
*pancabhih kulakam tuktarn padyaih pancadhikair budhaih \|\|*

**Two verses connected together grammatically are called yugmaka. Three verses together are called visesaka. Four verses together are called sandanitaka. Five or more verses together are called kulaka.**

### Text 11

*yogyatā me na kācid vāṁ kṛpā-lābhāya yady api \|*  
*mahā-kṛpālu-maulitvāt tathāpi kurutaṁ kṛpām \|\|11\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**Though I am not at all qualified to receive your mercy, give mercy, since you are the best of those endowed with a wealth of mercy.**

**Комментарий:**

Describing the couple equal in attractive form and qualities, the author prays to them. Though I have no qualification at all for receiving the mercy of you two (yam), you should be merciful. The reason is given. Those who are full of mercy, wealthy with mercy, are seen to be merciful to lame or deaf persons. What to speak of you two who are the chief (mauli) among all merciful people?

### Text 12

*ayogye'py aparādhe'pi dṛśyante kṛpayākulāḥ \|*  
*mahā-kṛpālavo hanta loke lokeśa-vanditau \|\|12\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**The most merciful are seen in this world to be most merciful even to unqualified and offensive people! О Radha and Krsna, worshipped by kings!**

**Комментарий:**

You are not only unqualified but are an offender. So how we can be merciful to you?”

Those who are greatly merciful are seen in this world to be filled with mercy. О you two, who are worshipped by kings!

### Text 13

*bhakter vāṁ karuṇā-hetor leśābhāso'pi nāsti me \|*  
*mahā-līleśca-ratayā tad apy atra prasīdatam \|\|13\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**I do not have even a reflection of a particle of bhakti, the cause of your mercy, but be merciful to me since you are performers of great pastimes.**

**Комментарий:**

“Our mercy is given because of bhakti. But you are devoid of bhakti. How can we give mercy to you?”

I do not have a reflection of a particle (lesdbhasah) of bhakti, the cause of your mercy. That is true, but, still, be merciful to me. The cause is given. You are the performers of great pastimes. The rain falls on both the friendly and the indifferent persons.

### Text 14

*jane duṣṭe'py abhakte'pi prasīdanto vilokitāḥ \|*  
*mahā-līlā-maheśāś ca hā nāthau bahavo bhuvi \|\|14\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**Many great controllers and persons with great pastimes are seen on this earth to be merciful to persons who are wicked and not devotees. О my two masters!**

**Комментарий:**

“The wealthy person or king, who is ignorant is merciful to the sinful and the offender, though they should be punished. But the intelligent Lord does not act in this way.”

The first part is clear. Many persons performing great pastimes and many great controllers are seen to be merciful. Siva was pleased with the kirata named Baija who offered a few drops of water. Siva gave him great benedictions and became famous by that name. A person entered a Siva temple to steal and lit a lamp to see the wealth. Pleased by that act, Siva gave him benedictions so that he became Kuvera. Siva pleased with the asuras, burned them by the fire of his anger, and bestowed on them Svarga. Great pastimes of the devatas on earth are seen. What to speak of you two the supreme devas?

### Text 15

*adhamo'py uttamaṁ matvā svam ajñe'pi manīṣiṇam \|*  
*śiṣṭaṁ duṣṭo'py ayaṁ jantur mantuṁ vyadhita yadyapi \|\|15\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**Even though, being the lowest but considering myself to be the highest, and though ignorant, considering myself to be wise, this living being has committed an offense.**

**Комментарий:**

“The devatas quickly give mercy to you while not looking closely. But we two give mercy while looking for a little bhakti and do not give it indiscriminately. That is our nature. You do not have even a speck of bhakti."

While admitting his offenses, speaking of his bhakti, he begs for mercy in two verses. This living being (ayam jantuh), though low (adhamah), thinks himself (svam) supreme. Though he is ignorant, he thinks himself to be full of knowledge, and though he is wicked, he thinks himself to be righteous, even though he has committed this offense (mantum). Showing himself in an assembly of devotees to be the highest, when he is the lowest, etc., is a great offense.

### Text 16

*tathāpy asmin kadācid vām adhīśau nāma-jalpini \|*  
*avadya-vṛnda-nistāri-nāmābhāsau prasīdatam \|\|16\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**Still, be merciful at some time to this person. О two lords, whose namabhasa delivers a host of low people!**

**Комментарий:**

Still you two (yam) should be merciful to this person (asmin). О two lord (adhisau)! He describes himself. He sometimes chants your names (nama-jalpini). They are described. Their Namabhasa delivers a host of persons with bad qualities (avadya).

*koṭimuktisukhā saumyā*

**Radha has more bliss than that of a million liberations. She is cheerful.**

*sarvaduḥkhapraśamanī*

**Radha destroys all suffering. . (Radha-sahasra-nama-stotra, Naradiya Purana)**

*govindeti tathā proktaṁ bhaktyā vā bhaktivarjitaiḥ \|*  
*dahate sarvapāpāni yugāntāgnirivotthitaḥ \|\|*

**Chanting “Govinda” with or without bhakti destroys all sins like the fire at the end of the yuga. (Skanda Purana)**

### Text 17

*yad akṣamyaṁ nu yuvayoḥ sakṛd-bhakti-lavād api \|*  
*tad-āgaḥ kvāpi nāsty eva kṛtvāśāṁ prārthaye tataḥ \|\|17\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**Since by a particle of bhakti offered once to you, unforgivable offense is destroyed, I pray with that hope.**

**Комментарий:**

“You are an offender. What is your atonement?”

From just one having a particle of bhakti to you two, the unforgivable offense (aksamyam agah) does not exist at all. With that hope (krtvasam), I pray to you.

### Text 18

*hanta klībo'pi jīvo'yaṁ nītaḥ kaṣṭena dhṛṣṭatām \|*  
*muhuḥ prārthayate nāthau prasādaḥ ko'py udañcatu \|\|18\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**This living being, though weak, has become bold because of intense suffering. Constantly he prays. O lords! May some mercy arise for this person.**

**Комментарий:**

“Why do you, devoid of sadhana, desire us, who are hard to see, like an earthling desiring the moon and stars?”

Hanta indicates lamentation according to Visva.

This living being (jlvah), weak (kllbah), which means devoid of strength of sadhana, has become bold because of intense pain of samsara. Constantly he prays to you two to attain relief from his suffering. O masters (nathau)! Kliba means unmanly and kastam means intense suffering according to Haima. The pain cannot be destroyed without mercy. Thus, may there arise (udancatu) mercy of you unto this jiva!

### Text 19

*eṣa pāpī rudann uccair ādāya radanais tṛṇam \|*  
*hā nāthau nātheti prāṇī sīdaty atra prasīdatam \|\|19\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**This sinful living entity crying loudly, placing grass in his teeth, prays to you two Lords. Be merciful to this suffering entity.**

**Комментарий:**

He speaks with great humility. “This sinful living entity (papi prani) loudly crying, placing grass in his teeth, begs (ndthati) you two lords (ndthau). Be merciful to this suffering entity (sidaty atra)”

### Text 20

*hāhā-rāvam asau kurvan durbhago bhikṣate janaḥ \|*  
*etāṁ me śṛṇutaṁ kākuṁ kākuṁ śṛṇutam īśvarau \|\|20\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**This unfortunate person calling out in sorrow, begs you two. Please hear my cry. Please hear my cry. О my lords!**

**Комментарий:**

This unfortunate person calling out in sorrow (hdhd-ravam), begs you two. Hdhd indicates sorrow according to Visva. What does he request? Hear my words (hdhum srnutam). Be merciful. He repeats his words because of his pain and confusion. This is so in the next verse also. О two lords (Isvarau)!

### Text 21

*yāce phutkṛtya phutkṛtya hā hā kākubhir ākulaḥ \|*  
*prasīdatam ayogye'pi jane'smin karuṇārṇavau \|\|21\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**Filled with misery, I request, calling out in plaintive words with distress. О oceans of mercy! Be merciful to this unqualified person.**

**Комментарий:**

Filled with misery, I request (ydce), calling out in plaintive words with distress. The rest is clear.

### Text 22

*krośaty ārta-svarair āsye nyasyāṅguṣṭham asau janaḥ \|*  
*kurutaṁ kurutaṁ nāthau karuṇā-kaṇikām api \|\|22\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**This person, placing thumb to his mouth, shouts in a voice of pain. О lords! Give a particle of mercy. Give just a particle of mercy.**

**Комментарий:**

This person, placing thumb to his mouth, shouts in a voice of pain. The rest is clear.

### Text 23

*vāceha dīnayā yāce sākrandam ati-manda-dhīḥ \|*  
*kirataṁ karuṇa-svāntau karuṇormi-cchaṭām api \|\|23\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**Being most foolish, I plead in a miserable voice to you two while crying. Splash a multitude of waves of mercy upon me, О lords with merciful hearts!**

**Комментарий:**

Being most foolish, I plead in a miserable voice (dlnaya vaca) to you two while crying. Splash a multitude of waves of mercy upon me. О persons with merciful hearts (karuna-svdntau)!

### Text 24

*madhurāḥ santi yāvanto bhāvāḥ sarvatra cetasaḥ \|*  
*tebhyo'pi prema-madhuraṁ prasādī-kurutaṁ nijam \|\|24\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**There are many situations dear to the heart in the spiritual world. But please give prema for yourselves, dearer than these.**

**Комментарий:**

Establishing his relationship with the couple, he begs for service in prema in three verses. First, he begs for prema in one verse. Service is attractive to the servant because of prema, as hunger is for enjoying food. Everywhere in your eternal abodes (sarvatra), the many situations (bhava), such as salokya, etc., or enjoyable objects like taste and smell, are dear (madhura) to the heart. Give prema directed to you (nijam) which is dearer than these. Being pleased, give it. Bhava means vibhiitis or outstanding elements in action, pastimes and objects according to Medini.

### Text 25

*sevām evādya vāṁ devāv īhe  kiñcana nāparam \|*  
*prasādābhimukhau hanta bhavantau bhavatāṁ mayi \|\|25\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**О lord! I desire only service and nothing else. Please be inclined to give mercy to me.**

**Комментарий:**

“Accept the prosperity of our planet from us since we are pleased. Why ask for our prema?”

О lords, Radhika and Madhava (devau)\\ I desire only service (sevam eva ihe) and nothing else (aparam). May you be inclined to award mercy of service to me. Hanta indicates joy.

### Text 26

*nāthitaṁ param evedam anātha-jana-vatsalau \|*  
*svaṁ sākṣād-dāsyam evāsmin prasādī-kurutaṁ jane \|\|26\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**О Radha and Krsna, affectionate to those having no shelter! I request only this. Please give to this person direct service to you.**

**Комментарий:**

Out of great respect to service, he begs again. О Lords affectionate to persons without shelter (anatha-jana-vatsalau)! Though you are eager to give me all wealth, only this is requested (nathitam) by me. What is this? Please bestow to this person, me, service to your limbs (svam saksat dasyam). Prasadam means giving. Prema seva is the highest bliss. It is the highest human goal since it relates to you. It should be given by you two, who are most generous.

### Text 27

*añjaliṁ mūrdhni vinyasya dīno'yaṁ bhikṣate janaḥ \|*  
*asya siddhir abhīṣṭasya sakṛd apy upapādyatām \|\|27\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**Placing his hands on his head, this miserable person begs. Once only, may this attainment desired by this person be fulfilled by you.**

**Комментарий:**

He clarifies the special results from direct service. The attainment (siddhih) desired by this person should be given by you two.

### Text 28

*amalo vāṁ parimalaḥ kadā parimalan vane \|*  
*anargheṇa pramodena ghrāṇaṁ me ghūrṇayiṣyati \|\|28\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**When will your pure fragrance, pervading the forest, intoxicate my nose with priceless delight?**

**Комментарий:**

The author expresses his desire in five verses (28-33). When will your pure fragrance, pervading the forest, intoxicate my nose with priceless joy? Parimala means fragrance according to Visvalocana.

### Text 29

*rañjayisyati karṇau me haṁsa-guñjita-gañjanam \|*  
*mañjulaṁ kiṁ nu yuvayor mañjīra-kala-siñjitam \|\|29\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**Will the sweet jingling of your ankle bells, which shames the warbling of swans, give delight to my ears?**

**Комментарий:**

Will the sweet jingling ofyour ankle bells (manjlra-kala-sinjitam) give delight to my ears?

### Text 30

*saubhāgyāṅka-rathāṅgādi-lakṣitāni padāni vām \|*  
*kadā vṛndāvane paśyann unmadiṣyaty ayaṁ janaḥ \|\|30\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**When will this person become intoxicated on seeing your footprints marked with auspicious signs like the wheel?**

**Комментарий:**

Seeing the feet of you two in Vrndavana, when will this person become intoxicated (unmadisyati). The feet are described. They are known (laksitani) by auspicious signs such as the wheel.

### Text 31

*sarva-saundarya-maryādā-nīrājya-pada-nīrajau \|*  
*kim apūrvāṇi parvāṇi hā mamākṣṇor vidhāsyatha \|\|31\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**О couple whose lotus feet are worshipped by the limit of all beauty! Will you produce festivals previously unexperienced to my eyes?**

**Комментарий:**

O couple whose lotus feet (pada-nirajau) are worshipped by the limit of all beauty! Will you produce (vidhasyatha) festivals (parvani) previously unexperienced (apurvani) to my eyes?

### Text 32

*sucirāśā-phalābhoga-padāmbhoja-vilokanau \|*  
*yuvāṁ sākṣāj-janasyāsya bhavetām iha kiṁ bhave \|\|32\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**In this person’s birth, will you two, the sight of whose lotus feet are the long-cherished fulfillment of a goal, become directly visible?**

**Комментарий:**

In the birth (bhave) of this person, me, will you two become directly visible (saksat)? Seeing the lotus feet of you two produces the fulfillment (abhoga) of results, which I have desired for a long time. Abhoga means fullness according to Amara-kosa.

### Text 33

*kadā vṛndāṭavī-kuñja-kandare sundarodayau \|*  
*khelantau vāṁ vilokiṣye suratau nātidūrataḥ \|\|33\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**When will I see nearby you two, most merciful and beautiful, playing in the caves and bowers of Vrndavana?**

**Комментарий:**

When will I see nearby (natiduratah) you two playing in the caves and bowers of Vrndavana? The bowers and caves though separate places for playing, are listed together. They are merciful (suratau). Surata means merciful according to Amara-kosa.

### Text 34

*gurvāyattatayā kvāpi durlabhānyonya-vīkṣaṇau \|*  
*mithaḥ sandeśa-sīdhubhyāṁ nandayiṣyāmi vāṁ kadā \|\|34\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**When will I delight you two, who sometimes have difficulty in meeting because of caution concerning elders, by delivering sweet messages?**

**Комментарий:**

When will I delight you two (vam) by sweet messages exchanged between you (mithah)? The couple is described. They sometimes find it hard to see each other because of caution concerning elders. Krsna sometimes is cautious of elders on occasions like his birth celebration.

### Text 35

*gaveṣayantāv anyo'nyaṁ kadā vṛndāvanāntare \|*  
*saṅgamayya yuvāṁ lapsye hāriṇaṁ pāritoṣikam \|\|35\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**When will I receive an attractive reward after bringing you two together when you search for each other in the forest?**

**Комментарий:**

When will I obtain an attractive (harinam) reward (paritosikam), something given out of satisfaction, such as a necklace jewel by bringing you together as you search for each other in the forest?

### Text 36

*paṇīkṛta-mitho-hāra-luñcana-vyagra-hastayoḥ \|*  
*kaliṁ dyūte vilokiṣye kadā vāṁ jita-kāśinoḥ \|\|36\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**When will I see you quarreling while gambling, each claiming victory, each trying to grab the necklace as a prize?**

**Комментарий:**

When will I see the quarrel (kalim) of you two when gambling? They are described. Each claims victory (jita-kasinoh). Jitakasi means claiming victory. The rest is clear.

### Text 37

*kuñje kusuma-śayyāyāṁ kadā vām arpitāṅgayoḥ \|*  
*pāda-saṁvāhanaṁ hanta jano'yaṁ racayiṣyati \|\|37\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**When will this person massage the feet of you two while you rest on a flower bed in a bower?**

**Комментарий:**

Arpitangayoh means sleeping. Racayisyati means “do.”

### Text 38

*kandarpa-kalahodghaṭṭa-truṭitānāṁ latā-gṛhe \|*  
*kadā gumphāya hārāṇāṁ bhavantau māṁ niyokṣyataḥ \|\|38\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**When will you two order me to string necklaces which have been broken, put in disarray during love quarrels?**

**Комментарий:**

When will you two (bhavantau) order me (niyoksayatah) to string necklaces which have been broken (trutitanam) put in disarray (udghatta) during love quarrels? Ghatta means moving about.

### Text 39

*keli-kallola-visrastān hanta vṛndāvaneśvarau \|*  
*karhi barhi-patatrair vāṁ maṇḍayiṣyāmi kuntalān \|\|39\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**О two lords of Vrndavana! When will I decorate your locks, which have come undone by great waves of pastimes, with peacock feathers?**

**Комментарий:**

О two lords of Vnidavana (ynidavanesvaraujl When will 1 decorate your locks which have come undone by great waves of pastimes (keli-kallola), with peacock feathers?

### Text 40

*kandarpa-keli-pāṇḍitya-khaṇḍitākalpayor aham \|*  
*kadā vām alika-dvandvaṁ kariṣye tilakojjvalam \|\|40\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**When will I make your two foreheads bright with tilaka, since you have destroyed the ornaments by your expertise in amorous play?**

**Комментарий:**

When will I make your two foreheads bright with tilaka, since the decoration (akalpayoh) has been destroyed by your expertise in amorous play? Akalpa means decoration.

### Text 41

*devoras te vana-sragbhir dṛśau te devi kajjalaiḥ \|*  
*ayaṁ janaḥ kadā kuñja-maṇḍape maṇḍayiṣyati \|\|41\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**О Krsna! When will this person decorate your chest with forest garlands? О Radha! When will this person decorate your eyes with collyrium?**

**Комментарий:**

O lord (deva)! When will this person decorate your chest (uras) with forest garlands? O devi (Radha)! When will this person decorate your eyes with collyrium?

### Text 42

*jāmbūnadābha-tāmbūlī-parṇāny-avadalayya vām \|*  
*vadanāmbujayor eṣa nidhāsyati janaḥ kadā \|\|42\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**Tearing golden betel nut leaves, when will this person place betel in your lotus mouths?**

**Комментарий:**

Tearing (avadalayya) golden (jambhunada) betel nut leaves (parnani), when will this person place (nidhasyati) them in your lotus mouths. This means to prepare betel nuts for eating.

### Text 43

*kvāsau duṣkṛta-karmāhaṁ kva vām abhyarthanedṛśī \|*  
*kiṁ vā kaṁ vā na yuvayor unmādayati mādhurī \|\|43\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**What is the position of me, committer of despicable actions? What is the position of such requests that I make? But, will not your sweetness drive any person insane?**

**Комментарий:**

Praying for the rare boon that he desires, seeing his lack of qualification, he speaks.

What is this person who has performed despicable actions? What are such special requests made to you? It is hard to combine these two elements. “Why do you request this?” How can your sweetness not intoxicate any person? Everyone becomes intoxicated. Thus, there is no fault on my part.

### Text 44

*yayā vṛndāvane jantur anarho'py eṣa vāsyate \|*  
*tayaiva kṛpayā nāthau siddhiṁ kurutam īpsitam \|\|44\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**By what mercy, this person, though undeserving, lives in Vrndavana, O lords! By that same mercy, you should fulfill my desire.**

**Комментарий:**

Praising their sweetness, he speaks while smiling. By the mercy of chanting your names (yaya), this person lives in Vrndavana. О lords (nathau)! By that, you should fulfill my desire.

### Text 45

*kārpaṇya-pañjikām etāṁ sadā vṛndāṭavī-naṭau \|*  
*giraiva jalpato'py asya jantoḥ sidhyatu vāñchitam \|\|45\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**О lords of Vrndavana! For the person who just chants by words this Karpanya-panjika constantly, may the desired result be attained!**

**Комментарий:**

One should attain prema just by reciting this stotra. Karpanya-panjika means that work by which humility is spread (panjyate). It belongs to the prsodaradi class. Panjika means a booklet that explains words according to Haima. О lords of Vrndavana! For the person who always chants by words what to speak of considering the meaning by his mind, the desired result (vanchitam), your mercy, should be attained.

*stotre ye'sminnalaṁkārāḥ santi dhīpūrvakānate \|*  
*kaṇṭhe sthitā girāṁ devī tatprakāśayatūdyatā \|\|*  
*kārpaṇyapañjikābhāṣyaṁ vidyābhūṣaṇavarṇitam \|*  
*saṁpaśyanto bhaviṣyanti vaiṣṇavā drutacetasaḥ \|\|*

In this stotra there are ornaments which diligent Sarasvati situated in my throat should reveal. The devotees, studying the Karpanya-panjika as described by Vidyabhusana, will have their hearts melt.

Thus, Karpanya-pahjika-stotra has been explained.

## utkalikā-vallariḥ

### 1

*śrī vṛndāṭavīnā-garābhyāṁ namaḥ \|*

**Перевод:**

**I offer respects to the clever couple of Vrndavana.**

### 2

*āsīd yasmād utkalikā-vallarir eṣā karkaśa-citta-grāva nitānta druti-hetuḥ \|*  
*śrī-rādhā-govinda-padābja-vrata-dāyī sa śrī-rūpo bhāvaka-bhūpo dayatāṁ naḥ \|\|*

**Перевод:**

**Since Utakalika-vallari was the cause of melting this stone of rough heart, may Rupa, king of the bhavakas, who bows at the lotus feet of Radha and Govinda, be merciful to us.**

**Комментарий:**

The stotra states that the humble devotee having revealed his lack of qualification to attain the Lord, with heart melted out of longing for his desired goal, not yet attained, falls down crying with a river of tears. The author first admits his condition to himself.

### Text 1

*prapadya vṛndāvana-madhyam ekaḥ*  
*krośann asāv utkalikākulātmā \|*  
*udghāṭayāmi jvalataḥ kaṭhorāṁ*  
*bāṣpasya mudrāṁ hṛdi mudritasya \|\|1\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**Alone, my heart filled with longing, attaining the middle of Vrndavana, loudly shouting in pain, I reveal the heap of scars from blazing tears impressed on my heart.**

**Комментарий:**

One person alone (ekah), I, my heart (atma) filled with longing (utkalikakula), attaining the middle of Vrndavana, loudly shouting in pain (krosan), reveal (udghatayami) the heap of scars from blazing tears impressed on the heart. This state certainly bestows the goal for the devotee.

*kathaṁ vinā romaharṣe dravatā cetasā vinā \|*  
*vinānandāśrukalayā śuddhyedbhaktyā vināśaya*

**Without bhakti how can the heart melt? Without melting of the heart, how can one’s hairs stand on end and tears come to the eyes? Without hair standing on end and tears in the eyes how can the consciousness become purified? (SB 11.14.23)**

The meter is seen later in the work. It is not described for fear of increasing the length of the commentary.

### Text 2

*aye vṛndāraṇya tvaritam iha te sevana-parāḥ*  
*parām āpuḥ ke vā na kila paramānanda-padavīm \|*  
*ato nīcair yāce svayam adhipayor īkṣaṇa-vidher*  
*vareṇyāṁ me cetasy upadiśa diśaṁ hā kuru kṛpām \|\|2\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**О Vrndavana! What persons absorbed in your service did not quickly attain the path of supreme bliss? Thus, with humility I request that you personally show the best way to see your two rulers in my heart. Please be merciful to me.**

**Комментарий:**

First, he prays for Vrndavana as his shelter. Aye indicates lamentation according to Haima. О Vrndavana (vrndaranya^. Which persons absorbed in your service (sevana-parah) did not quickly attain the path of supreme bliss? They all attained it. Because of this (atah), being most humble (nicaih) 1 request you. “What do you request?” Personally, show the best way to see Radha and Madhava (adhipayoh) in my heart. Be merciful to me.

### Text 3

*tavāraṇye devi dhruvam iha murāripor viharate*  
*sadā preyasyeti śrutir api virauti smṛtir api \|*  
*iti jñātvā vṛnde caraṇam abhivande tava kṛpāṁ*  
*kuruṣva kṣipraṁ me phalatu nitarāṁ tarṣa-viṭapī \|\|3\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**О Vrnda! Murari plays always with his beloved and her friends in your forest. Sruti proclaims this. Discerning this, I offer respects to your feet. Be merciful to me. May the tree of my thirst bear fruit.**

**Комментарий:**

He then prays to Vrnda, the deity of Vrndavana. O Vrnda (devi)l Murari plays always with his beloved and her friends in your forest. Sruti proclaims this (yirauti).

*gokulākhye māthuramaṇḍale vṛndāvana-madhye sahasra-dala-padma-madhye kalpa-taror mule asta-dala-kesare govindo ’pi syamah pitambaro dvibhujo mayura-puccha-siro venu-vetra-hasto nirgunah saguno nirakarah sdka.ro nirihah sacesto vivajate I dve pdrsve candravali radhika ca*

**In the place called Gokula, within Vrndavana within Mathura district, within a thousand petelled lotus, at the base of a desire tree amidst the filaments of the eight petalled lotus resides Govinda, dark in complexion, wearing yellow cloth and peacock feather on his head, possessing two arms, holding a flute and stick in his hands, who is beyond the material gunas and possessed of all qualities, who has no material form and has a spiritual form, who has no material activity and all spiritual activities. On his two sides are Candravali and Radha. (Purusa-bodhi Upanisad)**

*radhaya madhavo devo madhvenaiva radhika vibhrajante janesu*

**Radha shines with Krsna and Krsna shines with Radha among the people. (Rk-parisista)**

Smrti proclaims this.

*atra yā gopakanyāśca nivasanti mamālaye\|*  
*yoginyastā mayā nityaṁ mama sevāparāyaṇāḥ \|\|*

**The daughters of the cowherd men live in my abode. Completely giving up all connections, they serve me continually. (Gautamiya-tantra)**

*dvibhujaḥ sarvadā so'sti na kadāciccaturbhujaḥ \|*  
*gopyaikayā yutastatra parikrīḍati nityadā \|\|*

**Krsna has two arms and never four. Along with one gopi he plays in Vrndavana eternally. (Rudra-yamala)**

Ekaya means with Radha the chief of all gopis.

Discerning this, I offer respects to your feet. Be merciful to me. May the tree of my thirst (tarsa-vitapi) bear fruit. May I attain Radha and Krsna as the result.

### Text 4

*hṛdi cira-vasad-āśā-maṇḍalālamba-pādau*  
*guṇavati tava nāthau nāthituṁ jantur eṣaḥ \|*  
*sapadi bhavad-anujñāṁ yācate devi vṛnde*  
*mayi kira karuṇārdrāṁ dṛṣṭim atra prasīda \|\|4\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**О merciful Vrnda! This person immediately requests your permission to beg your masters whose feet are the shelter of my long-standing desires in the heart. Cast a tender glance of mercy upon me. Be pleased with me.**

**Комментарий:**

Having pleased Vrnda, the forest’s presiding deity, he asks for permission for his request. О Vrnda, full of the quality of mercy (gunavati)\\ This person immediately requests your permission to request your two lords. Sapadi means quickly according to Amara-kosa. I pray to you. Sprinkle a tender glance of mercy to me. Be pleased (prasida). Without your mercy the mercy of the couple who are your authorities is rare. The couple is described. The feet of that couple are the shelter of many long-standing (.cira-vasat) desires. My desires will be fulfilled by their feet.

### Text 5

*dadhataṁ vapur aṁśu-kandalīṁ*  
*dalad-indīvara-vṛnda-bandhurām \|*  
*kṛta-kāñcana-kānti-vañcanaiḥ*  
*sphuritāṁ cāru-marīci-sañcayaiḥ \|\|5\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**This person, offering respects, begs you, Krsna, whose bodily rays are more attractive than a host of blossoming blue lotuses, and begs you, Radha, who shine with many attractive rays which cheat the beauty of gold.**

**Комментарий:**

Ten verses (5-14) are connected. O son of Nanda! O excellent daughter of Gokula! This person, offering respects to you two, begs. In each verse, Krsna and Radha are described.

Krsna’s body is endowed with a heap of rays or beauty. More attractive (bandhuram) than a host of blossoming (dalat) blue lotuses. Kandalim means a group according to Visva. Radha shines (sphuritam) with a group of attractive rays (caru-marici) which cheat the beauty of gold.

### Text 6

*nicitaṁ ghana-cañcalā-tater*  
*anukūlena dukūla-rociṣā \|*  
*mṛga-nābhi-rucaḥ sa-nābhinā*  
*mahitāṁ mohana-paṭṭa-vāsasā \|\|6\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**This person, offering respects, begs you Krsna, whose beautiful cloth is like thick lightning, and you Radha, whose glorious, charming cloth is similar to the beauty of musk.**

**Комментарий:**

Krsna is covered (nicitam) with the beauty of cloth which is like the thick lightning. Radha is glorious with cloth enchanting as (sanabhina) the beauty of musk (mrga-nabhi). Sanabhi means similar according to Haima.

### Text 7

*mādhurīṁ prakaṭayantam ujjvalāṁ*  
*śrīpater api variṣṭha-sauṣṭhavām \|*  
*indirā-madhura-goṣṭha-sundarī-*  
*vṛnda-vismaya-kara-prabhonnatām \|\|7\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**This person, offering respects, begs you Krsna, whose intense sweetness is more praiseworthy than that of Visnu and begs you Radha, whose beauty astonishes all the gopis who are sweeter than Laksmi.**

**Комментарий:**

Krsna manifests intense sweetness which is more praiseworthy (sausthavam) than that of Visnu. Radha’s beauty (prabho) astonishes all the gopis who are sweeter than Laksmi.

### Text 8

*itara-janasu-durghaṭodayasya*  
*sthira-guṇa-ratna-cayasya rohaṇādrim \|*  
*akhila-guṇavatī-kadamba-cetaḥ*  
*pracura-camatkṛti-kāri-sad-guṇāḍhyām \|\|8\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**This person, offering respects, begs you Krsna, whose Rohana Mountain of jewel-like qualities do not manifest in other persons, and he begs you Radha, filled with good qualities which astonish the hearts of all women filled with good qualities.**

**Комментарий:**

Krsna is a Rohana Mountain of fixed jewel-like qualities such as omniscience, friendship and mercy, which do not manifest in other associates such as Indra.

Radha is full of good qualities like affection, beauty, friendliness, etc., which deeply surprise the hearts of all women who are endowed with good qualities like affection and beauty.

### Text 9

*nistula-vraja-kiśora-maṇḍalī-*  
*mauli-maṇḍana-harinmaṇīśvaram \|*  
*viśva-visphurita-gokulollasan-*  
*navya-yauvata-vataṁsa-mālikām \|\|9\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**This person offering respects, begs you Krsna, who are the excellent emerald on the head of all incomparable cowherd boys, and begs you Radha, who are the jasmine crown for all the beautiful young girls of Gokula which manifests in this world.**

**Комментарий:**

Krsna is the best emerald decorating the head of all incomparable (nistuld) cowherd boys like Sridama and Subala. Radha is the jasmine crown on all the beautiful young girls like Syamala and Pali of Gokula which has manifested in the universe.

### Text 10

*svānta-sindhu-makarīkṛta-rādhaṁ*  
*hṛn-niśākara-kuraṅgita-kṛṣṇām \|*  
*preyasī-parimalonmada-cittaṁ*  
*preṣṭha-saurabha-hṛtendriya-vargām \|\|10\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**This person offering respects, begs you Krsna, who makes Radha a makara in the ocean of your heart, and whose heart is intoxicated with her fragrance, and begs you Radha, who makes Krsna a deer on the moon of your heart, and whose senses are stolen by his fragrance.**

**Комментарий:**

He shows their mental qualities. Krsna makes Radha a makara fish in the ocean of his heart (svanta). Radha makes Krsna into a deer (kurangita) in the moon of her heart. These lines indicate the great attachment of the two for each other. His heart becomes intoxicated with her fragrance. Her senses are stolen by his fragrance.

### Text 11

*prema-mūrti-vara-kārtika-devī*  
*kīrti-gāna-mukharī-kṛta-vaṁśam \|*  
*viśva-nandana-mukunda-samajñā-*  
*vṛnda-kīrtana-rasajña-rasajñām \|\|11\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**This person, offering respects, begs you Krsna, whose flute sings the glories of Radha, best of all forms of prema, and begs you Radha, whose tongue knows the taste of glorifying Mukunda’s famous qualities, which delight the world.**

**Комментарий:**

He makes his flute sing the fame of Radha, (kartika-devi) the best among forms of prema like Lalita, etc. Radha’s tongue knows the taste of glorifying the host of qualities of Mukunda, which give all joy to the world (vi^va-nandanam). Samajna means fame according to Amara-kosa.

### Text 12

*nayana-kamala-mādhurī-niruddha-*  
*vraja-nava-yauvata-mauli-hṛn-marālam \|*  
*vrajapati-suta-citta-mīna-rāja-*  
*grahaṇa-paṭiṣṭha-vilocanānta-jālām \|\|12\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**This person offering respects, begs you Krsna, who catch the swan of Radha’s heart by the sweetness of his lotus eyes, and begs you Radha, whose net-like eyes are skillful at catching the fish of Krsna’s heart.**

**Комментарий:**

He catches the swan-like heart of Radha, the crown of all young girls of Vraja, by the sweetness of his lotus eyes. The net (jalam) of the edge (anta) of her eyes are skillful at catching the fish of Krsna’s heart. Jala means net in the masculine according to Amara-kosa. They are greatly attracted to each other’s eyes.

### Text 13

*gopendra-mitra-tanayā-dhruva-dhairya-sindhu-*  
*pāna-kriyā-kalaśa-sambhava-veṇu-nādam \|*  
*vidyā-mahiṣṭha-mahatī-mahanīya-gāna-*  
*saṁmohitākhila-vimohana-hṛt-kuraṅgām \|\|13\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**This person offering respects, begs you Krsna, whose flute sound, like Agastya, drinks up the ocean of Radha’s fixed composure, and begs you Radha, whose worshippable songs on the vina, supreme in all arts, bewilders the deer-like heart of Krsna who bewilders the whole world.**

**Комментарий:**

The sound of Krsna’s flute becomes Agastya (born from a pot — kalasa-sambhava) for drinking up the ocean of Radha’s fixed composure. She is the daughter of the friend of Nanda (gopendra-mitra — Vrsabhanu). She bewilders the deer-like heart of allenchanting Krsna, by her worshipable (mahaniyd) songs on the vlna (mahati), supreme in arts (vidya-mahistha).

### Text 14

*kvāpy ānusaṅgikatayodita-rādhikākhyā-*

*prādurbhavaj-jaḍima-ḍambara-saṁvṛtāṅgīm \|\|14\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**This person offering respects, begs you Krsna, who forget your playful arts on uttering Radha’s name, and begs you Radha, who become stunned on hearing the two syllables “Krsna.”**

**Комментарий:**

Krsna forgets all his playful arts (vildsa-kala) when Radha’s name is uttered on some occasion (anusangikatayd). All of Radha’s limbs become covered with intense (.dambard) paralysis (jadimd) by hearing the two syllables “krs-na." Each is controlled by the sweetness of the other’s name.

*bhikṣate kim api durbhago janaḥ \|\|15\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**This unfortunate person begs you, О son of Nanda, and you, О daughter of Vrsabhanu, offering respects with hands on his head.**

**Комментарий:**

Ballava-purandara is Nanda. Gokula-varenya is Vrsabhanu.

### Text 16

*hanta sāndra-karuṇā-sudhā-jharī-*

*durjane'tra diśataṁ rater nija-*  
*prekṣaṇa-pratibhuvaś chaṭām api \|\|16\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**O couple whose lake-like hearts are full of condensed rivers of sweet mercy! Be kind to this wicked person. Give abundant rati which is the guarantee of seeing you.**

**Комментарий:**

“What do you beg?” Hanta expresses joy. O couple whose lakelike hearts are full of condensed rivers of sweet mercy! Be kind to this wicked person. Give (disatam) heaps (chatam) of rati, which is glorified as the guarantee (pratibhuvah) of seeing you. Pratibhu means surety according to Halayudha.

### Text 17

*śyāmayor nava-vayaḥ-suṣamābhyāṁ*  
*gaurayor amala-kānti-yaśobhyām \|*  
*kāpi vām akhila-valgu-vataṁsau*  
*mādhurī hṛdi sadā sphuratān me \|\|17\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**O Radha and Krsna, attractive head ornaments for all people! May the indescribable beauty of you two, who are syama with new age and new beauty, and gaura with spotless beauty and spotless fame, manifest in my heart.**

**Комментарий:**

The effects of rati are described. O Radha and Krsna who are the attractive head ornaments (valgu-vatamsau) for all people! May your beauty (madhura) manifest in my heart. The two are described. They are a couple, syama and syama, with freshness of youth (nava) and beauty of youth. Susamd means great beauty according to Amara-kosa. Syama and Syama are combined as one sydmayoh. The same applies to the word gaurayoh. Syama of new youth is Radha, aged sixteen. Syama, Krsna, has new beauty, shining like an emerald.

They are again described. They are golden with pure beauty and pure fame. She is gaurl and he is gaura. Radha shines like gold with pure beauty. Krsna is bright(gaura) with spotless fame. Gaura means yellow and bright according to Visva.

### Text 18

*sarva-ballava-vareṇya-kumārau*  
*prārthaye bata yuvāṁ praṇipatya \|*  
*līlayā vitarataṁ nija-dāsyaṁ*  
*līlayā vitarataṁ nija-dāsyam \|\|18\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**О Radha and Krsna, the best youthful couple among all the cowherds! Surrendering, I pray to you two. Please with ease give me service to you. Please with ease give me service to you.**

**Комментарий:**

“Why should you become absorbed in our beauty?” О Radha and Krsna, the best youthful couple among all the cowherds! The rest is clear. In this condition, I should serve you (nija-dasyam).

*praṇipatya bhavantam arthaye*

**Комментарий:**

In two verses the author requests mercy of the two who have appeared before him when they are pleased with him. О son of Nanda! Offering respects to you, I pray with plaintive voice. “What do you want?” Make this person, me, the object of mercy of Radha, the head garland of the girls of Gokula.

*bhavatīm abhivādya cāṭubhir*

О Radha (iirjesvari), deity of Kartika month! Bowing to you, I request an excellent (varyam) boon (varam) using pleasing words (catubhih). The boon is described.

May Krsna (bakantakah) be greatly merciful to me with a mood like yours (bhavadlyataya).

**О affectionate associates who play with Radha and Krsna in all directions! Hearing my plaintive plea, be merciful to me.**

**Комментарий:**

He begs for mercy from their followers. О affectionate people (pranaya-jana-ganah) of the couple! This refers to Radha’s friends and Krsna’s friends. Hear my plea (kakum) and be merciful to me. They are described. You perform pastimes in all directions with Radha and Krsna, offspring of the best cowherds. They are assistants in the couple’s pastimes.

Instead of general requests, the author requests to two groups in three verses (22-24).

О Lalita devi! Skillful Radha and Krsna listen to you (asravau) in the cottages, in the bowers and mountains. Asravah means “listening to” according to Amara-kosa. For this reason (iti), nothing is difficult for you. Accept me on your own (svayarri).

О Visakha! In Gokula (iha), you are the best candidate of the affection of Radha and Krsna, having gold and black bodies. For this reason (tena), please help me attain the soft glance of mercy of your dear couple.

**О Subala! Since you are the priya-narma-sakha of Radha and Krsna in Vraja, mercifully inform the couple about this suffering person.**

**Комментарий:**

О Subala! You are the priya-narma-sakha of Radha and Krsna in Vraja. For this reason, inform the couple about this suffering (vidhuram) person in front of them with a mood of mercy.

*śṛṇuta kṛpayā hanta prāṇeśayoḥ praṇayoddhurāḥ*

*pravaṇita-manāḥ kiṁ yuṣmābhiḥ samaṁ tilam apy asau*

**Перевод:**

**О servants made with love for the couple! Please hear by your mercy what this miserable living entity entreats for a moment. With humble heart, when will this person serve the couple in prema along with you, even for a moment?**

**Комментарий:**

He addresses their servants. О servants wild with prema (pranayoddhurah) for the lords of your life (pranesayoh), hear by your mercy. “What should we hear?” Hear what this miserable living entity reveals. “What is that?” When will this person, with humble heart (pravanita-manah), perform service for the couple in prema at the same time as you, even form a short time (tilam)?

### Text 26

*kva jano'yam atīva pāmaraḥ*

**Перевод:**

**What is this most degraded person in comparison to that service rare even for devotees in bhava? Still, intense thirst, ever new, keeps agitating me.**

**Комментарий:**

He analyzes his wicked nature. What is the status of this most degraded person? What is the auspiciousness of service hard to attain by devotees who have attained bhava? It is impossible for me to have a relationship with it. Though this is so, my intense thirst (uttarsa-dhura) agitates (ullayati) me. The thirst is described: it is fresh (ajarjara). Jarjara means worn out according to Visva. The thirst is great.

### Text 27

*dhvanta-brahma-marāla-kūjita-bharair ūrjeśvarī-nūpura-*  
*kvānair ūrjita-vaibhavas tava vibho vaṁśī-prasūtaḥ kalaḥ \|*  
*labdhaḥ śasta-samasta-nāda-nagarī-sāmrājya-lakṣmīṁ parām*  
*ārādhyaḥ praṇayāt  kadā śravaṇayor dvandvena mandena me \|\|27\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**О Lord! When will the sound of your flute, whose power increases by the sound of Radha’s ankle bells which defeat the murmuring of Brahma’s swan, and which has attained the position of Laksmi ruling over all cities of all praiseworthy sounds, be worshipped with affection by my ears?**

**Комментарий:**

Understanding his lack of qualification, he prays with intense thirst again.

О bhagavctn (vibho)! When will the sweet sound (kalah) coming from your flute be worshipped (aradhyah) by my two ears? The sound is described. Its power increases (iirjita-vaibhava) by the sound of Radha’s (iirjesvari) ankle bells. The sound of her ankle bells is described. The sound minimizes (dhvastd) the murmuring of Brahma’s swan. The sound of the flute is further described. It has attained the high position of ruling Laksmi over all the praiseworthy villages of sound. When will I hear your flute in the rasa dance along with Radha’s jingling ankle bells?

### Text 28

*stambhaṁ prapañcayati yaḥ śikhi-piñcha-mauli-*

**О queen of Vrndavana! When will I hear for a moment the sound of your vina, which, interrupting the flute’s notes, stuns the flute?**
