I know you are an enemy since you brought me into this forest on some pretext. Kaksa means a room according to Visva. Today I will not give up the rules prescribed by the Veda. Because they are prescribed by the Vedas, they are eternal (sanatanam). They are the cause of great happiness. Or I will not give up Krsna (sanatanam) from whom arise the rules of the Veda. He is not bound by the Vedas. From him arises happiness.

## atha rāsaḥ

### 1

*komala-śaśikara-ramya-vanāntara-nirmita-gīta-vilāsa \|*  
*tūrṇa-samāgata-ballava-yauvata-vīkṣaṇa-kṛta-parihāsa \|\|*  
*jaya jaya bhānu-sutā-taṭa-raṅga-mahā-naṭa sundara nanda-kumāra \|*  
*śarad-aṅgīkṛta-divya-rasāvṛta maṅgala-rāsa-vihāra \|\| dhruva \|\|*

**Перевод:**

**O Krsna, performing pastimes of singing in the pleasant forest, with soft moon rays! O Krsna, joking in order to see the love of the gopis who had quickly gathered! O Krsna, dancing in the various sections of the pastime of the auspicious rasa dance saturated with spiritual love in the autumn! O beautiful son of Nanda! May you manifest your excellence.**

**Комментарий:**

The raga is dhanasrt. The author describes the rasa dance.

O son of Nanda! May you manifest your excellence. You made pastimes of singing in the pleasant forest, with soft moon rays. You joked in order to see the love of the gopis who had quickly gathered. You danced greatly in the dancing arena on the bank of the Yamuna. You performed with its parts the pastime of the auspicious rasa dance spread with spiritual love in the autumn. This is the chorus.

### 2

*gopī-cumbita rāga-karambita māna-vilokana-līna \|*  
*guṇa-vargonnata-rādhā-saṅgata-sauhṛda-sampad-adhīna \|\|*  
*tad-vacanāmṛta-pāna-madāhṛta valayī-kṛta-parivāra \|*  
*sura-taruṇī-gaṇa-mati-vikṣobhaṇa khelana-valgita-hāra \|\|*  
*ambu-vigāhana-nandita-nija-jana maṇḍita-yamunā-tīra \|*  
*sukha-saṁvid-ghana pūrṇa-sanātana nirmala-nīla-śarīra \|\|*

**Перевод:**

**O Krsna, kissed by the gopis. O Krsna filled with attraction for the gopis! O Krsna, who disappeared on seeing the gopis’ pride. O Krsna associating with Radha, endowed with the greatest qualities. O Krsna, dependent on her friendship! O Krsna who brought them there because of prema, wanting to drink their sweet words! O Krsna, performing the rasa dance by forming a circle with them! O Krsna, agitating the minds of the devata women by your sweet singing! O Krsna, whose pearl necklace swayed from the dancing! O Krsna, giving joy to the gopis by playing in the water! O Krsna, decorating the bank of the Yamuna with the decorated gopis! O Krsna, the very form of condensed bliss and knowledge! O perfect one! O eternal one! O Krsna, untouched by maya! O beautiful black form!**

**Комментарий:**

O Krsna, kissed by the gopis! O Krsna filled with attraction for the gopis! O Krsna, who disappeared on seeing the gopis’ pride. O Krsna associating with Radha, endowed with the greatest qualities. O Krsna, dependent on her friendship! Or O Krsna, dependent on the friendship in association with Radha who had the greatest qualities!

You brought them because of prema, wanting to drink their sweet words such as jayati te’dhikam (SB 10.31.1). You associated with the gopis in a circle (yalayi-krta). You performed the rasa dance by forming a circle with them. You agitated the minds of the devata women by your sweet singing. Your pearl necklace swayed from the dancing. You gave joy to the gopis by playing in the water. You decorated the bank of the Yamuna with the gopis decorated with ornaments and clothing after bathing. O Krsna, the very form of condensed bliss and knowledge. O perfect one! O eternal one! Or O Krsna, who makes Sanatana complete! O Krsna, untouched by maya (nirmala)! O form beautifully black!

### 3

*śuddha-satī-vrata-vittā aham atinirmala-cittā \|*  
*prathayasi sujana-vimuktaṁ narmedaṁ kim ayuktam \|\|*  
*mādhava parihara me paṭam etam \|*  
*yāmi javena niketam \|\| dhruva \|\|*

**Перевод:**

**О Madhava! I am famous for my pure vow of chastity. My heart is devoid of lust. Why do you joke like this? It is devoid of scriptural reference and improper. Let go of my cloth. I will quickly go home.**

**Комментарий:**

The raga is dhanasri. As Visakha returns home after bathing in the Yamuna, Krsna, instructed by Radha who is hiding in the creepers on the bank, grabs her garment. Visakha then speaks to him. О Madhava! I am famous (vitta) for my pure vow. My mind is devoid of desires (atinirmala). Why do you joke with me, since I am pure? The joking is described. It is devoid of actions approved by those learned in smrti scriptures. Thus, it is improper (ayuktam). Let go of my cloth. I will quickly go home. This is the chorus.

### 4

*yadi jānāmy adhitīraṁ tvām atigūḍha-śarīram \|*  
*dūre sūra-sutāyāṁ sāyaṁ katham upayāyām \|\|*  
*vidadhe bhavad avanāmam caritaṁ parihara vāmam \|*  
*vartma sanātanam ucitaṁ pālaya dhārmika-rucitam \|\|*

**Перевод:**

**If I had known that you were hiding in the creepers on the bank of the Yamuna, why would I come to the Yamuna in the evening? I offer respects to you. Give up these atrocious acts. Protect the path prescribed in the Vedas, favored by followers of dharma.**

**Комментарий:**

“You have been sent for my pleasure.” If I had known that you were hiding in the creepers on the bank of the Yamuna, why would I come to the Yamuna in the evening? I offer respects (avanamam) to you. Give up these atrocious acts. Protect the path prescribed in the Vedas (sanatanam), favored by followers of dharma. This is a svayam dial message, because of mention of the word “evening.” Protect the eternal path of surrender to the Lord. Do what is suitable to me. The gopis are eternal saktis of the eternal Supreme Lord. What is remembered by followers of dharma is an inclination to surrender to Krsna. The alankara is mudra.

### 5

*kiṁ vitanoṣi mudhāṅga-vibhūṣaṇa-kapaṭenātra vighātam \|*  
*soḍhum ahaṁ samayasya na samprati śaktā lavam api yātam \|\|*  
*gokula-maṅgala-vaṁśī \|*  
*dhvanir udgarjati vana-gataye smara-bhūpati-śāsana-śaṁsī \|\| dhruva \|\|*

**Перевод:**

**Why do you make me late for the appointment on the pretext of uselessly decorating me? I cannot tolerate the passing of even a second. The sound of the flute reciting the order of Cupid, of Krsna, auspicious for Gokula, cries out to go to the forest.**

**Комментарий:**

The raga is karnata. Radha, about to go for an appointment, speaks to a sakhi who is decorating her. Atra means “at the appointment.” Vighatam means being late. I cannot tolerate the passing of a moment. “It is not yet time for the appointment.”

### 6

*mādhava-caraṇāṅguṣṭha-nakha-dyutir ayam udayati hima-dhāmā \|*  
*mā gurujana-bhayam udgira muhur iyam abhavaṁ dhāvitu-kāmā \|\|*  
*taṁ sevitum iha paśya sanātana-paramāraṇya-javeśam \|*  
*gopa-vadhū-tatir iyam upasarpati bhānu-sutā-taṭa-deśam \|\|*

**Перевод:**

**The moon rises, endowed with the effulgence of Krsna’s toenails. Do not say that I should fear the elders since I desire to run there. Look! All the gopis have gone to the bank of the Yamuna to serve Krsna dressed in eternal, excellent forest clothing.**

**Комментарий:**

Thinking the time for the appointment has already passed, she speaks.

Hima-dhama means the moon. “The elders will recognize you if you go in the moonlight.” Do not raise (udgira) fear of elders since I want to run there (davitu-kama). All the gopis go to the bank of the Yamuna to serve Krsna. Only I do not go. He is described. He wears beautiful, eternal dress arising from the forest. Or he wears forest clothing meditated upon by Sanatana.

### 7

*sphurad-indīvara-nindi-kalevara*  
*rādhā-kuca-kuṅkuma-bhara piñjara \|*  
*sundara-candraka-cūḍa manohara*  
*candrāvali-mānasa-śuka-pañjara \|\|*  
*jaya jaya jaya guñjāvali-maṇḍita \|*  
*praṇaya-viśṛṅkhala-gopī-maṇḍala-vara-*  
*bimbādhara-khaṇḍana-paṇḍita \|\| dhruva \|\|*

**Перевод:**

**О Krsna, whose body derides a blossoming blue lotus! О Krsna, yellowed by the kunkuma from Radha’s breast! О Krsna, attractive with hair topped by a beautiful peacock feather. О Krsna, a cage for the parrot of Candravalfs mind! Manifest your excellence! О Krsna, decorated with gunja berries! О Krsna, controlled by affection! О Krsna, expert at biting the excellent bimba lips of the gopis!**

**Комментарий:**

The raga is karnata. Krsna plays with the gopis who have come. О Krsna, yellowed by kunkuma (pinjara)! Your hair is topped with a beautiful peacock feather! You are bound by chains of affection. You are controlled by affection.

### 8

*mṛga-vanitānana-tṛṇa-visraṁsana-*  
*karma-dhurandhara-muralī-kūjita \|*  
*svārasika-smita-suṣamonmādita-*  
*siddha-satī-nayanāñcala-pūjita \|\|*  
*tāmbūlollasad-ānana-sārasa*  
*jāmbūnada-ruci-visphurad-ambara \|*  
*hara-kamalāsana-sanaka-sanātana-*  
*dhṛti-vidhvaṁsana-līlā-ḍambara \|\|*

**Перевод:**

**O Krsna, whose flute sound makes the deer stop chewing the grass in their mouths! O Krsna, worshipped by the glances of the chaste women intoxicated with the beauty of your natural soft smile. O Krsna, whose moon-like face shines with betel nut! O Krsna, whose cloth shines the color of gold! O Krsna, whose extensive pastimes destroy the determination of Siva, Brahma, Sanaka and Sanatana.**

**Комментарий:**

The sound of your flute makes the deer stop chewing the grass in their mouths.

You are worshipped by the glances of the chaste women intoxicated with the beauty of your natural (svarasika) soft smile. Your extensive (dambara) pastimes destroy the determination of Siva, etc.

### 9

*saurabha-sevita-puṣpa-vinirmita*  
*nirmala-vana-mālā-parimaṇḍita \|*  
*mandatara-smita-kānti-karambita-*  
*vadanāmbuja-nava-vibhrama-paṇḍita \|\|*  
*jaya jaya marakata-kandala-sundara \|*  
*vara-cāmīkara-pītāmbara-dhara*  
*vṛndāvana-jana-vṛnda-purandara \|\| dhruva \|\|*

**Перевод:**

**O Krsna, decorated with faultless forest garlands made from fragrant flowers! O Krsna, endowed with the beauty of a soft smile! O Krsna, expert at fresh gestures using your lotus face! Manifest your excellence! O Krsna, beautiful with makara sprout earrings! O Krsna, wearing excellent astonishing yellow cloth! O Krsna, prince of the people of Vrndavana!**

**Перевод:**

**This is in kedara-raga. The author calls out to please Krsna, situated in Vrndavana. The meaning is clear. Karambitam means endowed with. Kandala is a new sprout.**

### 10

*nava-guñjā-phala-rājibhir ujjvala-*  
*keki-śikhaṇḍaka-śekhara-mañjula \|*  
*guṇa-vargātula-gopa-vadhū-kula-*  
*citta-śilīmukha-puṣpita-vañjula \|\|*  
*kala-muralī-kvaṇa-pūra-vicakṣaṇa*  
*paśupālādhipa-hṛdayānandana \|*  
*giriśa-sanātana-sanaka-sanandana-*  
*nārada-kamalāsana-kṛta-vandana \|\|*

**Перевод:**

**O Krsna, whose peacock feather crown is attractive with many fresh gunja berries! O Krsna, an asoka tree attractive for the bee-like hearts of the gopis endowed with incomparable qualities! O Krsna, skillful at playing the flute! O Krsna, joy to Nanda’s heart! O Krsna, offered respects by Siva, Sanatana, Sanaka, Sanandana, Narada and Brahma.**

**Комментарий:**

Sekhara is a crown. He is an asoka tree attractive for the bees of the hearts of the gopis of incomparable qualities. He gives joy to the heart of Nanda (pasupaladhipa). He is offered respects by Siva and others.

### 11

*yāmuna-jala-kaṇikābhir upete \|*  
*saṅgatam ujjvala-kuñja-nikete \|\|*  
*tvayi vinihita-vara-sauhṛda-bhāram \|*  
*vihitāpara-taruṇī-parihāram \|\|*  
*bhaja sakhi ballava-rāja-kumāram \|*  
*kāmita-tāvaka-saṅga-vihāram \|\| dhruva \|\|*

**Перевод:**

**O friend! Worship the son of Nanda, desiring pastimes with you, who is waiting for you, having come to an effulgent bower filled with fine water drops from the Yamuna, who has great affection for you, who has given up all other young girls.**

**Комментарий:**

This is in gaudi-raga. A messenger unites Radha with Krsna who is in a bower.

О friend! Worship the son of Nanda! He is described. He is waiting for you, having come to an effulgent bower. The rest is clear. He desires pastimes with you (tavaka). This is the chorus.

### 12

*nava-guñjā-phala-mañjula-hāram \|*  
*mālya-vihāri-madhupa-parivāram \|\|*  
*nirmala-narma-vibhāvana-śīlam \|*  
*ballavam atra sanātana-līlam \|\|*

**Перевод:**

**Worship the cowherd, who wears a pearl necklace with fresh gunja berries, whose associates are bees attracted to his garland, who likes to speak pure jokes, who has eternal pastimes.**

**Комментарий:**

He has a pearl necklace attractive with fresh gunja berries. He is accompanied by bees attracted to his flower garland. He is alone. He likes to mix his speech with pure jokes. This means he attracts others by his jokes. He has eternal pastimes. This means he is eternally dear. Or he has pastimes worshipped by Sanatana.

### 13

*taruṇī-locana-tāpa-vimocana-*  
*hāsa-sudhāṅkura-dhārī \|*  
*manda-maruccala-piñcha-kṛtojjvala-*  
*maulir udāra-vihārī \|\|*  
*sundari paśya milati vanamālī \|*  
*divase pariṇatim upagacchati sati*  
*nava-nava-vibhrama-śālī \|\| dhruva \|\|*

**Перевод:**

**О beautiful friend! О chaste one! Krsna, relieving the gopis’ eyes of suffering by the sprout of his sweet smile, wearing a crown made bright by a peacock feather swaying in the gentle breeze, playing extensively, wearing a forest garland, endowed with ever fresh pastimes, is coming at the end of the day.**

**Комментарий:**

This is sung in mallara-raga. The author describes Krsna, who goes to Vraja from the forest in the afternoon. О beautiful friend! O chaste one! Krsna, wearing a forest garland, is coming. Look! It happens when the day is ending (divase parinatim upagaccati). He moves with a gentle breeze. His crown (mauli) is shining with a peacock feather. Mauli means crown according to Haima. He has ever new pastimes (vibhrama). This is the chorus.

### 14

*dhenu-khuroddhuta-reṇu-paripluta-*  
*phulla-saroruha-dāmā \|*  
*acira-vikasvara-lasad-indīvara-*  
*maṇḍala-sundara-dhāmā \|\|*  
*kala-muralī-ruti-kṛta-tāvaka-ratir*  
*atra dṛg-anta-taraṅgī \|*  
*cāru-sanātana-tanur anurañjana-*  
*kāri-suhṛd-gaṇa-saṅgī \|\|*

**Перевод:**

**He has a blossoming lotus garland covered with dust raised by the cows’ hooves. His body is more beautiful than lustrous blue lotuses suddenly blossoming for a long time. He glances around restlessly. He has an eternally attractive body. He attracts his friends to his association.**

**Комментарий:**

He increases your rati by the soft sounds of his flute. His body is eternally attractive. Or his body is attractive to Sanatana who knows the truth about him. The rest is clear.

### 15

*yadyapi samādhiṣu vidhir api paśyati*  
*na tava nakhāgra-marīcim \|*  
*idam icchāmi niśamya tavācyuta*  
*tad api kṛpādbhuta-vīcim \|\|*  
*deva bhavantaṁ vande \|*  
*man-mānasa-madhukaram arpaya nija-*  
*pada-paṅkaja-makarande \|\| dhruva \|\|*

**Перевод:**

**O Acyuta! Though even Brahma in samadhi cannot see a ray of light from your toenail, hearing about your waves of astonishing mercy, I desire this. O Lord! I offer respects to you. Engage my bee-like mind in the honey of your lotus feet.**

**Комментарий:**

The raga is dhanaSri. The author prays for prema for the lotus feet of the Lord, Nanda’s son, endowed with variegated pastimes.

О Krsna, who does not fall from giving mercy to the suffering people (acyuta)\\

Even Brahma cannot see a ray from the tip of your toenail in samadhi without your mercy. Marlci means a ray according to Amara-kosa. Hearing about your astonishing wave of mercy, I desire what I will explain. One attains the Lord only by his mercy. Vasu says in Narayaniya:

*na śakyaḥ sa tvayā draṣṭumasmābhirvā bṛhaspate \|*  
*yasya prasādaṁ kurute sa vai taṁ draṣṭumarhati \|\|*

**О Brhaspati! It is not possible for you or me to see him. He can be seen by that person to whom he gives mercy. (Mahabharata 12.323.18)**

Brahma also says in the Tenth Canto athapi te deva (SB 10.14.29)

О Lord! I offer respects to you. For what purpose? Engage (arpaya) my mind at the honey of your lotus feet.

### 16

*bhaktir udañcati yadyapi mādhava*  
*na tvayi mama tila-mātrī \|*  
*parameśvaratā tad api tavādhika-*  
*durghaṭa-ghaṭana-vidhātrī \|\|*  
*ayam avilolatayādya sanātana*  
*kalitādbhuta-rasa-bhāram \|*  
*nivasatu nityam ihāmṛta-nindini*  
*vindan-madhurima-sāram \|\|*

**Перевод:**

**О Madhava! Though I have not a particle of bhakti, you are the Supreme Lord, and can do the impossible. May the bee of my mind, deriding nectar, constantly and steadily remain at your lotus feet, filled with abundant, astonishing rasa, having attained the essence of sweetness.**

**Комментарий:**

“How can I engage your mind in the absence of bhakti?”

Though not even a speck of bhakti for you manifests in me, you can perform what is impossible. You are the supreme lord. By that you can do it. May the bee of my mind (ayam) reside steadily and constantly at the honey of your lotus feet (atra), having attained a great amount of astonishing rasa. The bee has attained the essence of sweetness and derides nectar (amrta-nindini). О eternal form! Or great powerful Lord whose mercy is discerned by Sanatana.

In order to describe varieties of heroines, the author points out the following:

## atha nayika-bhedah

### 1

*athābhisārikā vāsa-sajjāpy utkaṇṭhitā tathā \|*  
*vipralabdhā khaṇḍitā ca kalahāntaritā parā \|\|*  
*proṣita-preyasī proktā tathā svādhīna-bhartṛkā \|*  
*ity aṣṭau nāyikā-bhedā rasa-tantre prakīrtitāḥ \|\|*

**Перевод:**

**The following eight types of heroines are glorified in rasa scriptures: abhisarika, vasa-sajja, utkanthita, vipralabdha, khandita, kalahantarita, prosita-preyasi and svadhina-bhartrka.**

## tatrābhisārikā

### 1

*yā paryutsuka-cittātimadena madanena ca \|*  
*ātmanābhisaret kāntaṁ sā bhaved abhisārikā \|\|*

**Перевод:**

**The woman who goes to meet her lover with her body, whose heart is sprinkled with love and intoxicated with youth is called the abhisarika.**

**Комментарий:**

The abhisarika is described.

### 2

*tvaṁ kuca-valgita-mauktika-mālā \|*  
*smita-sāndrī-kṛta-śaśi-kara-jālā \|\|*  
*harim abhisara sundari sitaveśā \|*  
*rākā-rajanir ajani gurur eṣā \|\| dhruva \|\|*

**Перевод:**

**О beautiful Radha! Wearing white dress, with pearl necklace swaying on your breasts, with smile that intensified the rays of the moon, go and meet Krsna. The moonlight night has appeared as your guru.**

**Комментарий:**

The raga is dhanasri. The author illustrates the abhisarika.

О beautiful woman! Dressed in white cloth and ornaments, go and meet Krsna. The white dress is described. She wears a swaying pearl necklace on her breasts. By her smile, the rays of the moon become more intense. A guru has appeared as the excellent full moon night. This is the chorus.

### 3

*parihita-māhiṣa-dadhi-ruci-sicayā \|*  
*vapur arpita-ghana-candana-nicayā \|\|*  
*karṇa-karambita-kairava-hāsā \|*  
*kalita-sanātana-saṅga-vilāsā \|\|*

**Перевод:**

**You wear cloth the color of buffalo yogurt. Your body is anointed with thick sandalwood. You wear blossoming white lotuses in your ears. You have attained pastimes with eternal Krsna.**

**Комментарий:**

She wore cloth the color of buffalo yogurt on her limbs. She wore blossoming (hasa) white lotuses on her ears. She attained pastimes by meeting with eternal Krsna. Or she had pastimes in which the attachment of Sanatana was seen.

## atha vāsaka-sajjā

### 1

*bhaved vāsaka-sajjāsau sajjitāṅga-ratālayā \|*  
*niścityāgamanaṁ bhartur dvārekṣaṇa-parāyaṇā \|\|*

**Перевод:**

**The vasaka-sajja decorates her body and the place for amorous pastimes, and, making certain her lover is coming, is absorbed in looking at the door.**

**Комментарий:**

The vasaka-sajja is described. She decorates (sajjita) her body and the place for pastimes.

### 2

*kusumāvalibhir upaskuru talpam \|*  
*mālyaṁ cāmala-maṇisara-kalpam \|\|*  
*priyasakhi keli-paricchada-puñjam \|*  
*upakalpaya satvaram adhikuñjam \|\| dhruva \|\|*

**Перевод:**

**Prepare a bed of many flowers and a flower garland like a jeweled necklace. О dear friend! Quickly prepare all the ingredients for play in the bower.**

**Комментарий:**

The raga is kalyana. The heroine speaks to her sakhis. Make (.upaskuru) a bed. Make a flower garland like a jeweled necklace. The garland is made of flower buds. О dear friend! Prepare objects for play, such as flower balls, goblets of liquor, and sweets, in the bower (adhikunjam). This is the chorus.

### 3

*maṇi-sampuṭam upanaya tāmbūlam \|*  
*śayanāñcalam api pīta-dukūlam \|\|*  
*viddhi samāgatam apratibandham \|*  
*mādhavam āśu sanātana-sandham \|\|*

**Перевод:**

**Bring betel nut in a jeweled box and arrange a yellow cloth at the edge of the bed. Understand that Madhava, making an eternal promise, is quickly arriving without obstacle.**

**Комментарий:**

The meaning is clear. “1 am doing this bit by bit.” Understand that Madhava will come, without obstacles (aprati-bandham). His promise is eternal (sanatana-sandham). Or he has made a promise to Sanatana.

## athotkaṇṭhitā

### 1

*sā syād utkaṇṭhitā yasyā vāsaṁ naiti drutaṁ priyaḥ \|*  
*tasyānagamane hetuṁ cintayantyā śucā bhṛśam \|\|*

**Перевод:**

**The utkanthika is the woman to whose house her lover does not come quickly and who thus laments greatly, worried about the cause of his not coming.**

**Комментарий:**

The utkanthita is described. Tasya refers to the lover. She is endowed with lamentation (suca).

### 2

*kim u candrāvalir anaya-gabhīrā \|*  
*nyaruṇad amuṁ rati-vīram adhīrā \|\|*  
*aticiram ajani rajani-rati-kālī \|*  
*saṅgam avindata na hi vanamālī \|\| dhruva \|\|*

**Перевод:**

**Has Candravali, confident and capricious, blocked the hero of love from coming? The night has quickly become very dark. Thus, Krsna has not come for the meeting.**

**Комментарий:**

The raga is asavafi.

Candravali is very confident (anaya-gabhira). The night has quickly become very dark (ati-kah). Because of that (hi) Krsna did not meet me. This is the chorus.

### 3

*kim iha jane dhṛta-paṅka-vipāke \|*  
*vismṛtir asya babhūva varāke \|\|*  
*kim uta sanātana-tanur alaghiṣṭham \|*  
*raṇam ārabhata surāribhiru(ri)iṣṭam \|\|*

**Перевод:**

**Did he forget this insignificant person, who reaps results of sin? Or did Krsna, with eternal body eagerly start a huge battle with demons?**

**Комментарий:**

She thinks of another cause. Has he forgotten about me? She explains the reason for his forgetting. This person has attained results (vipdke) of sin (parika). Panka means sin according to Visvalocana. This person is insignificant (varake). How could he forget me, since I am the jewel of young women, having prema and he has affection for me? She thinks of another reason. Did the person with eternal body, start a great battle with some demons? The battle is described. It was desired (istam) by that valiant person. Or his body is dear to Sanatana.

## atha vipralabdhā

### 1

*yasyā dūtīṁ svayaṁ preṣya samaye nāgataḥ priyaḥ \|*  
*śocantī taṁ vinā duḥsthā  vipralabdhā tu sā smṛtā \|\|*

**Перевод:**

**The vipralabdha is the miserable woman who laments when her lover does not come on time, after she has sent a messenger for the meeting.**

**Комментарий:**

Vipralabdha woman is described. Sending the messenger for the meeting he does not come.

### 2

*komala-kusumāvalī-kṛta-cayanam \|*  
*apasāraya rati-līlā-śayanam \|\|*  
*śrī-hariṇādya na lebhe śamaye \|*  
*hanta janaṁ sakhi śaraṇaṁ kamaye \|\| dhruva \|\|*

**Перевод:**

**Take away the pleasure bed, strewn with soft flowers. Krsna did not come on time. O friend! To whom should I go?**

**Комментарий:**

The raga is gaudl. The heroine speaks to her sakhi. Remove the bed. I was not attained by Krsna. Reduplicated perfect tense is used (lebhe) out of confusion. Hanta expresses lamentation. О friend! To whom (kam janam) should I go (aye)? Who will show me Krsna? This is the chorus.

### 3

*nidhṛta-manohara-gandha-vilāsam \|*  
*kṣipa yāmuna-taṭa-bhuvi paṭa-vāsam \|\|*  
*labdham avehi niśāntim ayāmam \|*  
*muñca sanātana-saṅgati-kāmam \|\|*

**Перевод:**

**Throw the powder of attractive fragrance on the bank of the Yamuna. The last portion of night has arrived. Give up the desire for embracing Krsna.**

**Комментарий:**

Throw the fragrant powder on the bank of the Yamuna. It is described. It has the charm of attractive fragrance. It was very fragrant. “Krsna will come.” The last portion of night has come. Give up the desire for embracing Krsna (sanatana). The alankara of mudra.

## atha khaṇḍitā

### 1

*anyayā saha kāntasya dṛṣṭe sambhoga-lakṣaṇe \|*  
*īrṣyā-kaṣāyitātmāsau khaṇḍitā khalu kathyate \|\|*

**Перевод:**

**The khandita woman is said to be the woman who seeing the marks of enjoyment of her lover with another woman, becomes filled with envy.**

**Комментарий:**

The khandita woman is described. Anyaya means with a rival heroine.

### 2

*hṛdayāntaram adhiśayitam \| ramaya janaṁ nija-dayitam \|\|*  
*kiṁ phalam aparādhikayā \| saṁprati tava rādhikayā \|\|*  
*mādhava parihara paṭima-taraṅgam \|*  
*vetti na kā tava raṅgam \|\| dhruva \|\|*

**Перевод:**

**Enjoy with your lover who is close to your heart. What use do you have of your offender, Radhika? O Madhava! Give up your harsh actions. What woman knows your pastimes?**

**Комментарий:**

The raga is rama-keli. Enjoy with your lover Candravali situated completely within your heart. What is the result for one who has offended you (aparadhikaya)? 1 was awake in the bower, waiting for you. Give up this wave of sharpness. This is the chorus.

### 3

*āghūrṇati tava nayanam \| yāhi ghaṭīṁ bhaja śayanam \|\|*  
*anulepaṁ racayālam \| naśyatu nakha-pada-jālam \|\|*  
*tvām iha vilasati bālā \| mukhara-sakhīnāṁ mālā \|\|*  
*deva sanātana vande \| na kuru vilambam ālinde \|\|*

**Перевод:**

**Your eyes are rolling. Spend your time with her. Enjoy the bed. Smear sandalwood on your body. Hide the nail marks. My young group of noisy sakhis laugh at you. I offer respects to you, O eternal, playful one! Immediately leave my porch.**

**Комментарий:**

Ghatl (twenty-four minutes) becomes the object of an intransitive verb (yahi). Smear sandalwood, etc., all over your body. Destroy the many nail marks. My group of noisy sakhis laugh at you, affectionate and talking the truth. Leave my porch immediately. There is mudra alankara here also.

### 4

*yāṁ sevitavān asi jāgarī \|*  
*tvām ajayat sā niśi nāgarī \|\|*  
*kapaṭam idaṁ tava vindati hare \|*  
*nāvasaraṁ punar āli-nikare \|\| dhruva \|\|*

**Перевод:**

**This heroine, staying awake at night, serving you, has conquered you. O Krsna! Your cheating has no chance again among her group of friends.**

**Комментарий:**

The raga is bhairava. The author again describes the khandita state because of its great charm.

Staying awake in the night serving you, this heroine has conquered you. Your cheating, saying, “I lamented greatly in the forest, longing for you,” has no opportunity in my group of friends. This is the chorus.

### 5

*mā kuru śapathaṁ gokula-pate \|*  
*vetti ciraṁ kā caritaṁ na te \|\|*  
*mukta-sanātana-sauhṛda-bhare \|*  
*na punar ahaṁ tvayi rasam āhare \|\|*

**Перевод:**

**О master of Gokula! Do not make vows. Who does not know your character for a long time? I will no longer have attraction for you who breaks eternal, strong friendship.**

**Комментарий:**

You cheat everyone, making them suffer. I will not bind myself with attraction for you again, since you gave up eternal friendship. This also is mudra-alahkara.

## atha kalahāntaritā

### 1

*nirasto manyunā kānto namann api yayā puraḥ \|*  
*sānutāpa-yutā dīnā kalahāntaritā bhavet \|\|*

**Перевод:**

**The kalahantarita woman rejects the love with anger, though offered respects by the lover, but also feels repentance and becomes miserable.**

**Комментарий:**

The kalahantarita woman is described.

### 2

*nākarṇayam atisuhṛd-upadeśam \|*  
*mādhava-cāṭu-paṭalam api leśam \|\|*  
*sīdati sakhi mama hṛdayam adhīram \|*  
*yad abhajam iha na hi gokula-vīram \|\| dhruva \|\|*

**Перевод:**

**I did not listen to the advice of my great friends. I did not hear the many affectionate words of Madhava even a little. О friend! My unsettled heart is shattered since I did not worship the hero of Gokula.**

**Комментарий:**

The raga is lalita. I did not listen to the advice of my friends like Lalita. I did not hear the many affectionate words of Madhava, even a little. My heart is shattered (sidati) since I did not worship the hero of Gokula, Madhava. This is the chorus.

### 3

*nālokayam arpitam uru-hāram \|*  
*praṇamantaṁ ca dayitam anuvāram \|\|*  
*hanta sanātana-guṇam abhiyāntam \|*  
*kim adhārayam aham urasi na kāntam \|\|*

**Перевод:**

**I did not look at the fine necklace he offered. I did not look at him offering respects many times. Ah! Why I did not hold to my chest my approaching lover, of eternal qualities?**

**Комментарий:**

I did not look at the excellence he offered me and did not look at him offering respects. Why did I not hold to my chest my lover who approached? О friend! Deliver me from my great regret. My lover has eternal qualities. Or he has qualities glorified by Sanatana.

## atha virahiṇī proṣita-preyasau

### 1

*kutaścit kāraṇād yasyā vidūrastho bhavet patiḥ \|*  
*tad-anāgama-duḥkhārtā sā syāt proṣita-bhartṛkā \|\|*

**Перевод:**

**When the lover stays far away for some reason, the woman who suffers great pain when he does not return is called the prosita-bhartrka.**

**Комментарий:**

The woman in separation when the lover departs is described.

When Krsna stays in Mathura to kill Kamsa he goes far away.

### 2

*kurvati kila kokila-kule ujjvala-kala-nādam \|*  
*jaiminir iti jaiminr iti jalpati saviṣādam \|\|*  
*mādhava ghore viyoga-tamasi nipapāta rādhā \|*  
*vidhura-malina-mūrtir adhikam adhirūḍha-bādhā \|\| dhruva \|\|*

**Перевод:**

**When the cuckoos sing brightly, Radha utters “Jaimini, Jaimini” in lamentation. О Madhava! Radha has fallen in deep darkness of separation. Her body is contaminated with pain. She experiences ever-increasing suffering.**

**Комментарий:**

The raga is gaudl. Uddhava speaks to Krsna situated in Mathura.

When flocks of cuckoos sing, Radha, fearing being struck by thunder bolts utters “Jaimini, Jaimini.” It is well known that shouting Jaimini’s name reduces fear of thunder.

*muneḥ kalyāṇamitrasya jaimineścāpi kīrtanāt \|*  
*vidyudagnibhayaṁ nāsti \[…\] litena mahodare \|\|*  
*\[…\] jaiminiśca vaiśampāyana eva ca \|*  
*pulastyaṁ(styaḥ) pulahaścaiva pañcaite vajravāraṇāḥ \|\|*

**By chanting the name of the sage Jaimini, friend of auspiciousness, there is no fear of lightning or fire. The five, Jaimini, Sumanta, Vaisampayana, Pulastya and Pulaha prevent thunder.**

О Madhava! Radha has fallen into deep darkness of separation. She is a form contaminated with suffering. She suffers increasingly, with more intensity. This is the chorus.

### 3

*nīla-nalina-mālyam ahaha vīkṣya pulaka-vītā \|*  
*garuḍa garuḍety abhirauti parama-bhītā \|\|*  
*lambhita-mṛga-nābhim aguru-kardamam anu dīnā \|*  
*dhyāyati śiti-kaṇṭham api sanātanam anulīnā \|\|*

**Перевод:**

**Seeing a garland of blue lotuses, with hairs standing on end, she shouts “Garuda, Garuda” in great fear. Seeing aguru mixed with musk, suffering, she meditates on Siva. She becomes absorbed in you, having an eternal form.**

**Комментарий:**

She fears a black snake on seeing a garland of blue lotuses. To destroy the fear, she chants the name of Garuda, the eater of snakes. Seeing aguru mixed with musk, mistaking it for Black Cupid, she meditates on Siva to drive it away. She becomes absorbed, thinking of you, eternal in form.

## atha svādhīna-bhartṛkā

### 1

*yasyāḥ prema-guṇākṛṣṭaḥ priyaḥ pārśvaṁ na muñcati \|*  
*vicitra-sambhramāsaktā sā syāt svādhīna-bhartṛkā \|\|*

**Перевод:**

**She who attracts her lover by her quality of prema, so that he does not leave her side, who is absorbed in various pastimes is the svadhina-bhartrka.**

**Комментарий:**

The svadhina-bhartrka is described.

She is absorbed in various pastimes (sambhrama).

### 2

*patrāvalim iha mama hṛdi gaure \|*  
*mṛgamada-bindubhir arpaya śaure \|\|*  
*śyāmala sundara vividha-viśeṣam \|*  
*viracaya vapuṣi mamojjvala-veśam \|\| dhruva \|\|*

**Перевод:**

**О heroic Krsna! Please draw patterns using musk drops on my golden chest. Please arrange my bright cloth on my body in various ways.**

**Комментарий:**

The raga is mallara. Radha, playing, speaks to Krsna. О brave Krsna (saure)! Make some patterns using musk on my golden chest. О dark beautiful Krsna! Arrange my dress in special ways. This is the chorus.

### 3

*piñcha-mukuṭa mama piñcha-nikāśam \|*  
*varam avataṁsaya kuntala-pāśam \|\|*  
*atra sanātana śilpa-lavaṅgam \|*  
*śruti-yugale mama lambhaya saṅgam \|\|*

**Перевод:**

**О Krsna with peacock crown! Decorate my excellent hair, long as a peacock tail. О eternal Krsna! Place clove flower ornaments skillfully crafted on my ears.**

**Комментарий:**

О Krsna with peacock crown! Decorate my excellent hair, long like a peacock tail, with flowers. Or make my hair attractive, being already decorated with flowers. Place on my two ears clove flower decorations made with skill. О eternal Krsna! Place them there. “Why are words like husband and wife used in pastimes of paramour love?” This can be accepted because Krsna is actually the husband of Radha and others who are the supreme sakti. Secondary paramour love where the gopis accept marriage to other cowherds by his desire with no beginning nourishes the pastimes. There is no harm in this.

### 4

*kim ayaṁ racayati nayana-taraṅgam \|*  
*kairaviṇī na hi bhajati pataṅgam \|\|*  
*vāraya mādhavam udavad-anaṅgam \|*  
*spṛśati yathāyaṁ na sakhi mad-aṅgam \|\| dhruva \|\|*

**Перевод:**

**Is Krsna leering at me? The night lotus does not worship the sun. О Lalita! Stop Madhava, full of desire so that he does not touch my limbs. The raga is vasanta. Radha, picking flowers, on seeing Krsna approach with clear desire, speaks to Lalita to prevent him, though she is joyful.**

**Комментарий:**

Is Krsna glancing at me? “He wants to embrace you.” The night lotus does not worship the sun (patahgam). The rest is clear. О my friend Lalita (sakhi)! This is the chorus

### 5

*kampikarān mama patati lavaṅgam \|*  
*tvam api tathāpi na muñcasi raṅgam \|\|*  
*kam api sanātana-dharmam abhaṅgam \|*  
*na parihariṣye hṛdi kṛta-saṅgam \|\|*

**Перевод:**

**A clove flower falls from my trembling hand. Still you do not give up your joking mood. I will not give up the unbroken dharma of the Vedas fixed in my heart.**

**Комментарий:**

A clove flower falls from my trembling hand. But you do not stop your joy. “Why are you agitated by your lover Krsna?” I am afraid of breaking dharma. 1 will not reject family dharma coming in an unbroken tradition, prescribed in the beginningless Vedas (sanatana). It is situated in my heart. Her trembling hand indicates that sattvika-bhava has arisen. This indicates her desire to play with him. Or I cannot give up bhakti, attained from beginningless time, for eternal Krsna.

### 6

*apaghana-ghaṭita-ghusṛṇa-ghana-sāra \|*  
*piñcha-khacita-kuñcita-kaca-bhāra \|\|*  
*jaya jaya ballava-rāja-kumāra \|*  
*rādhā-vakṣasi hari-maṇi-hāra \|\| dhruva \|\|*

**Перевод:**

**О Krsna, with kunkuma and camphor on your limbs! О Krsna, with a peacock feather in your curly hair! О Krsna, son of Nanda! Manifest your excellence! О Krsna, sapphire on Radha’s chest!**

**Комментарий:**

The raga is bhairava. The poet describes Krsna, who is pleased.

He has kunkuma and camphor on his body (apaghana). Apaghana means body according to Dhananjaya. Ghusrna means kunkuma according to Halayudha. Ghana-sara is camphor according to Halayudha. He has a peacock feather in his curly hair. He has a sapphire necklace. Hari means Indra according to Halayuhda. This is the chorus.

### 7

*rādhā-dhṛti-hara-muralī-tāra \|*  
*nayanāñcala-kṛta-madana-vikāra \|\|*  
*rasa-rañjita-rādhā-parivāra \|*  
*kalita-sanātana-citta-vihāra \|\|*

**Перевод:**

**О Krsna, whose loud flute steals Radha’s composure! О Krsna, whose glance stimulates Radha’s love symptoms! О Krsna, who produces attraction in Radha’s friends! О Krsna, who produces pastimes in the heart of Sanatana!**

**Комментарий:**

The loud sound of his flute steals the determination of Radha. He produces ecstatic symptoms of love in Radha by his glance. He tinges Radha’s friends and servants with anuraga. He produces pastimes in the heart of Sanatana.

### 8

*sundari sādhvī tvam iha kiśorī \|*  
*tat katham asi vada goṣṭha-purandara-nandana hṛn-maṇi-caurī \|\| dhruva \|\|*

**Перевод:**

**О beautiful Radha! You are a chaste young girl in Gokula. Please say how you will steal the jewel-like heart of Nanda’s son?**

**Комментарий:**

The raga is karnata, the rhythm is ekatall. Visakha speaks to Radha, very soft.

О beautiful Radha! You are chaste in Gokula (iha). Please say how you will steal the heart jewel of Nanda’s son. This is the chorus.

### 9

*na hi saṅgopaya para-dhanam adhunā tvaṁ viditā kula-pālī \|*  
*lalitā-sakhi kuru karuṇāṁ sīdati kandara-bhuvi vanamālī \|\|*  
*ayi ramaṇī-maṇi ramaṇīyaṁ maṇim arpaya punar avilambam \|*  
*bhavatu nirākulam atikṛpayā tava hari-parijana-nikurambam \|\|*  
*dūtī-yugam idam avanamati svayam avani-luṭhita-kaca-jūṭam \|*  
*tanvi sanātana-sauhṛdam anusara vistāraya na hi kūṭam \|\|*

**Перевод:**

**Do not conceal the jewel of Krsna’s mind since I know you are a protector of your family. O friend of Lalita! Show mercy Krsna is suffering in a mountain cave. O jewel among women! Give to him the jewel in your heart, attractive with the quality of love, without delay. Make all his associates happy by your mercy. His two messengers offer respects with their hair on the ground. O beautiful Radha! Show eternal friendship! Do not show a crooked nature.**

**Комментарий:**

Do not conceal the jewel of Krsna’s mind (para-dhanam) since I know you are a protector of your family. O friend of Lalita! Show mercy. Krsna is suffering in a mountain cave. “I know how to take the jewel of his heart, but not how to give it.” O jewel among women! Give to him the jewel in your heart attractive with the quality of love (ramanlyam), without delay. “Then what will happen?” Two messengers from Krsna offer respects to you. O beautiful Radha (tanvi)! Be friendly to eternal Krsna. Or show eternal friendship. Do not show crookedness (kutam).

### 10

*rādhe kalaya hṛdayam anukūlam \|*  
*dalati dṛgañcala-śara-hata-hṛt tava gokula-jīvita-mūlam \|\| dhruva \|\|*

**Перевод:**

**O Radha! Make your heart favorable. The life of Gokula is tom apart, his heart pierced by the arrow of your glance.**

**Комментарий:**

The raga is mallara in ekatali rhythm. She again speaks to Radha who has not replied.

Make your heart favorable to Krsna. “Why should I do this?” The son of Nanda, the life of Gokula, his heart pierced by your glance, is torn apart. This is the chorus.

### 11

*śīlita-pañcama-gītir adakṣiṇa-pāṇi-saroruha-haṁsī \|*  
*tanute sāmpratam asya munivratam arati-bharād iva vaṁśī \|\|*  
*bhramad indindira-vṛnda-vikarṣaṇa-parimala-paṭala-viśālā \|*  
*patitā kaṇṭha-taṭād abhiśuṣyati tasya vane vanamālā \|\|*  
*adaye dadhatī tanur api tanutāṁ tasya samujjhita-līlā \|*  
*śīryati kandara-dhāmni sanātana-hṛdayānandana-śīlā \|\|*

**Перевод:**

**His flute, which used to play the fifth note, which was a swan in the lotus of his left hand, now is silent in great sadness. His garland, whose profuse fragrance attracted hordes of swarming bees, falling from his neck in the forest, withers away. O merciless Radha! His body, which gives joy to the heart of Sanatana, giving up eating, has become thin and suffers in the cave.**

**Комментарий:**

His broken heart is described. The flute of Krsna who is pierced by the arrow of your glance, is now silent (muni-vratam) because of great sadness (arati-bharat). The flute is described. It used to sing the fifth note. It was a swan in his left lotus hand. It cannot act in this way now. His garland has fallen from his neck in the forest and dries up. He does not know that the dear garland has fallen off. The garland is described. It attracts many wandering bees by its abundant fragrance. The fragrance can be perceived from far away (yisala). O merciless Radha (adaye)! His body has become thin, suffering in the cave. The body is described. It has given up eating (samujjita-llld). It gives joy to the heart of Sanatana. Krsna, worshipped by Brahma’s son Sanatana, whom you should worship, is fully devoted to you and is suffering. Knowing this, you do not receive him. Then, knowing the suffering of her lover, Radha approached and gave him bliss. This is understood.

### 12

*madhuripur adya vasante \|*  
*khelati gokula-yuvatibhir ujjvala-puṣpa-sugandha-dig-ante \|\| dhruva \|\|*

**Перевод:**

**Krsna today plays with the gopis in the spring, fragrant in all directions with flowers.**

**Комментарий:**

The raga is vasanta. The poet describes the spring pastimes of Krsna. The meaning is clear.

### 13

*prema-karambita-rādhā-cumbita-mukha-vidhur utsava-śālī \|*  
*dhṛta-candrāvali-cāru-karāṅgulir iha nava-campaka-mālī \|\|*  
*nava-śaśi-rekhā-likhitaviśākhā-tanur atha lalitā-saṅgī \|*  
*śyāmalayāśrita-bāhur udañcita-padmā-vibhrama-raṅgī \|\|*  
*bhadrālambita-śaivyodīrita-rakta-rajo-bhara-dhārī \|*  
*paśya sanātana-mūrtir ayaṁ ghana-vṛndāvana-ruci-kārī \|\|*

**Перевод:**

**Krsna, with moon-like face kisses Radha, endowed with prema. He is joyful. He holds the attractive fingers of Candravali. He wears a campaka garland. He marks the body of Visakha with lines of the crescent moon. He associates with Lalita. He places his arm on Syamala. He happily performs pastimes with Padma. He bears the red powder thrown by Bhadra and Saibya. Look! The eternal form gives great pleasure to Vrndavana.**

**Комментарий:**

His pastimes with named gopis is described. Krsna, with moonlike face kissed Radha, endowed with prema. The next items are clear. He marked the limbs, the breasts of Visakha with lines like the crescent moon. He became joyful in pastimes with Padma. He has on his body the red power thrown by Saibya and Bhadra. He has an eternal body, or his body is the object of meditation of Sanatana.

### 14

*ṛturājārpita-toṣa-taraṅgam \|*  
*rādhe bhaja vṛndāvanaṁ-raṅgam \|\| dhruva \|\|*

**Перевод:**

**О Radha! Partake of the joy of Vrndavana, with waves of joy offered by spring.**

**Комментарий:**

The raga is vasanta. Krsna, producing attraction for the spring pastimes, speaks to Radha. О Radha! Partake of the pleasure of Vrndavana. The pleasures are described. They have waves of happiness offered by spring. This is the chorus.

### 15

*malayānila-guru-śikṣita-lāsyā \|*  
*naṭati latā-tatir ujjvala-hāsyā \|\|*  
*pika-tatir iha vādayati mṛdaṅgam \|*  
*paśyati taru-kulam aṅkurad aṅgam \|\|*  
*gāyati bhṛṅga-ghaṭādbhuta-śīlā \|*  
*mama vaṁśīva sanātana-līlā \|\|*

**Перевод:**

**The creepers with blossoming smiles dance, having been taught by their guru, the Malaya wind. The cuckoos singing, play mrdangas. The sprouting trees watch. The astonishing bees sing like my flute, endowed with eternal pastimes.**

**Комментарий:**

He shows the entrance to spring. All the creepers dance. They are described. They have been taught by the Malaya breeze, their guru. They have smiles in the form of bright flowers. The cuckoos play drums in the form of their singing. The sprouting trees watch the musical festival. The astonishing bees sing like flutes.

The flute performs eternal pastimes.

### 16

*viharati saha rādhikayā raṅgī \|*  
*madhu-madhure vṛndāvana-rodhasi harir iha harṣa-taraṅgī \|\| dhruva \|\|*

**Перевод:**

**Happy Krsna, with waves of joy, plays with Radhika on the banks sweet with spring in Vrndavana.**

**Комментарий:**

The raga is vasanta. The author speaks of pastimes with Radha who is attracted to the spring pastimes. Rahgi means joyous.

### 17

*vikirati yantreritam agha-vairiṇi rādhā kuṅkuma-paṅkam \|*  
*dayitāmayam api siñcati mṛgamada-rasa-rāśibhir aviśaṅkam \|\|*  
*kṣipati mitho yuva-mithunam idaṁ navam aruṇataraṁ paṭavāsam \|*  
*jitam iti jitam iti muhur api jalpati kalpayad-atanu-vilāsam \|\|*  
*subalo raṇayati ghana-kara-tālī jitavān iti vanamālī \|*  
*lalitā vadati sanātana-vallabham ajayat paśya mamālī \|\|*

**Перевод:**

**Radha sprinkles liquid kunkuma from a syringe on Krsna. Krsna sprinkles Radha with abundant musk liquid fearlessly. The young couple throws red powder on each other. Performing pastimes of Cupid, they each say, “I won. I won.” Subala claps his hands, saying, “Krsna won.” Lalita speaks to the eternal cowherd. “Look! My friend has won.”**

**Комментарий:**

Radha sprinkles kunkuma liquid from a syringe on Krsna. This corresponds to her color. And he sprinkles liquid musk on her. This corresponds to his color. He sprinkles fearlessly. After using syringes, they throw powder. They throw fragrant red power at each other. Sticking to the kunkuma and musk, a special beauty arises. They say, “I won.” Subala, Krsna’s priya-narma-sakha claps his hands. The rest is clear.

### 18

*rādhā sakhi jala-keliṣu nipuṇā \|*  
*khelati nija-kuṇḍe madhuripuṇā \|\| dhruva \|\|*

**Перевод:**

**O friend! Radha, skillful at water sports, plays with Krsna in her kunda.**

**Комментарий:**

The raga is dhanasri. After the spring pastimes, the water pastimes are described. Servants on the shore speak. O friend! At her pond Radha plays with Krsna. She is skillful at water play.

### 19

*kuca-paṭa-luṇṭhana-nirmita-kalinā \|*  
*āyudha-padavī-yojita-nalinā \|\|*  
*dṛḍha-parirambhaṇa-cumbana-haṭhinā \|*  
*hima-jala-secana-karmaṇi kaṭhinā \|\|*  
*sukha-bhara-śithila-sanātana-mahasā \|*  
*dayita-parājaya-lakṣaṇa-sahasā \|\|1\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**Radha, with lotus as a weapon, plays with Krsna, who fights to plunder her bodice. Radha, merciful in splashing him with water plays with Krsna, who tries to embrace and kiss her. Radha, smiling from victory over her lover, plays with Krsna, whose eternal valor trembles from great happiness.**

**Комментарий:**

These are descriptions of Krsna and Radha alternately.

He fights (kalina) to plunder her bodice. She makes weapons out of lotuses. She beats him with lotuses. He forcefully embraces and kisses her. She mercilessly splashes him with cold water. He has eternal valiant acts trembling with happiness on touching Radha’s limbs. Or he has valiant acts described by Sanatana. She laughs on seeing Krsna defeated and inactive. She laughs, saying, “How have your powers become disgraced today?”

### 20

*rādhe nija-kuṇḍa-payasi tuṅgīkuru raṅgam \|*  
*kiṁ ca siñca piñcha-mukuṭam aṅgīkṛta-bhaṅgam \|\| dhruva \|\|*

**Перевод:**

**О Radha! Increase your pastimes in the water of your kunda. Sprinkle Krsna, with peacock crown, as he flees.**

**Комментарий:**

The raga is dhanasrl. Rangam means joy or pastimes. Sprinkle Krsna with a peacock feather crown who flees (angikrta-bhangam). Take this opportunity. This is the chorus.

### 21

*asya paśya phulla-kusuma-racitojjvala-cūḍā \|*  
*bhītibhir atinīla-niviḍa-kuntalam anu gūḍhā \|\|*  
*dhātu-racita-citra-vīthir ambhasi parilīnā \|*  
*mālāpy atiśithila-vṛttir ajani bhṛṅga-hīnā \|\|*  
*śrī-sanātana-sumaṇi-ratnam aṁśubhir api caṇḍam \|*  
*bheje pratibimba-bhāva-dambhī tava gaṇḍam \|\|*

**Перевод:**

**Look! His shining crown made of blossoming flowers hides in his thick black locks out of fear. His patterns made of minerals have dissolved in the water. His garland, devoid of bees, has become slack. His Kaustubha jewel, fierce with rays, on the pretext of a reflection, worships your cheek.**

**Комментарий:**

“How is Krsna, very strong, perceived when he flees?” He has a head ornament made of flowers. It hides in his thick locks of hair out of fear. With the defeat of their master, his associates also hide. His patterns made of mineral dyes have dissolved in the water. The next line is clear. Sumani-ratnarn is the Kaustubha jewel of Krsna (sanatana). It has rays difficult to behold. On the pretext of a reflection it worships your cheek. Look! Who will doubt your victory over Krsna? After playing in the water, the couple dressed and put on ornaments, and after eating sweets at Lalitananda-da bower, slept happily on a jeweled bed.

Will not the great devotees, knowers of bhava give mercy to Vidyabhusana, who has with effort explained the forty-one gathas written by Rupa.

## śrī lalitā-praṇāma-stotram

*śrīlalitāyai namaḥ*

**Перевод:**

**I offer respects to Sri Lalita.**

### Text 1

*rādhā-mukunda pada-sambhava-dharma-bindu-*  
*nirmañchanopakaraṇī-kṛta deha-lakṣām \|*  
*uttuṅga-sauhṛda-viśeṣa-vaśāt pragalbhāṁ*  
*devīṁ guṇaiḥ sulalitāṁ lalitāṁ namāmi \|\|1\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**I offer respects to beautiful Lalita graced with good qualities, who uses her body to remove the perspiration from the feet of Radha and Krsna, who is bold because of her strong friendship mixed with possessiveness.**

**Комментарий:**

*naumi śrīlalitāṁ devīṁ lalitāṁ guṇarāśibhiḥ \|*  
*rādhikāmādhavau yasyā bhavetāmāśrayau sadā \|\|*

I praise Lalita devi, beautiful with many good qualities whose shelter is always Radha and Madhava.

I offer respects to Lalita devi. She is described. Her body serves in the worship of the drops of perspiration from the lotus feet of Radha and Mukunda. She engages her body in removing their perspiration caused by their exertion. She is bold because of being under the control of very strong friendship special because of being mixed with possessiveness.

### Text 2

*rākā-sudhā-kiraṇa-maṇḍala-kānti-daṇḍi*  
*tuṇḍa-śriyaṁ cakita-cāru camūru-netrām \|*  
*rādhā-prasādhana-vidhāna-kalā-prasiddhāṁ*  
*devīṁ guṇaiḥ sulalitāṁ lalitāṁ namāmi \|\|2\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**I offer respects to beautiful Lalita graced with good qualities, whose beautiful face conquers the beauty of the full moon, whose eyes are like those of a frightened, attractive deer, who is famous for her skill in decorating Radha.**

**Комментарий:**

The beauty of her face punishes the beauty of the disk of the full moon. She has the eyes of a frightened, attractive deer. She is famous for her art of decorating Radha. She is famous for her skill in decorating Radha.

### Text 3

*lāsyollasad-bhujaga-śatru-patatra-citra-*  
*paṭṭāṁśukābharaṇa-kañculikāñcitāṅgīm \|*  
*gorocanā-ruci-vigarhaṇa gaurimāṇaṁ*  
*devīṁ guṇaiḥ sulalitāṁ lalitāṁ namāmi \|\|3\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**I offer respects to beautiful Lalita graced with good qualities, whose limbs are worshipped by a bodice, ornaments, and cloth colorful like peacock with his tail spread while dancing, and whose golden complexion derides the lust of gorocana.**

**Комментарий:**

Her limbs are worshipped (ancita) by a very colorful bodice, ornaments like a simanta jewel, and cloth colorful like peacock with his tail spread while dancing. Her complexion is golden, deriding the luster of gorocana.

### Text 4

*dhūrte vrajendra-tanaye tanu suṣṭhu-vāmyaṁ*  
*mā dakṣiṇā bhava kalaṅkini lāghavāya \|*  
*rādhe giraṁ śṛṇu hitām iti śikṣayantīṁ*  
*devīṁ guṇaiḥ sulalitāṁ lalitāṁ namāmi \|\|4\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**I offer respects to beautiful Lalita graced with good qualities, who instructs, “O Radha, О moon! Do not comply with the rascal, the son of Nanda. Show him crookedness. He will treat your compliance lightly. Hear these beneficial words.”**

**Комментарий:**

О Radha, О moon! Do not comply with the rascal, the son of Nanda. Show him crookedness. He will treat your compliance lightly. Hear these beneficial words from me. She teaches Radha in this way.

### Text 5

*rādhām abhi-vraja-pateḥ kṛtam ātmajena*  
*kūṭaṁ manāg api vilokya vilohitākṣīm \|*  
*vāg-bhaṅgibhis tam acireṇa vilajjayantīṁ*  
*devīṁ guṇaiḥ sulalitāṁ lalitāṁ namāmi \|\|5\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**I offer respects to beautiful Lalita graced with good qualities, whose eyes redden on seeing a little cheating done by Krsna to Radha, who immediately shames him by sarcastic words.**

**Комментарий:**

Her eyes redden on seeing a little cheating (kutam) done by the son of Nanda to Radha. This means she is angry. She immediately shames him with sarcastic words like “You are truthful, sincere, pure and affectionate.”

### Text 6

*vātsalya-vṛnda-vasatiṁ paśupāla-rājñyāḥ*  
*sakhyānuśikṣaṇa-kalāsu guruṁ sakhīnām \|*  
*rādhā-balāvaraja jīvita-nirviśeṣāṁ*  
*devīṁ guṇaiḥ sulalitāṁ lalitāṁ namāmi \|\|6\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**I offer respects to beautiful Lalita graced with good qualities, who is the object of Yasoda’s motherly affection, who is the guru for the sakhis, teaching them the art of friendship, who considers Radha and Krsna to be her very life.**

**Комментарий:**

She is the abode of Yasoda’s motherly affection. She is the guru for the arts of teaching the sakhis like Visakha about friendship. She teaches the methods of establishing friendship. She considers her life to be Radha and Krsna (nirvisesa).

### Text 7

*yāṁ kām api vraja-kule vṛṣabhānujāyāḥ*  
*prekṣya sva-pakṣa-padavīm anuruddhyamānām \|*  
*sadyas tad iṣṭa-ghaṭanena kṛtārthayantīṁ*  
*devīṁ guṇaiḥ sulalitāṁ lalitāṁ namāmi \|\|7\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**I offer respects to beautiful Lalita graced with good qualities, whose desires were suddenly fulfilled on seeing some girl obediently engaged in Radha’s service in Vraja.**

**Комментарий:**

Her desires were fulfilled (ista-ghatanena krtarthayantlm) seeing a girl engaged (ruddhyamanam) in Radha’s group in Vraja.

### Text 8

*rādhā-vrajendra-suta-saṅgama-raṅga-caryāṁ*  
*varyāṁ viniścitavatīm akhilotsavebhyaḥ \|*  
*tāṁ gokula-priya-sakhī-nikuramba-mukhyāṁ*  
*devīṁ guṇaiḥ sulalitāṁ lalitāṁ namāmi \|\|8\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**I offer respects to beautiful Lalita graced with good qualities, who ensures that the pastime of Radha and Krsna meeting is superior to all other festivals, and who is the chief among all the dear sakhis of Gokula.**

**Комментарий:**

She ascertains that the pastimes of meeting of Radha and Krsna are superior to all other festivals. She endeavors to see that this happens. The rest is clear.

### Text 9

*nandann amūni lalitā-guṇa-lālitāni*  
*padyāni yaḥ paṭhati nirmala-dṛṣṭir aṣṭau \|*  
*prītyā vikarṣati janaṁ nija-vṛnda-madhye*  
*taṁ kīrtidā-pati-kulojjvala-kalpa-vallī \|\|9\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**The desire creeper of Vrsabhanu’s family attracts that person who with pure vision, joyfully recites these eight verses beautiful with Lalita’s qualities and places him among her group.**

**Комментарий:**

The result of reciting the astaka is stated. One should read the verses made beautiful by describing the qualities of Lalita. The desire creeper of Vrsabhanu’s family, Radha, attracts that person. She can award the desired result.

## yamunāṣṭakam vā viśākhā-stotram

*śrīyamunāyai namaḥ*

**Перевод:**

**I offer respects to Yamuna.**

### Text 1

*bhrātur antakasya pattane ’bhipatti-hāriṇī*  
*prekṣayāti-pāpino ’pi pāpa-sindhu-tāriṇī \|*  
*nīra-mādhurībhir apy aśeṣa-citta-bandhinī*  
*māṁ punātu sarvadāravinda-bandhu-nandinī \|\|1\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**May the daughter of the sun, who prevents people from attaining the city of her brother death, who delivers the most sinful from the ocean of sin by being seen, who binds the hearts of all beings by the beauty of her water, purify me always.**

**Комментарий:**

*viśākhorasi yā viṣṇoryasyāṁ viṣṇurjalātmani \|*  
*nityaṁ nimajjati prītyā tāṁ saurīṁ yamunāṁ stumaḥ \|\|*

I praise Yamuna, daughter of the sun, in whom Visnu always bathes with affection, who, as Visakha, is on the chest of Visnu.

Visakha should be praised with a stotra. She is equal to the Yamuna. This is proved in the verses.

May the daughter (nandini) of the sun (aravinda-bandhu), Yamuna, purify me always. She is described. She saves one from attaining (abhipatti-hdrini) the city of her elder brother Yamaraja. It is said in Yamuna-stora that she is skillful at delivering those who surrender. By seeing her, she delivers the most sinful from the ocean of great sin. She destroys their sins. In Yamuna-stotra it is said that she is the doctor for mahapataka. She controls hearts of all men and devatas by the beauty of her water.

### Text 2

*hāri-vāri-dhārayābhimaṇḍitoru-khāṇḍavā*  
*puṇḍarīka-maṇḍalodyad-aṇḍajāli-tāṇḍavā \|*  
*snāna-kāma-pāmarogra-pāpa-sampad-andhinī*  
*māṁ punātu sarvadāravinda-bandhu-nandinī \|\|2\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**May the daughter of the sun, who decorates Khandava forest with her attractive streams, who causes birds to dance in her white lotuses, who destroys quantities of fierce sin which degenerates simply by their desire to bathe in her waters, purify me always.**

**Комментарий:**

She decorated the huge Khandava forest with her attractive currents. Among her white lotuses, flocks of birds dance. She diminishes the piles of intense sin of low persons who desire to bathe in her water. Just by the desire to bathe in her waters great sins are destroyed.

### Text 3

*śīkarābhimṛṣṭa-jantu-durvipāka-mardinī*  
*nanda-nandanāntaraṅga-bhakti-pūra-vardhinī \|*  
*tīra-saṅgamābhilāṣi-maṅgalānubandhinī*  
*māṁ punātu sarvadāravinda-bandhu-nandinī \|\|3\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**May the daughter of the sun, who destroys the jivas’ karmas by a drop of her water, who increases raga bhakti for Krsna, who produces auspiciousness for those just desire to live on her banks, purify me always.**

**Комментарий:**

She destroys the bad karma (durvipaka) of living entities who have touched her water drops (sikara). Aihara means drop of water according to Amara-kosa.

She increases streams of raga (antaranga) bhakti for the son of Nanda. She produces auspiciousness for persons who merely desire to live on her bank, without even living there.

### Text 4

*dvīpa-cakravāla-juṣṭa-sapta-sindhu-bhedinī*  
*śrī-mukunda-nirmitoru-divya-keli-vedinī \|*  
*kānti-kandalībhir indranīla-vṛnda-nindinī*  
*māṁ punātu sarvadāravinda-bandhu-nandinī \|\|4\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**May the daughter of the sun who surpasses the seven oceans endowed with seven islands, who reveals the attractive pastimes performed by Krsna, who criticizes the blue lotuses by her black beauty, purify me.**

**Комментарий:**

She pierces the seven oceans served by the seven islands. Yamuna-stotra says that she associates with the seven oceans. She rolls over them like a wheel and does not merge into the oceans like rivers. She has inconceivable power. She reveals the attractive pastimes manifested by Mukunda. She reveals his pastimes. The next line is clear. In Yamuna-stotra it is said that her color is dark like a blue lotus. Logicians will speculate that actually the water is white in color since by throwing it in the air it is seen to be white and that though water is actually white in color, by contacting the black earth, Yamuna water seems to be black. But that is refuted here, since inconceivable matters are not subject to material logic. Yamuna-stotra says that the water of the Yamuna is black. Water thrown in the air is seen to be white, but one could say that this was caused by light from the stars.

### Text 5

*māthureṇa maṇḍalena cāruṇābhimaṇḍitā*  
*prema-naddha-vaiṣṇavādhva-vardhanāya paṇḍitā \|*  
*ūrmi-dor-vilāsa-padmanābha-pāda-vandinī*  
*māṁ punātu sarvadāravinda-bandhu-nandinī \|\|5\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**May the daughter of the sun, who is decorated with attractive Mathura district, who is skillful at increasing raganuga bhakti, who offers respects to the feet of Krsna with her waves acting as arms, purify me.**

**Комментарий:**

By her beauty she decorates other mountains, towns and forests.

She is decorated with attractive Mathura. She attains beauty by that. She is skillful at spreading the tradition of raganuga bhakti (prema-naddha-vaisnavadhva). This means that by bathing in her, that bhakti manifests on its own. She bows down to the feet of Krsna by the movements of her waves which are arms. Sukadeva says:

*nadyastadā tadupadhārya mukundagītamāvartalakṣitamanobhavabhagnavegāḥ \| āliṅganasthagitamūrmibhujairmurāregṛhṇanti pādakamalaṁ kamalopahārāḥ \|\|*

**When the rivers hear the flute-song of Krsna, their minds begin to desire him, and thus the flow of their currents is broken and their waters are agitated, moving around in whirlpools. Then with the arms of their waves the rivers embrace Murari’s lotus feet and, holding on to them, present offerings of lotus flowers. (SB 10.21.15)**

### Text 6

*ramya-tīra-rambhamāṇa-go-kadamba-bhūṣitā*  
*divya-gandha-bhāk-kadamba-puṣpa-rāji-rūṣitā \|*  
*nanda-sūnu-bhakta-saṅgha-saṅgamābhinandinī*  
*māṁ punātu sarvadāravinda-bandhu-nandinī \|\|6\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**May the daughter of the sun, who is decorated with herds of mooing cows on both her attractive banks, who is endowed with rows of flowering, scented kadamba trees, who is joyous with the association of Krsna’s devotees, purify me.**

**Комментарий:**

She is decorated with herds of mooing cows on both her attractive banks.

She is endowed (riisita) with rows of flowering kadamba trees having attractive scent. She becomes joyous on associating with the devotees of Nanda’s son.

### Text 7

*phulla-pakṣa-mallikākṣa-haṁsa-lakṣa-kūjitā*  
*bhakti-viddha-deva-siddha-kinnarāli-pūjitā \|*  
*tīra-gandhavāha-gandha-janma-bandha-randhinī*  
*māṁ punātu sarvadāravinda-bandhu-nandinī \|\|7\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**May the daughter of the sun, resounding with thousands of joyous swans, served by groups of devatas intent on serving the Lord, who destroys the bondage of birth by the touch of a particle of wind from her bank, purify me.**

**Комментарий:**

She resounds with thousands of joyous swans. Mallikaksa is a swan with grey face and legs according to Halayudha. This represents other types of swans also.

She is served by groups of devatas intent on serving the Lord tyhakti-viddha). She destroys bondage to birth by the small touch (gandhd) of the wind from her banks. Gandha-vahdh means wind according to Amara-kosa. Gandha means a particle according to Haima.

### Text 8

*cid-vilāsa-vāri-pūra-bhūr-bhuvaḥ-svar-āpinī*  
*kīrtitāpi durmadoru-pāpa-marma-tāpinī \|*  
*ballavendra-nandanāṅgarāga-bhaṅga-gandhinī*  
*māṁ punātu sarvadāravinda-bandhu-nandinī \|\|8\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**May the daughter of the sun, who surpasses the three worlds with her spiritual water, who is glorified, who burns the essence of the greatest sins, who is scented with the remnants of Krsna’s cosmetics, purify me.**

**Комментарий:**

She attains the three worlds by her flow of spiritual water. She crosses the three worlds just as she surpasses the seven oceans. In Yamuna-stotra it is said she is spiritual (brahmi) and full of spiritual knowledge (.brahma-vidya). She is glorified. She burns the sources of great sin (durmada). Yamuna-stotra says she burns (tapini). She is fragrant with the fragments of cosmetics like catuhsama of Krsna (when he plays in the water).

### Text 9

*tuṣṭa-buddhir aṣṭakena nirmalormi-ceṣṭitāṁ*  
*tvām anena bhānu-putri sarva-deva-veṣṭitām \|*  
*yaḥ stavīti vardhayasva sarva-pāpa-mocane*  
*bhakti-pūram asya devi puṇḍarīka-locane \|\|9\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**O Yamuna! O shining one! Increase the raga bhakti to lotuseyed Krsna, who destroys all sins for the person who, with satisfied mind, praises you, active with pure waves, surrounded by devatas, by reciting this astaka.**

**Комментарий:**

The author prays for the result, prema for Krsna, for the reciter of the poem.

O daughter of the sun, Sri Yamuna! For the person satisfied in mind who praises you by this astaka, increase the raga bhakti for Krsna with lotus eyes. Krsna is described. He removes sin up to ignorance (sarva-papa-mocane). O shining one (devi)! Yamuna is described. She has actions which are pure waves. She is surrounded by all devatas.

The meter is tilnakam.

Yamunastaka has been explained.

## śrī mathurā-stavaḥ

*śrī-mathurāyai namaḥ*

**Перевод:**

**I offer respects to Mathura.**

### Text 1

*mukter govinda-bhakter vitaraṇa-caturaṁ saccidānanda-rūpaṁ*  
*yasyāṁ vidyoti vidyā-yugalam udayate tārakaṁ pārakaṁ ca \|*  
*kṛṣṇasyotpatti-līlā-khanir akhila-jagan-mauli-ratnasya sā te*  
*vaikuṇṭhoru pratiṣṭhā prathayatu mathurā maṅgalānāṁ kalāpam \|\|1\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**May Mathura, in which two types of knowledge—taraka and paraka—forms of sac-cid-ananda, skillful at bestowing liberation and Govinda-bhakti—manifest and shine, which is the basis of Vaikuntha, which is a mine of the birth pastimes of Krsna, who is the jewel in the crown of the universe, bestow heaps of auspiciousness to you.**

**Комментарий:**

О Mathura devi! I write this commentary on your profound stava for pleasure.

Deliver me, most sinful. You are glorified as merciful, strong and active.

The author praises Mathura. May Mathura bestow heaps of auspiciousness to you. Its qualities which have the ability to spread out are described. Its two types of knowledge—taraka and paraka always manifest. These are described. It is skillful at giving in sequence liberation (takara) and bhakti to Govinda (paraka). Since Mathura is a form of the parasakti, it has a sac-cid-ananda form. It shines everywhere (vidyoti). This means it is capable of destroying avidya. It is said in Padma Purana, Patala-khanda:

*ukto'dbhutaśca mahimā mathurāyā jaṭādhara \|*  
*munerbhuvo vā saritaḥ prabhāvaḥ kena vā vibho \|\|*  
*kṛṣṇasya vā prabhāvo'yaṁ saṁyogasya pratāpavān \|*

**O Siva! You have spoken of the astonishing glories of Mathura. Is it because of the power of its sages, earth or rivers? Is it because of the great power of Krsna there?**

*ṛṣīṇāṁ vā prabhāvaśca prabhāvo viṣṇutārake \|*  
*tathā pārakacicchakterubhe tatpudakārake \|\|*

**It is because of power of Visnu’s taraka-sakti. It is also because of his paraka-sakti. These two allow one to attain his abode.**

Asked by Parvati, Siva speaks:

*na bhūmikāprabhāvaśca sarito vā varānane \|*  
*tadeva śṛṇu bho devi prabhāvo yena vartate \|\|*

**O Parvati! It is not from the power of earth, rivers or sages.**

**Please listen, O devi! Please hear about their powers.**

*na bhūmikāprabhāvaśca sarito vā varānane \|*  
*tadeva śṛṇu bho devi prabhāvo yena vartate \|\|*  
*śrī-kṛṣṇa-mahimā-sarvacicchakteryaḥ pravartate \|*  
*tārakaṁ pārakaṁ tasya prabhāvo yamamāhataḥ \|*  
*tārakājjāyate muktiḥ premabhaktistu pārakāt \|\|*

**All Krsna’s powers arise from his cit-sakti. The power of the taraka and pdraka mantras is unlimited. Taraka produces liberation and Pdraka produces prema.**

Mathura is further described in the third line (it is the place of Krsna’s birth pastimes).

*mathureti suvikhyātā tasminkṣetraṁ paraṁ mama \|*

**О sinless earth! Hear that I will say in truth. The place called Mathura is famous.**

*suramyā ca suśamyā ca janmabhūmiḥ priyā mama \|\|*

**My dear birth place is attractive and auspicious.**

*sarveṣāṁ devi tīrthānāṁ mādhuraṁ paramaṁ mahat \|*  
*kṛṣṇena krīḍitaṁ yatra tacca śuddhaṁ pade pade \|\|*

**О devil Mathura is supreme among all tirthas. There Krsna performed pure pastimes at every step. (Adi-varaha Purana)**

Krsna is described. He is jewel in the crown (Brahma and Siva, etc.) of the whole universe. He is the lord, being worn like a jewel on their heads. Mathura is described. It is the basis of Vaikuntha.

*aho madhupurī dhanyā vaikuṇṭhācca garīyasī \|*  
*dinamekaṁ nivāsena punarjanma na vidyate \|\|*

**Mathura, most auspicious, is greater than Vaikuntha. By living there for one day one no longer takes birth.**

*evaṁ saptapurīṇāṁ tu sarvotkṛṣṭaṁ tu māthuram \|*  
*śrūyatāṁ mahimā devi vaikuṇṭhabhuvanottama \|\|*

**О devil Mathura is the best of the seven cities. You should hear the glories of Mathura, superior to Vaikuntha. (Padma Purana, Patala-khanda)**

By this, the powers of Mathura’s land and rivers are not rejected (na bhumikaprabhavasca sarito va varanane), since the power of these two are indicated here. As well the power of the place (bhumi) is indicated in suramya ca susamya ca janmabhumih

priya mama, and their powers is increased by being under the shelter of taraka and paraka saktis.

### Text 2

*koṭīndu-spaṣṭa-kāntī rabhasa-yuta-bhava-kleśa-yaudher ayodhyā*  
*māyā-vitrāsi-vāsā muni-hṛdaya-muṣo divya-līlāḥ stuvantī \|*  
*sāśīḥ kāśīśa-mukhyāmara-patibhir alaṁ prārthita-dvāra-kāryā*  
*vaikuṇṭhodgīta-kīrtir diśatu madhupurī prema-bhakti-śriyaṁ vaḥ \|\|2\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**May Mathura, more effulgent than a million moons, uncontrolled by the troops of aggressive material afflictions which steals the hearts of great sages, which manifests attractive pastimes, which fulfills the devotee’s desires, to whom Siva and others pray to become door keepers, whose glory is sung by Varaha, whose residents are feared by maya, bestow a wealth of prema-bhakti to you.**

**Комментарий:**

Having indicated the superiority of Mathura over other places since it is the place of Krsna’s pastimes from birth and gives prema, the author prays for his desired goal, prema-bhakti. May Mathura bestow the wealth of prema-bhakti to you. Mathura is described. Its effulgence clearly surpasses a million moons^ Koti means excellence in numbers according to Medinikara. It cannot be conquered by impulsive troops in the form of the material klesas. They cannot control the inhabitants since the inhabitants have the power of paraka. Living there frightens ignorance or the mdyavl devatas. Or those who create obstacles to the inhabitants have no power there. It steals the hearts of the sages such as Suka. It has attained the pastimes of Krsna (sravanti). It reveals Krsna’s pastimes. It fulfills the worshipper’s desires (saslh). Siva and other devatas pray to be its door keepers. Siva and others are its guards at the gates. Its famous qualities such as bestowing liberation are strongly stated by Varaha (vaikuntha).

Or Kanci (kantl) is only like the half moon. Mathura itself is like the full moon in comparison to Kanci. Ayodhya in the form

of Rama’s city is inferior with its armies. The ignorance of its inhabitants can be destroyed only with great difficulty. It cannot be conquered by long practice of taraka devoid of paraka, which is the cause of prema-bhakti. Living in Mathura frightens Haridvara (mayapuri). Living in Mathura is superior to living in Haridvara. In his activities at Avanti (Ujjain), Krsna who steals the hearts of sages, performed attractive pastimes such has living in the gurukula and gathering firewood. Siva, lord of Kasi, and others pray with desire (sasih) to be door keepers. Thus, it is different from Kasi. Mathura is respected (arya) by Dvaraka. Thus, it is praised by the Lord.

### Text 3

*bījaṁ muktitaror anartha-paṭalī-nistārakaṁ tārakaṁ*  
*dhāma prema-rasasya vāñchita-dhurā-saṁpārakaṁ pārakam \|*  
*etad yatra nivāsinām udayate cic-chakti-vṛtti-dvayaṁ*  
*mathnātu vyasanāni māthura-purī sā vaḥ śriyaṁ ca kriyāt \|\|3\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**May Mathura burn up your sins, including the subtle body and bestow a wealth of prema. In that place, for the inhabitants, there manifests two functions of the cit-sakti; taraka the seed of the tree of liberation, which destroys ignorance completely, and paraka which manifest the rasa of prema and brings one under the control of Krsna.**

**Комментарий:**

“Sacrifices do not give results of Svarga without desire. Mathura also will not give liberation without desire. Thus, it is impossible to get results without having material desire.” This verse answers.

May Mathura burn up your sins, including the subtle body and bestow a wealth of prema. Ability to perform both these acts is described. In Mathura, the two spiritual saktis manifest for the inhabitants. The cit-sakti or para-sakti of the Lord, in the form of two portions, sarhvit and hladini, is attained by the inhabitants.

Just as without desiring it when your hand goes in the fire one gets burned, so because the subtle body is destroyed, liberation is easily achieved. There is no harm in that. The two saktis are named: tarakam and pdrakam. Taraka has the six syllable mantra with Rama as the devata. It is described. It is the seed of the tree of liberation. It manifests liberation. “If one is bound up, how can one get liberated?” It destroys piles of anarthas. It destroys prakrti. Paraka has the eighteen syllable Krsna mantra. It is described. It reveals (dhama) prema rasa. It makes complete being controlled by Krsna (vanchita-dhura). In Padma Purana, Patala-khanda, the Lord says:

*ubhau mantrāvubhe nāmnī madīyaprāṇavallabhe \|*  
*nānā nāmāni mantrāśca tanmadhye sāramucyate \|\|*

**These two mantras and two names are dear to my life. Among various names and mantras these two are the essence.**

*ajñātamathavā jñātaṁ tārakaṁ japate yadi \|*  
*yatra tatra bhavenmṛtyuḥ kāśyāṁ tu phalamādiśet \|\|*

**If one utters the taraka mantra unknowingly or knowingly, he will attain the result of dying in Kasi, wherever he dies.**

*vartate yasya jihvāgre sa pumāṁllokapāvanaḥ \|*  
*chinatti sarvapāpāni kāśīvāsaphalaṁ labhet \|\|*

**The person who chants this mantra purifies the world, destroys all sin and attains the result of living in Kasi.**

*iti tārakamantro'yaṁ yastu kāśyāṁ pravartate \|*  
*sa eva māthure devi vartate'tra varānane \|\|*

**О beautiful Parvati! He who chants this mantra in Kasi actually lives in Mathura.**

*atha tārakamucyeta yathāmantraṁ yathāvalam \|*  
*pārakaṁ yatra varteta ru(ṛ)ddhisidvisamāgamaḥ \|\|*

**I will speak of the paraka mantra and its power. When the paraka mantra is chanted all prosperity and perfections follow.**

*pūjyo bhavati trailokye śatāyurjāyate pumān \|*  
*aṣṭasiddhisamāyukte vartate yatra pārakam \|\|*

**When a person chants this mantra, the person is worshipped in the three worlds and lives a hundred years. He attains eight siddhis.**

*pārakaṁ yasya jihvāgre tasya saṁtoṣavartitā \|*  
*paripūrṇo bhavetkāmaḥ satyasaṁkalpatā tathā \|\|*

**He who chants the paraka mantra becomes satisfied, is complete in his desires and attains anything he desires.**

*dvividhapremabhaktistu śrutaṁ dṛṣṭaṁ tathaiva ca \|*  
*akhaṇḍa-paramānandas tadgato jñeya-lakṣaṇaḥ \|\|*

**Two types of prema-bhakti are described and seen. Their characteristic should be understood to be continuous, intense bliss.**

*aśrupātaḥ kvacinnṛtyaṁ kvacitpremātivihalaḥ \|\|*

**Sometimes the person weeps, sometimes dances, sometimes becomes overwhelmed with prema.**

### Text 4

*adyāvanti patad-grahaṁ kuru kare māye śanair vījaya*  
*cchatraṁ kāñci gṛhāṇa kāśi purataḥ pādū-yugaṁ dhāraya \|*  
*nāyodhye bhaja sambhramaṁ stuti-kathāṁ nodgāraya dvārake*  
*devīyaṁ bhavatīṣu hanta mathurā dṛṣṭi-prasādaṁ dadhe \|\|4\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**О Avanti! Today hold the spittoon. О Haridvara! Fan gently. О Kanci! Hold the umbrella. О Kasi! Place the sandals in front. О Ayodhya! Do not worship with fear. О Dvaraka! Do not utter praises. The goddess Mathura gives a glance of mercy to you.**

**Комментарий:**

The superiority of Mathura to all other cities, because of its superiority to Vaikuntha, and being the abode of taraka and paraka, and being a mine of Krsna’s birth and other pastimes, is explained in a second verse.

О inhabitant of Avanti! Today keep in your hand the spittoon for betel nut. О Maya (Haridvara)! Today fan gently. О Kanci! Today hold an umbrella with a golden handle. О Kasi! Today place the two sandals in front. О Ayodhya! Today do not be fearful. О Dvaraka! Today do not utter praises. Because the goddess, bathed, the wife of the Lord, Mathura, famous for the good character and mercy, gives her glance of mercy to you. Pleased with your service she gives mercy. Hanta indicates joy. In Adi-varaha Parana it is said:

*kāśyādi-puryo yadi santi loke tāsāṁ tu madhye mathuraiva dhanyā \|*  
*yā janma-mauñjī-vrata-mṛtyu-dāhair nṛṇāṁ caturdhā vidadhāti mokṣam \|\|*

**Mathura is most auspicious among the cities like Kasi on earth. It bestows liberation of four types to human beings if one is born there, if one receives a sacred thread there, if one dies there or is burned there.**

*evaṁ sapta-purīṇāṁ tu sarvotkṛṣṭaṁ tu māthuram*

**О devi! Mathura is the best of the seven cities. (Padma Purana)**

Seeing Mathura to be similar to Avanti and other cities is a fault.

This is stated in Uttara-khanda:

*mathurāyāṁ prakurvanti purīsādhāraṇīdṛśam \|*  
*ye narāste tu vijñeyā pāparāśibhiranvitāḥ \|\|*

**Though learned, people who think that Mathura is an ordinary city accrue heaps of sins.**

The srutis also declare that Mathura is not touched by matter, being a form of the Lord.

*sākṣād brahma gopāla-puri*

**The city of Gopala is directly Brahman. (Gopdla-tapani Upanisad)**

*cakreṇa rakṣitā hi vai mathura tasmad gopala-puri bhavati*

**Protected by the cakra, Mathura, the city of Krsna, is the highest abode. (Gopala-tapanl Upanisad)**

Skanda Purana says:

*tan-maṇḍalaṁ māthuraṁ hi viṣṇu-cakropari sthitam \|*  
*padmākāraṁ sadā tatra vartate śāśvataṁ padam \|\| iti \|\|*

**O King! Mathura is situated on top of the Lord’s cakra. It exists eternally in the shape of a lotus.**

Thus Mathura-stava has been explained.

## prathamaṁ govardhanāṣṭakam

*namaḥ śrīgovardhanāya*

**Перевод:**

**I offer respects to Govardhana.**

### Text 1

*govindāsyottaṁsita vaṁśī-kvaṇitodyal-*  
*lāsyotkaṇṭhā-matta-mayūra-vraja-vīta \|*  
*rādhā-kuṇḍottuṅgataraṅgāṅkuritāṅga*  
*pratyāśāṁ me tvaṁ kuru govardhana pūrṇām \|\|1\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**О Govardhana, surrounded by groups of peacocks mad with enthusiastic dancing because of the sound of the flute ornamenting the face of Govinda! О Govardhana whose limbs sprout with green grass because of the high waves of Radha-kunda! Please fulfill my desires.**

**Комментарий:**

*yaḥ puṣṇandhavalāstṛṇodakabharairnetrāṇi ca prekṣiṇāṁ*  
*citrābhirmaṇikāntibhirharipadasparśātiharṣākulaḥ \|*  
*saṁcchindandṛṣadastibhiḥ pavimukhaṁ govardhanākhyām*  
*adhā taṁ vande nata vāñchitapradamahaṁ śailādhirājaṁ mudā \|\|*

I joyfully offer respects to the king of mountains, called Govardhana, which bestows desires, which nourishes the cows with abundant grass and water, which nourishes the eyes of the beholders with the colorful sparkle of gems, which is joyous with the touch of Krsna’s feet, which cuts all directions with its glances.

The author praises Govardhana. О Govardhana! Please fulfill my desires (pratyasam). О Govardhana, surrounded (vita) by groups of peacocks mad with enthusiastic dancing because of the sound of the flute ornamenting the face of Govinda! О Govardhana whose limbs sprout with green grass (ahkurita) because of the high waves of Radha-kunda.

### Text 2

*yasyotkarṣād vismita-dhībhir vraja-devī-*  
*vṛndair varyaṁ varṇitam āste haridāsyam \|*  
*citrair yuñjasta dyuti-puñjair akhilāśāṁ*  
*pratyāśāṁ me tvaṁ kuru govardhana pūrṇām \|\|2\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**O Govardhana, described by the gopis as the best of Krsna’s servants because of your excellence, flooding all directions with an abundance of colorful beauty! Please fulfill my desires.**

**Комментарий:**

The amazed gopis described you as the best servant of Krsna. You fill all directions with abundant beauty of artistry of moonstone, sapphire and ruby.

### Text 3

*vindadbhir yo mandiratāṁ kandara-vṛndaiḥ*  
*kandaiś cendor bandhubhir ānandayatīśam \|*  
*vaidūryābhair nirjhara-toyair api so’yaṁ*  
*pratyāśāṁ me tvaṁ kuru govardhana pūrṇām \|\|3\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**Govardhana is he who gives joy to Krsna by many caves equivalent to palaces, by roots pleasing as the moon, and by flowing water the color of vaidurya gems. O Govardhana! Please fulfill my desires.**

**Комментарий:**
