Govardhana gives bliss to Krsna and his friends (isam), welcoming him as a guest, by many caves like gem studded houses (mandiratam vindadbhih), by roots which are friends of the moon. This means the roots are bright and tasty. He gives bliss to Krsna by clear rivers the color of vaidurya gems.

The gopis say:

*hantāyamadrirabalā haridāsavaryo yadrāmakṛṣṇacaraṇa(?)sparśapramodaḥ \|*  
*mānaṁ tanoti saha gogaṇayostayoryatpānīyasūyavasakandarakandamūlaiḥ \|\|*

**Of all the devotees, this Govardhana Hill is the best! О my friends, this hill supplies Krsna and Balarama, along with their calves, cows and cowherd friends, with all kinds of necessities—water for drinking, very soft grass, caves, fruits, flowers and vegetables. In this way the hill offers respects to the Lord. Being touched by the lotus feet of Krsna and Balarama, Govardhana Hill appears very jubilant. (SB 10.21.18)**

### Text 4

*śaśvad-viśvālaṅkaraṇālaṅkṛtimedhyaiḥ*  
*premṇā dhautair dhātubhir uddīpita-sāno \|*  
*nityākrandat-kandara veṇu-dhvani-harṣāt*  
*pratyāśāṁ me tvaṁ kuru govardhana pūrṇām \|\|4\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**О Govardhana, bright with pure minerals washed with prema for decorating Krsna, ornament of the universe, and having caves filled with joyful sounds of bamboo! Please fulfill my desires.**

**Комментарий:**

You have plateaus bright with minerals like manahsila, which are yellow, red and blue. The minerals are pure (medhyaih) and are for always decorating the ornament of the universe, Krsna. Things related to the Lord are pure. Or medhya means “attained for decorating.” Medha means to unite according to Dhatu-patha. The minerals are washed with prema. Govardhana has caves which are always filled with the joy in the form of sounds of bamboo. This means Govardhana is always mad with prema for Krsna.

### Text 5

*prājyā rājir yasya virājaty upalānāṁ*  
*kṛṣṇenāsau santatam adhyāsita-madhyā \|*  
*so’yaṁ bandhur bandhur adharmā surabhīṇāṁ*  
*pratyāśāṁ me tvaṁ kuru govardhana pūrṇām \|\|5\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**Govardhana has many rows of rock slabs in whose center Krsna always sits. You are the friend of the cows and have attractive qualities. О Govardhana! Please fulfill my desires.**

**Комментарий:**

The plentiful (prajya) rows of rock slabs, in the middle of which Krsna always sits, shine. Asau means famous. Govardhana is friend of the cows since he nourishes them. He has splendid (bandhura) qualities.

### Text 6

*nirdhunvānaḥ saṁhṛti-hetuṁ ghana-vṛndaṁ*  
*jitvā jambhārātimasambhāvita-bādham \|*  
*svānāṁ vairaṁ yaḥ kila niryāpitavān saḥ*  
*pratyāśāṁ me tvaṁ kuru govardhana pūrṇām \|\|6\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**Conquering Indra who was impossible to impede, by destroying the many clouds causing destruction, you destroyed his enmity to your relatives. О Govardhana! Please fulfill my desires.**

**Комментарий:**

Conquering Indra (jambharatim) who was impossible to stop, you destroyed his enmity to all your relatives. “How is it possible that Govardhana conquered Indra?” You destroyed the many clouds sent by Indra for flooding the worlds.

### Text 7

*bibhrāṇo yaḥ śrī-bhuja-daṇḍopari-bhartuś*  
*chatrī-bhāvaṁ nāma yathārthaṁ svam akārṣīt \|*  
*kṛṣṇopajñaṁ yasya makhas tiṣṭhati so’yaṁ*  
*pratyāśāṁ me tvaṁ kuru govardhana pūrṇām \|\|7\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**You became an umbrella under the arm of Krsna and fulfilled the meaning of your name. Your sacrifice was invented by Krsna. О Govardhana! Please fulfill my desires.**

**Комментарий:**

You became an umbrella above the arm of Krsna (bhartuh) and made your name true (king of mountains). Chatri-bhavam means acting as an umbrella and a king, above whom an umbrella is held. Govardhana means one who increases the cows or words of praise or one who shatters the thunderbolt (go) of Indra meant for destroying Vraja. Vardhaka means to cut according to Kavi-kalpadruma. Govardhana’s sacrifice was invented (upajnd) by Krsna. Upajnam means “first known” according to the sutra, when neuter in gender.

### Text 8

*gāndharvāyāḥ keli-kalā-bāndhava kuñje*  
*kṣuṇṇais tasyāḥ kaṅkaṇa-hāraiḥ prayatāṅga \|*  
*rāsa-krīḍā-maṇḍitayopatyakayāḍhya*  
*pratyāśāṁ me tvaṁ kuru govardhana pūrṇām \|\|8\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**О assistant of Radha in artistic pastimes! О Govardhana, decorated with bracelets and necklaces of Radha which have fallen in the bower. О Govardhana, decorated with the rasa dance in your valley! Please fulfill my desires.**

**Комментарий:**

О assistant (bandhavah) of Radha in artistic pastimes! You are decorated (prayatanga) with the bracelets and necklaces of Radha which have fallen in the bower. In your valley the rasa dance takes place. Upatydka is a low area according to Amara-kosa.

### Text 9

*adro-śreṇī-śekhara padyāṣṭakam etat*  
*kṛṣṇāmbhoda-preṣṭha paṭhed yas tava dehī \|*  
*premānandaṁ tundilayan kṣipram amandaṁ*  
*taṁ harṣeṇa svīkurutāṁ te hṛdayeśaḥ \|\|9\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**О topmost mountain! О dear to the black raincloud! May Krsna, lord of your heart, quickly increasing great bliss of prema, accept as his own that jiva who recites your astaka with affection.**

**Комментарий:**

The author prays for results of reciting the astaka.

О topmost mountain! О dear to the black raincloud! May Krsna, lord of your heart, accept as his own that jiva who recites your astaka with affection. What does Krsna do? He nourishes quickly the abundant bliss of prana for himself. May this happen by your mercy.

*vedair andhair mraujagā mattamayūraḥ*

**111 Ils sll ssl 1 (ma, ta, ya, sa, gu) with caesura after the fourth (veda) and the ninth (randhra) syllable after that is called matta-mayura**

## dvitīyaṁ govardhanāṣṭakam

*sri-govardhanaya namah*

**Перевод:**

**I offer respects to Govardhana.**

### Text 1

*nīla-skandhojjvala-ruci-bharair maṇḍite bāhu-daṇḍe*  
*chatra-cchāyāṁ dadhad-agharipor labdha-saptāha-vāsaḥ \|*  
*dhārāpāta-glapita-manasāṁ rakṣitā gokulānāṁ*  
*kṛṣṇa-preyān prathayatu sadā śarma govardhano naḥ \|\|1\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**May Govardhana, who was the protector of Gokula’s people whose minds were exhausted from the rain, and who was beautiful as an umbrella, living for seven days over Krsna’s hand, decorated with the great shining beauty of his black shoulder, always bestow happiness to us.**

**Комментарий:**

May Govardhana always bestow happiness to us. It is described. He lived for seven days, having the beauty of an umbrella, over Krsna’s hand. Chaya means beauty according to Amara-kosa. Krsna’s hand is described. It decorated his dark shoulder, shining with beauty. The mountain is further described. It protected the people of Gokula whose minds were exhausted from the downpour.

### Text 2

*bhīto yasmād aparigaṇayan bāndhava-sneha-bandhān*  
*sindhāv adris tvaritam aviśat pārvatī-pūrvajo’pi \|*  
*yas taṁ jambha-dviṣam akuruta stambha-saṁbheda-śūnyaṁ*  
*sa prauḍhātmā prathayatu sadā śarma govardhano naḥ \|\|2\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**May bold hearted Govardhana, who deflated the pride of Indra, who made Mainaka, not considering the affection of other mountains, quickly disappeared in the ocean out of fear, always bestow happiness to us.**

**Комментарий:**

The elder brother of Parvati, Mainaka, afraid of Indra, not considering affectionate relationships with other mountains, disappeared in the ocean. Bold hearted, Govardhana made that Indra (sambha-dvisam) devoid of pride.

### Text 3

*āviṣkṛtya prakaṭa-mukuṭāṭopam aṅgaṁ sthavīyaḥ*  
*śailo’smīti sphuṭam abhidadhat tuṣṭi-visphāra-dṛṣṭiḥ \|*  
*yasmai kṛṣṇaḥ svayam arasayad ballavair dattam annaṁ*  
*dhanyaḥ so’yaṁ prathayatu sadā śarma govardhano naḥ \|\|3\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**May fortunate Govardhana, to whom the cowherds offered food which Krsna ate after he manifested a huge form with obvious pride, with eyes wide and clearly said, “I am the mountain,” always bestow happiness to us.**

**Комментарий:**

Krsna ate (arasayat) the four types of food offered to Govardhana by cowherds (ballavaih). What did Krsna do before eating? Manifesting a huge body (sthaviyah angam) with a show of pride (prakata-mukutatopam), he said clearly, “I am the mountain.” He became one with the mountain. He is further described. He had eyes wide (visphara) with satisfaction.

### Text 4

*adyāpy ūrja-pratipadi mahān bhrājate yasya yajñaḥ*  
*kṛṣṇopajñaṁ jagati surabhī-sairibhī-krīḍayāḍhyaḥ \|*  
*śaṣpālambottama-taṭayā yaḥ kuṭumbaṁ paśūnāṁ*  
*so’yaṁ bhūyaḥ prathayatu sadā śarma govardhano naḥ \|\|4\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**May Govardhana, whose great worship, including playing with cows and buffalos, on the first day of Kartika, is resplendent even today in the world, who became herds of cows, with slopes of fresh grass, always bestow happiness to us.**

**Комментарий:**

Even today on the first tithi of Kartika (urja), a sacrifice, a great ceremony of worship of Govardhan, invented by Krsna, shines. Ujra means Kartika month according to Amara-kosa. It includes (adhyah) playing with cows and buffalos (sairibht). Sairibha means a buffalo according to Halayudha. Govardhana, with excellent slopes supporting fresh green grass from the many cool streams, became the herd of cows.

### Text 5

*śrī-gāndharvā-dayita-sarasī-padma-saurabhya-ratnaṁ*  
*hṛtvā śaṅkotkara-para-vaśair asvanaṁ sañcaradbhiḥ \|*  
*ambhaḥ-kṣoda-praharika-kulenākulenānuyātair*  
*vātair yu(ju)ṣṭaḥ prathayatu sadā śarma govardhano naḥ \|\|5\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**May Govardhana, served by breezes which, having stolen the jewels of lotus perfume from the couple’s kundas and silently fleeing in fear, are attacked by agitated water drops which act as guardians of the kundas, always bestow happiness to us.**

**Комментарий:**

Govardhana is again described with more details. Govardhana is served by winds. The winds are described. Stealing the jewel of fragrance from the lotuses in Radha’s and Krsna’s kundas, the winds have great fear (sankotkara-para-vasair). Silently fleeing, they are attacked by groups of guards in the form of water drops (ambhah-ksoda), who are agitated (akulena). In fear of their masters they say, “They take these jewels, cheating us though we were alert.” The wind is fragrant because of the lotuses. It is gentle since it moves without noise. It is cool because of the water drops. It serves Govardhana, who is like a great king.

### Text 6

*kaṁsārātes tari-vilasitair ātarānaṅga-raṅgair*  
*ābhīrīṇāṁ praṇayam abhitaḥ pātram unmīlayantyāḥ \|*  
*dhauta-grāvāvalir amalinair mānasāmartya-sindhor*  
*vīci-vrātaiḥ prathayatu sadā śarma govardhano naḥ \|\|6\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**May Govardhana, whose stones are washed by the pure waves of Manasa Ganga, which manifests everywhere affection for Krsna and the gopis through boat pastimes with collecting fees out of love, always bestow happiness to us.**

**Комментарий:**

Govardhana is further described.

Its stones are washed by the many waves of Manasa Ganga (manasamartya-sindhoh). Amartya-sindhu means the devata’s Ganga. Sindhu means river according to Halayudha. The waves are described. They are pure, bright like milk (amalinaih). Manasa Ganga is described. It reveals everywhere affection for Krsna and the gopis by pastimes with a boat. Tan means boat according to Amara-kosa. The pastimes are described. They include amorous pastimes with paying taxes (atara). Atara means paying taxes according to Amara-kosa. There is a fee for crossing the water as a loving pastime. The affection is described. It is a support (patram) for Krsna bringing the gopis under his control. Or it is a means of drinking the sweetness of the pastime.

### Text 7

*yasyādhyakṣaḥ sakala-haṭhināmādade cakravartī*  
*śuklaṁ nānyad vraja-mṛga-dṛśām arpaṇād vigrahasya \|*  
*ghaṭṭasyoccair madhukara-rucas tasya dhāma-prapañcaiḥ*  
*śyāma-prasthaḥ prathayatu sadā śarma govardhano naḥ \|\|7\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**May Govardhana, having a plateau dark with the great beauty of a sapphire toll gate, whose owner is the king of rascals who does not accept anything except the gopis bodies as a tax, always bestow happiness to us.**

**Комментарий:**

Govardhana is further described. It has a plateau made dark by great beauty of toll station (ghattasya). The station is described. It is made of sapphire (madhukara-rucah). Whose station is this? It is owned by the best of the insistent. Its controller is Krsna. He does not accept any fee except the bodies of the gopis, who carry on their head milk for sacrifices, as they go on the path, to the place of sacrifice near Govinda kunda. He accepts their bodies as the tax.

### Text 8

*gāndharvāyāḥ surata-kalahoddāmatā-vāvadūkaiḥ*  
*klānta-śrotrotpala-valayibhiḥ kṣipta-piñchāvataṁsaiḥ*  
*kuñjais talpopari pariluṭhad-vaijayantī-parītaiḥ \|*  
*puṇyāṅga-śrīḥ prathayatu sadā śarma govardhano naḥ \|\|8\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**May Govardhana, whose body is beautiful with bowers manifesting Radha’s noisy love quarrels and strewn with withered ear ornaments and bracelets, with thrown off peacock feathers, with plundered Vaijayanti garland on the bed, always bestow happiness to us.**

**Комментарий:**

Its body is beautiful (punydriga-srih) with bowers. They are described. The bowers are noisy with the unrestrained quarrels of Radha during love. The scene is further described. The rest is clear.

### Text 9

*yas tuṣṭātmā sphuṭam anupaṭhec chraddhayā śuddhayāntar*  
*medhyaḥ padyāṣṭakam acaṭulaḥ suṣṭhu govardhanasya \|*  
*sāndraṁ govardhana-dhara-pada-dvandva-śoṇāravindaṁ*  
*vindan premotkaram iha karoty adri-rāje sa vāsam \|\|9\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**The person who with satisfied mind and pure heart, with pure faith, clearly recites this astaka concerning Govardhana, while sitting, attaining intense prema for the red lotus feet of Krsna, will live at Govardhana.**

**Комментарий:**

The author explains the results for the recite of this astaka: residence at Govardhana. The person who with pure faith recites this astaka with pure heart (antarmedhyah), while sitting down (acatulah), lives at Govardhana, enjoying intense prema at the red lotus feet of the lifter of Govardhana. By my blessing may he live there. Thus, the second astaka on Govardhana called that which gives bliss of living at Govardhana (sri-girindra-vasananda-da) has been explained.

## śrī-vṛndāvanāṣṭakam

*namaḥ śrīvṛndāvanāya*

**Перевод:**

**I offer respects to Vrndavana.**

### Text 1

*mukunda-muralī-rava-śravaṇa-phulla-hṛd-ballavī-*  
*kadambaka-karambita-prati-kadamba-kuñjāntarā \|*  
*kalinda-giri-nandinī-kamala-kandalāndolinā*  
*sugandhir anilena me śaraṇam astu vṛndāṭavī \|\|1\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**May Vrndavana, which has central kadamba forests filled with gopis whose hearts become joyful by the sound of Krsna’s flute, which is fragrant with breezes which sway groups of lotuses growing in the Yamuna, be my shelter.**

**Комментарий:**

О devi! Forgive my faults. Give me residence within your domain. Show a glance of mercy. With devotion I describe your pure stotra which produces love for Vrndavana.

The author praises Vrndavana. Vrndavana should give me shelter. Saranam can be analyzed as the place where sufferings are destroyed (slryante). May Vrndavana destroy all suffering up to the root of ignorance. Or may Vrndavana be my living place. It is described. It has in its center kadamba bowers endowed with groups of gopis whose hearts are joyful on hearing the sound of Krsna’s flute.

It is further described. It is made fragrant with wind. The wind is described. It sways groups of lotuses in the Yamuna. The breeze is gentle, fragrant and cooling.

### Text 2

*vikuṇṭha-pura-saṁśrayād vipinato’pi niḥśreyasāt*  
*sahasra-guṇitāṁ śriyaṁ praduhatī rasa-śreyasīm \|*  
*caturmukha-mukhair api spṛhita-tārṇadehodbhavā*  
*jagadgurubhir agrimaiḥ śaraṇam astu vṛndāṭavī \|\|2\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**May Vrndavana, which is filled with a wealth of rasa a thousand times greater than an auspicious forest of Vaikuntha, in which the principle gurus of the universe headed by Brahma desire to be born as grass, be my shelter.**

**Комментарий:**

It is filled with a wealth of rasa a thousand times greater than an auspicious forest of Vaikuntha. It has a wealth of bliss with four bhakti rasas of dasya, sakhya, vatsalya and madhurya. In the forest of Vaikuntha there are two rasas: santa and dasya. Madhura-rati is very rare. Thus, it is particularly great. Stimulated by these four ratis, Krsna remains with that forest by his beginningless sahkalpa-sakti. Krsna says in Brhad-gautamlya tantra:

*pañcayojanamevāsti vanaṁ me deharūpakam*

**That forest of five yojanas is a form of my body.**

Thus the gurus of the universe headed by Brahma desire to be born as grass in Vrndavana. Brahma says:

*tad bhūribhāgyamiha janma kimapyaṭavyāṁ*  
*yadgokule'pi katamāṅghrirajo'bhiṣekam*

**My greatest possible good fortune would be to take any birth whatever in this forest of Gokula and have my head bathed by the dust falling from the lotus feet of any of its residents. (SB 10.14.34)**

Uddhava says:

*āsāmaho caraṇareṇujuṣāmahaṁ syāṁ*  
*vṛndāvane kimapi gulmalatauṣadhīnām*

**“Oh, let me be fortunate enough to be one of the bushes, creepers or herbs in Vrndavana, because the gopis trample them and bless them with the dust of their lotus feet.” (SB 10.47.61)**

### Text 3

*anārata-vikasvara-vratati-puñja-puṣpāvalī-*  
*visāri-vara-saurabhodgama-ramā-camatkāriṇī \|*  
*amanda-makaranda-bhṛd-viṭapi-vṛnda-vṛndīkṛta-*  
*dvirepha-kula-vanditā śaraṇam astu vṛndāṭavī \|\|3\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**May Vrndavana, which astonishes Laksmi by the fragrance emanating from fine trees covered with creepers blossoming constantly with flowers, which is praised by swarms of bees which are respected by the huge groves with fine honey, be my shelter.**

**Комментарий:**

It is filled the beauty of flowers of all seasons. It astonishes Laksmi by production of fragrances from excellent forests spread with flowers on many creepers constantly blossoming. Anarata means constantly according to Amara-kosa. Laksmi, giving up the charm of forests in Vaikuntha, lives in Vraja out of desire for it.

*yadvāñchayā śrīlalanācarat tapo*  
*vihaya kdtnan su-cirath dhrta-vrata*

**Desiring to touch your lotus feet, the goddess of fortune performed austerities for centuries, giving up all other desires and taking austere vows. (SB 10.16.36)**

It is praised by swarms of bees which are praised by many trees loaded with excellent honey. The bees offer respects by wandering around and humming.

### Text 4

*kṣaṇa-dyuti-ghana-śriyor vraja-navīna-yūnoḥ padaiḥ*  
*suvalgubhir alaṅkṛtā lalita-lakṣma-lakṣmī-bharaiḥ \|*  
*tayor nakhara-maṇḍalī-śikhara-keli-caryocitair*  
*vṛtā kiśalayāṅkuraiḥ śaraṇam astu vṛndāṭavī \|\|4\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**May Vrndavana, which is decorated with the beautiful, finely marked feet of Radha and Krsna, who are like lightning and a cloud, and which is covered with buds and shoots which imitate the toenails of the couple, give me shelter.**

**Комментарий:**

The special nature of the forest with Radha and Krsna is shown. It is decorated with the feet of Radha and Govinda, the youthful couple. They are described. They have beauty like lightning and a cloud. Their feet are described. Their feet are very beautiful (suvalgubhih). They have great beauty with twenty-four and a half-moons, and foot marks like the umbrella. The forest is covered with buds and sprouts (kisalayankuraih). They are described. They are suitable to imitate the toenails of the couple.

### Text 5

*vrajendra-sakha-nandinī-śubhatarādhikāra-kriyā-*  
*prabhāvaja-sukhotsava-sphurita-jaṅgama-sthāvarā \|*  
*pralamba-damanānuja-dhvanita-vaṁśikā-kākalī-*  
*rasajña-mṛga-maṇḍalā śaraṇam astu vṛndāṭavī \|\|5\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**May Vrndavana, whose moving and nonmoving beings become joyful because of the two festivals of happiness manifested from their powers which are revealed by glorious actions of Vrnda and her assistants assigned by Radha, whose herds of deer know the fine rasa of the flute played by Krsna, be my shelter.**

**Комментарий:**

The couple is eternally situated there. Her moving and nonmoving beings are joyful because of the festivity and happiness arising from powers revealed by Vrnda served by thousands of forest devis, given incomparably glorious authority by Radha, daughter of Vrsabhanu. Vrndavana’s herds of deer know the fine (kakali) rasa of the sound of the flute played by Krsna, the younger brother of Balarama. Kakali means fine according to Amara-kosa. They have attained a state of continual joy.

### Text 6

*amanda-mudirāmbudābhyadhika-mādhurī-medura-*  
*vrajendra-suta-vīkṣaṇonnaṭita-nīlakaṇṭhotkarā \|*  
*dineśa-suhṛd-ātmajākṛta-nijābhimānollasal-*  
*latā-khaga-mṛgāṅganā śaraṇam astu vṛndāṭavī \|\|6\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**May Vrndavana, whose peacocks dance on seeing black Krsna, sweeter than fine clouds, whose birds, animals and creepers are joyous with Radha’s identification as Vrndavana’s ruler, be my shelter.**

**Комментарий:**

The author clarifies the eternal rulership of Vrndavana just mentioned. Her peacocks dance on seeing Krsna, shiny with condensed, dark beauty, sweeter than fine clouds. Mudira means clouds according to Amara-kosa. Her animals, birds, their mates, and creepers are joyful because of Radha’s identity with Vrndavana, where she thinks, “Vrndavana is mine.” The female birds, animals and creepers (which are female) are joyous because Radha, a woman is the ruler of Vrndavana.

### Text 7

*agaṇya-guṇa-nāgarī-gaṇa-gariṣṭha-gāndharvikā-*  
*manoja-raṇa-cāturī-piśuna-kuñja-puñjojjvalā \|*  
*jagat-traya-kalā-guror lalita-lāsya-valgat-pada-*  
*prayoga-vidhi-sākṣiṇī śaraṇam astu vṛndāṭavī \|\|7\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**May Vrndavana, which shines with abundant bowers which indicate the skill in amorous battles of Radha, who is made strong by women with countless qualities, and which is the witness of many methods of foot movements of Govinda, most skillful at arts in the three worlds as he attractively dances, be my shelter.**

**Комментарий:**

The excellence of Vrndavana as the shelter of the rasa dance is described.

It shines with many bowers indicating (pisuna) the skill in the love battles of Radha, who is strong with gopis of countless qualities. It is witness of many ways (prayoga-vidhi) of using the moving (yalgat) feet of Krsna, skillful at all arts, being the guru of arts for the three worlds, when he dances attractively.

### Text 8

*variṣṭha-haridāsa-tāpada-samṛddha-govardhanā*  
*madhūdvaha-vadhū-camatkṛti-nivāsa-rāsa-sthalā \|*  
*agūḍha-gahana-śriyo madhurima-vrajenojjvalā*  
*vrajasya sahajena me śaraṇam astu vṛndāṭavī \|\|8\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**May Vrndavana, having Govardhana, which is made successful by being the best servant of Krsna, having the rasa arena which astonishes the gopis by its beauty, shining bright with great sweetness along with Vraja village, which has the beauty of many visible forests, be my shelter.**

**Комментарий:**

It is endowed with Govardhana, made successful as an object serving the Lord, by being called the Lord’s best servant. Govardhana is a limb of Vrndavana.

It is endowed with the place of the rasa dance, the dwelling of Krsna’s gopis who have astonishing minds. The place has ever fresh varieties of beauty for the gopis who experience the place, because of its astonishing nature. Or Rukmini, Satyabhama and others become astonished by the place on hearing its greatness from Krsna. It is further described. It shines with great sweetness, along with Vraja. Vraja is described. It has many visible (jagudha) forests (gahand). Vraja is very interior since it is surrounded by many attractive forests.

### Text 9

*idaṁ nikhila-niṣkuṭāvali-variṣṭha-vṛndāṭavī-*  
*guṇa-smaraṇa-kāri yaḥ paṭhati suṣṭhu padyāṣṭakam \|*  
*vasan vyasana-mukta-dhīra-niśam atra sad-vāsanaḥ*  
*sa pīta-vasane vaśī ratim avāpya vikrīḍati \|\|9\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**The person who attentively recites this astaka which makes one remember the qualities of Vrndavana, superior to the many gardens of Svarga, while controlling his senses, with his mind free of sin and with desire to serve the Lord, living in Vrndavana, attains rati for Krsna who wears yellow cloth, and plays there.**

**Комментарий:**

The results of reciting the astaka are described.

The person who recites this astaka, attaining rati for Krsna, wearing yellow cloth, accompanied by Radha, plays. This is my hope. The astaka is described. It makes one remember the qualities of Vrndavana superior to the groves (niskuta) such as Nandana garden of Svarga. The reciter is described. He lives always (anisam) in Vrndavana (atra). His mind is free of committing sin (vyasana-mukta). He does not commit sin even in his mind. He has auspicious desires: studying scriptures, worshipping the Lord, etc. He controls his senses (vast).

Thus ends the explanation of Vrndavanastaka.

## śrī-nāmāṣṭakam

*śrī-kṛṣṇa-nāmne namaḥ*

**Перевод:**

**I offer respects to the name of Krsna.**

### Text 1

*nikhila-śruti-mauli-ratna-mālā-*  
*dyuti-nīrājita-pāda-paṅkajānta \|*  
*api mukta-kulair upāsyamānaṁ*  
*paritas tvāṁ harināma saṁśrayāmi \|\|1\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**0 name of the Lord! 0 name, whose toenails are worshipped by the light from the jewels of the Upanisads, I take complete shelter of you, worshipped by many liberated souls.**

**Комментарий:**

*namabhasenapi te yogi-mrgya*  
*muktih syad ityahur amnayavacah \|*  
*tvadyakhyane mahyamlsa pradadyah*  
*svasmin bhaktim nadhikam tat prayace \|\|*

The Vedas say that just by ndmabhasa, liberation, sought by the yogis, is attained. I pray for nothing more than bhakti, which the Lord should give me, in explaining about him.

The author praises the Lord’s name. O name of the Lord! I take shelter of you in all ways. The crest jewels of all the srutis are the Upanisads. The tips of the toenails of your lotus feet are worshipped (performing aratrika) by the light from the heaps of jewels of the Upanisads, the crest jewels of the Vedas. This indicates nondifference of the Lord from his name. Or all the personified Vedas worship the feet of the name by touching them with the jewels on their crowns.

*vaktā kartāvitā nānyo*  
*dharmasyācyuta te bhuvi*  
*sabhāyām api vairiñcyāṁ*  
*yatra mūrti-dharāḥ kalāḥ*

**О Acyuta! There is no speaker, creator and protector of dharma other than you, either on the earth or even in the assembly of Brahma, where the personified Vedas reside. (SB 11.17.5)**

*sarve vedah yat padam amananti*

**All the Vedas worship his feet. (Katha Upanisad 1.3.15)**

The Vedas explain that the name of the Lord is the highest goal.

The name is described. It is worshipped even by the liberated souls.

*etat sama gayann aste*

**The jiva dwells there, singing the sama. (Taittinya Upanisad 3.10.5)**

*nivṛtta-tarṣair upagīyamānād*  
*bhavauṣadhāc chrotra-mano-’bhirāmāt*  
*ka uttamaśloka-guṇānuvādāt*  
*pumān virajyeta vinā paśughnāt*

**Glorification of the Supreme Personality of Godhead is performed in the parampara system; that is, it is conveyed from spiritual master to disciple. Such glorification is relished by those no longer interested in the false, temporary glorification of this cosmic manifestation. Descriptions of the Lord are the right medicine for the conditioned soul undergoing repeated birth and death. Therefore, who will cease hearing such glorification of the Lord except a butcher or one who is killing his own self? (SB 10.1.4)**

*etannividyamānānām icchatām akutobhayam \|*  
*yogināṁ nṛpa nirṇītaṁ harer nāmānukīrtanam \|\|*

**O King! Continuous chanting of the name of the Lord has been prescribed for devotees, for those with desires for liberation and material elevation, and for those satisfied with the self. (SB 2.1.11)**

Yoginam means liberated persons who perform bhagavad-yoga.

### Text 2

*jaya nāma-dheya muni-vṛnda-geya he*  
*jana-rañjanāya paramakṣarākṛte \|*  
*tvam anādarād api manāg udīritaṁ*  
*nikhilogra-tāpa-paṭalīṁ vilumpasi \|\|2\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**O name, glorified by all sages! O supreme form of syllables, for giving joy to people! You, chanted even slightly, without respect, destroy piles of terrible sins.**

**Комментарий:**

“Why should I give shelter to those who are most sinful?”

O name (namadheya)! O name glorified by all the sages! May you manifest your excellence (jaya)! Manifest your excellence of burning up all sins.

Uttered slightly (manak) by sdfiketa, pdrihasa, etc., you destroy (vilumpasi) piles of terrible sins, up to the subtle body.

*sāṁketyaṁ pārihāsyaṁ vā stobhaṁ helanameva vā \| vaikuṇṭhanāmagrahaṇamaśeṣāghaharaṁ viduḥ \|\|*

**Chanting the name of the Lord while indicating someone else or while joking in a friendly manner, or chanting the Lord’s name in order to fill up space while chanting verses or chanting with neglect destroys unlimited sins and desires. (SB 6.2.14)**

*parihāsopahāsāṁsairviṣṇornāma gṛṇanti ye \|*  
*kṛtārthāste'pi manujāstebhyo'pīha namo namaḥ \|\|*

**Those humans who chant the name of Visnu as a joke, in a mocking way, etc., become successful. I offer respects to those persons. (Narayana-vyuha-stava)**

*pramādādapi saṁspṛṣṭo yathānalakaṇo dahet \|*  
*tathoṣṭhapuṭasaṁspṛṣṭaṁ harināma dahedagham \|\|*

**Just as a particle of fire burns when touched inattentively, the name of the Lord burns up sin when touches by the lips. (KaSi-khanda)**

Since I remember your power, please purify me. I preach your glories. О name, taking the form of supreme (param) syllables (aksara) for pleasing people! This indicates the name’s merciful nature. Parama becomes param as in sakandhu (saka + dhu), where irregular syllables are dropped in combining words.

*оm asyajananto nama cid-viviktan mahaste*  
*visno sumatim bhajamahe от tat sat*

**О Visnu! Your name is spiritual and self-revealed. Knowing that name a little, not even completely, chanting impurely, we have attained fine intelligence about you, because that name от is perfect in itself. (Rg Veda 1.156.3)**

*sakala-nigama-valli-sat-phalam cit-svarupam*

**It is the highest fruit, with spiritual svarupa, in the tree of all the Vedas. (Skanda Purana)**

The name takes the form of spiritual syllables. Just as Krsna, indicated by the name has a spiritual form, swans and hogs also have spiritual forms.

### Text 3

*yad-ābhāso’py udyan kavalita-bhava-dhvānta-vibhavo*  
*dṛśaṁ tattvāndhānām api diśati bhakti-praṇayinīm \|*  
*janas tasyodāttaṁ jagati bhagavan-nāma-taraṇe*  
*kṛtī te nirvaktuṁ ka iha mahimānaṁ prabhavati \|\|3\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**О Lord! О sun of the name! What learned person in this world can describe the great glories of your name, whose abhasa, having the power to destroy the darkness of samsara, gives wisdom of bhakti even to persons devoid of intelligence?**

**Комментарий:**

After having destroyed sin, namabhasa does not stop giving effects. It reveals bhakti to Krsna, indicated by your name. О Lord (bhagavan)! What learned person (krti) can describe your great (udattam) glories in this world? О sun of Krsna’s name (nama-tarane)! No one can. Why? Abhasa of the name, accepted with sahketa, etc., with power to destroy the darkness of samsara, gives wisdom concerning bhakti to Krsna to persons devoid of that knowledge. Since such are your glories, even a knowledgeable person cannot describe you fully, without obtaining teachings given by someone who knows about you. The meaning of this is clear in sruti:

*оm asyajananto nama cid-viviktan mahas te*  
*visno sumatim bhajamahe от tat sat*

**О Visnu! Your name is spiritual and self-revealed. Knowing that name a little, not even completely, chanting impurely, we have attained fine intelligence about you, because that name от is perfect in itself. (Rg Veda 1.156.3)**

A (in asya) means slightly, the lesser form of the name such as sahketa, etc. One attains knowledge (sumatim) concerning Visnu.

### Text 4

*yad brahma-sākṣāt-kṛti-niṣṭhayāpi*  
*vināśam āyāti vinā na bhogaiḥ \|*  
*apaiti nāma sphuraṇena tat te*  
*prārabdha-karmeti virauti vedaḥ \|\|4\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**The Vedas proclaim that just by the appearance of the name on the tongue, prarabdha-karma is destroyed, though is generally not destroyed without experiencing it, after concentrating to attain realization of Paramatma.**

**Комментарий:**

The name chanted with pure bhakti, destroys prarabdha-karmas, which usually can only be destroyed by experiencing them, without having to experiencing them.

Prarabdha-karma is not destroyed by contemplation of Brahman continuously like an uninterrupted stream of oil, by which one directly perceives Paramatma (brahma-saksat-krti). It is destroyed only by experiencing it, О name! The Vedas proclaim (virauti) that the name destroys that karma just by its appearance on the tongue. By the appearance of brahma-vidya there is destruction and non-adherence of sancita and kriyamana papa and punya.

*ubhe ihaiveṣa ete taratyamṛtaḥ sādhvasādhanī*

**The knower of Brahman surpasses both sin and piety. (Brhad-aranyaka Upanisad 4.4.22)**

Prarabdha-karma means pious and sinful reactions which have started to give their results. They are destroyed by experiencing them, not by brahma-vidya.

*tasya tāvadeva ciraṁ yāvanna vimokṣye*

**As long as the body lasts, he is not liberated. (Chandogya Upanisad 6.14.2)**

This is described by the Lord, author of the sutras:

*tadadhigama uttarapūrvayoraśleṣavināśau tarhyapadeśāt \|\|*

**With attainment of Brahman, present sinful actions have no effect and previous karmas are destroyed since that is indicated in the sruti. (Brahma-sutras 4.1.13)**

*itarasyāpyevamasaṁśleṣaḥ pāte tu  \|\|*

**Pious acts give no effect and karmas from pious acts of previous life are destroyed. On exhaustion of prarabdha-karmas the person attains liberation. (Brahma-sutras 4.1.14)**

*anārabdhakāya eva tu pūrve tadavadheḥ \|\|*

**The anarabdha-karmas are destroyed but the praradbha-karmas remain, because that is the conclusion of sruti. (Brahma-sutras 4.1.15)**

The meaning is this. With the realization of Brahman (tad-aghigame), present acts giving future effects (uttara) have no effect (aslesa) and past acts giving effects in the future are destroyed. This is so because it is taught in the srutis (vyapadesat).

There is no effect (asamslesa) of the present acts and destruction (yinasa) of effects for previous acts. Liberation will take place with the destruction of the body created by prarabdha. The sancita karmas of sin and pious acts previously committed (anarabdha-karya) but not yet giving results are destroyed by vidya. But those acts which are now giving effect are not destroyed. They must be experienced till the destruction of the body.

This prarabhda-karma is destroyed by uttering the name.

*sa eva sarvebhyaḥ pāpmabhya udita udaiti*  
*ha vai sarva pāpmabhyo ya evaṁ veda*

**He is called Ut. He has risen above all sins. He who knows this rises above all sins. (Chandogya Upanisad 1.6.6-7)**

Udite means by worshipping the Lord’s name all sins are destroyed. Thus prarabdha is also destroyed.

With this intention the Satyayams say:

*tasya putrā dāyamupayanti suhṛdaḥ*  
*sādhukṛtyāṁ dviṣantaḥ pāpakṛtyām*

**His children receive his inheritance, his friends receive his pious results and his enemies receive his sinful results. (Sama-veda-jaiminiya-brahmana 1.18.27)**

The Kausltakls say:

*tatsukṛtaduṣkṛte vidhunute tasya priyā*  
*jñātayaḥ sukṛtamupayantyapriyā duṣkṛtam*

**His pious and sinful reactions are destroyed - his pious results go to his dear friends or relatives and the sinful results got to the sinful. (Kausitaki Upanisad 1.4)**

The author of the sutras, the Lord, says:

*ato'nyāpi hyekeṣām ubhayoḥ  \|\|*

**For some nirapeksa devotees both types of prarabdha-karmas are dissolved because this is stated is some Srutis. (Brahma-sutras 4.1.17)**

The meaning is this. For the devotees with the highest attraction to the Lord, dedicated exclusively to his name (ekesam), the results of pious and impious acts have no effect and there is no experience of the prarabdha-karmas, because (hi) of sruti statements such as the following which explain that the prarabdha-karma is destroyed.

*tasya tavad eva ciram yavan na vimoksye atha sampatsye*

**As long as he has karma, he will not be liberated. With the exhaustion of karmas, he achieves the result. (Chandogya Upanisad 6.14.2)**

Tasya putra dayam upayanti quoted above states the same.

### Text 5

*aghadamana-yaśodānandanau nandasūno*  
*kamalanayana-gopīcandra-vṛndāvanendrāḥ \|*  
*praṇatakaruṇa-kṛṣṇāv ity aneka-svarūpe*  
*tvayi mama ratir uccair vardhatāṁ nāma-dheya \|\|5\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**О killer of Agha! О joy of Yasoda! О son of Nanda! О lotuseyed one! О moon of the gopis! О king of Vrndavana! О lord merciful to the surrendered! О Krsna! О Name! May my attraction for you, endowed with many forms, increase.**

**Комментарий:**

The name is most merciful, giving various types of bliss to the devotees since it manifests in a variety of ways. О name (namadheya)! May my attraction for you, of inconceivable powers, increase. The name is described. О killer of Agha! О bliss of Yasoda! О son of Nanda! You have attained many svariipas with a hundred and eight names.

### Text 6

*vācyaṁ vācakam ity udeti bhavato nāma svarūpa-dvayaṁ*  
*pūrvasmāt param eva hanta karuṇaṁ tatrāpi jānīmahe*  
*yas tasmin vihitāparādha-nivahaḥ prāṇī samantād bhaved*  
*āsyenedam upāsya so’pi hi sadānandāmbudhau majjati \|\|6\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**О name! Two forms of you arise: vacya and vacaka. We know that the vacaka is more merciful than the vacya form. He who has committed all sins becomes submerged in an ocean of eternal bliss by uttering your name.**

**Комментарий:**

Your great mercy is clear. Thus, I take shelter of you. О name! Your two svarupas—as the vacya and vacaka—manifest. Vacya means the form of bliss, consciousness and pervasion, the Supreme Lord. Vacakam means the collections of syllables such

as Krsna and Govinda. We know that the vacdka, your variety of names, is more merciful than the vacya, the form of the Lord. Why? The living being who has committed many sins to your vacya form destroys all those sins by uttering your vacdka form (the name) and becomes submerged in an ocean of eternal bliss, the bliss of prema for the Lord. He becomes successful.

*mama nāmāni loke'smiñśraddhayā yastu kīrtayet \|*  
*tasyāparādhakoṭīstu kṣamāmy eva na saṁśayaḥ \|\|*

**He who sings my names with faith in this world without doubt is forgiven by me for ten million offenses. (Visnu-yamala)**

The name and who is designated by the name are nondifferent.

*nāma-cintāmaṇiḥ kṛṣṇa-caitanya-rasa-vigrahaḥ \|*  
*pūrṇaḥ śuddho nityamukto'bhinnatvānāmanāminoḥ*

**The name of the Lord is cintamani. It is Krsna himself, a form of consciousness and rasa. It is complete, pure, and eternally liberated since there is no difference between the name and Krsna himself. (Padma Purand)**

### Text 7

*sūditāśrita-janārti-rāśaye*  
*ramya-cid-ghana-sukha-svarūpiṇe \|*  
*nāma gokula-mahotsavāya te*  
*kṛṣṇa-pūrṇa-vapuṣe namo namaḥ \|\|7\|\|*

**Перевод:**

**О name! О Krsna! I offer repeated respects to you, who destroy countless sins of the surrendered souls, who causes a great festival in Gokula, whose form is attractive knowledge and bliss, whose form is all pervading.**

**Комментарий:**

“Thirty-two seva-aparadhas should be destroyed by the name. By what will the ten offenses to the name such as sadhu-ninda be destroyed?”

О name! О Krsna! I offer respects to you. The name is described. It destroys (sudita) piles of suffering of people who have committed offenses to the name, but who take shelter of the name.

*jāte nāmāparādhe tu pramādena kathaṁcana \|*  
*sadā saṁkīrtayan nāma tadekaśaraṇo bhavet \|\|*

**If, somehow or other, one accidentally commits offenses he should constantly chant the holy name. He should fully surrender to the name. (Padma Purana)**

*nāmāparādha-yuktānāṁ nāmānyeva haranty agham \|*  
*aviśrānti-prayuktāni tāny evārtha-karāṇi yat \|\|*

**The holy name removes the sins, even of those who chant offensively, provided they chant constantly. The holy name gives all results (Padma Purana)**

Forgive the committed offenses! One should constantly chant (prayuktani) while avoiding the offenses.

*aparādha-vimukto hi nāmni yatnaṁ samācaret*

**One should with care avoid offenses. (Padma Purana)**

The name is further described. It is the svarupa of happiness with an attractive wealth of knowledge as explained in nama-cintamanih krsna. It is further described. It causes a great festival in Gokula. The name’s body is all-pervasive (pttrna-vapuse).

**Перевод:**

**О name which gives life to Narada’s vina! О abundant sweetness like the essence of waves of nectar! О name of Krsna! Always manifest as much as is suitable on my tongue with attraction.**

**Комментарий:**

The author prays for a manifestation of the name in himself.

О name which gives life to Narada’s vina! О abundant sweetness like the essence of waves of nectar! О name of Krsna! Manifest as much as is agreeable (kamam) on my tongue (rasane) with attraction (rasena). Manifest on my tongue to my capacity of accepting you. At the end, he prays for manifestation of Krsna’s name since that is the principle name.

*nāmnāṁ mukhyataraṁ nāma kṛṣṇākhyaṁ me paraṁtapa*

**О conqueror of enemies, the name of Krsna is the chief of all names. (Hari-bhakti-vilasa 11.498, credited to Prabhasa-khanda, Skanda Purana)**

The results of reciting the name are explained in the verses themselves. Thus, they are not stated at the end. Thus Srl-namastaka has been explained.

*śrīrūpadevaḥ karuṇaikasindhuḥ stavālimetāṁ yadi nākariṣyat \|*

**If Rupa Gosvami, an ocean of mercy, had not written the series of stavas, the devotees would not understand sufficiently the qualities, form and pastimes of Krsna.**

*vidyābhūṣaṇa racite stavamālā-bhūṣaṇe bhāṣye \|*  
*parituṣyatu vanamālī vara-ruciśālīvate tasmin \|\|*

**May Vanamali be pleased with this attractive commentary, and ornament of Stavamala written by Vidyabhiisana.**

*iti stavamālā saṁpūrṇāṁ \|*

## About Srila Rupa Gosvami

The topmost maidservant of Sri Sri Radha-Krsna is Sri Rupa Manjari who appeared as the head of the Gaudiya Vaisnava Sampradaya, Srila Rupa Gosvami (1489-1588). Sri Rupa appeared in East Bengal, the son of a pious brahmana named Kumaradeva along with his brothers, Sanatana and Anupama. The three brothers later moved to Ramakeli where they were solicited by the powerful Nawab Hussein Shah to join his government. Due to their association with the

Muslim king, Rupa and Sanatana became known by the Muslim names Dabir Khas and Sakir Mallik.

When Sri Caitanya Mahaprabhu came to Ramakeli, the three brothers petitioned the Lord to alleviate their suffering condition and grant them His mercy. Mahaprabhu pacified them and told them that Krsna would deliver them very soon.

Not long afterwards, an intense feeling of renunciation awakened in the hearts of Rupa and Sanatana. Finally Rupa resigned from the Nawab’s service and sent messengers to Puri to find out when Mahaprabhu planned to travel to Vrndavana. When the messengers returned with the news that Mahaprabhu had left already for Vrndavana, Rupa wrote to Sanatana and requested him to extricate himself from the Nawab’s service as soon as possible and meet him in Prayaga. Rupa and Anupama then traveled to Prayaga where they met Sri Caitanya Mahaprabhu who was staying at the house of a South Indian brahmana.

While in Prayaga, Mahaprabhu taught Sri Rupa the esoteric teachings of Vaisnava philosophy at the Dasavamedha Ghata and requested him to go to Vrndavana to uncover Sri Krsna’s pastime places and write literatures on bhakti.

On the order of Mahaprabhu, Rupa Gosvami traveled to Vrndavana and stayed for one month. On the way to Puri, where they were to meet the Lord again, Anupama left his body on the banks of the Ganga.

Arriving in Puri, he was greeted by the Lord as well as Sri Svaritpa Damodar Gosvami, Ramananda Raya and the other associates of the

Lord. All the Lords devotees considered that he was the beneficiary of the Lord’s special mercy, thus he knew the heart of Sri Caitanya Mahaprabhu. All the devotees delighted in hearing his divine compositions.

Returning to Sri Radha-Damodar Mandir, Vrndavana to carry out the order of the Lord, he was joined by his elder brother Sanatana Gosvami whom he had not seen for more than a year. In Vrndavan, the two brothers led an exemplary life of devotion and austerity, writing transcendental literatures, visiting the Lord's places of pastimes, and chanting the Holy Name. They would sleep for only an hour and a half every day, and some days not at all. Their food was meager and consisted of only a few fried chickpeas or a dry chapatti just to keep body and soul together.

## About Srila Jiva Gosvami

In the Gaura-ganoddesa-dipika (195) it is said that Srila Jiva Gosvami was formerly Vilasa-mahjari gopi. Born in Ramakeli, he was the nephew of the illustrious brothers Sri Rupa and Sanatana, who were the objects of Sri Caitanya's unlimited mercy. From his very childhood Jiva Gosvami was greatly fond of Srimad-Bhagavatam. He later came to Navadvipa to study Sanskrit, and, following in the footsteps of Sri Nityananda Prabhu, he circumambulated the entire Navadvipa-dhama. After visiting Navadvipa-dhama he went to Benares to study Sanskrit under Madhusudana Vacaspati, and after finishing his studies in Benares he went to Vrndavana and took shelter of his uncles, Sri Rupa and Sanatana. This is described in the Bhakti-ratnakara. After the disappearance of Srila Rupa Gosvami and Sanatana Gosvami in Vrndavana, Srila Jiva Gosvami became the acarya of all the Vaisnavas in Bengal, Orissa and the rest of the world, and it is he who used to guide them in their devotional service. In Vrndavana he established the Radha-Damodara temple. When Jiva Gosvami was still present, Srila Krsnadasa Kaviraja Gosvami compiled his famous Caitanya-caritamrta. Later, Srila Jiva Gosvami inspired Srinivasa Acarya, Narottama dasa Thakura and Duhkhi Krsnadasa to preach Krsna consciousness in Bengal. Sri Jiva Gosvami awarded the designation Kaviraja to Ramacandra Sena, a disciple of Srinivasa Acarya’s, and to Ramacandra’s younger brother Govinda. His disciple Krsnadasa Adhikari listed all the books of the Gosvamis in his diary.

In the year 1476 Sakabda (A.D. 1554)Sanatana Gosvami completed the Brhad-vaisnava-tosanl commentary on Snmad-Bhagavatarn. In the year 1504 Sakabda (A.D. 1582) Srila Jiva Gosvami published an edited version of the Brhad-vaisnava-tosanl named Laghu-tosani.

## About Sri Baladeva Vidyabhusana

Sri Baladeva Vidyabhusana (Sri Govinda Dasa) appeared in the 1600's near Remuna, Orissa. In his youth, he mastered Sanskrit grammar, poetry, and logic. After carefully studying the commentries of Sankara and Madhva he took initiation in the Tattva-vadi disciplic succession of Sripad Madhvacarya. Baladeva Vidyabhusana became a dig vijaya pandit (conqueror of all opponents) and began visiting the holy places. Wherever he went he defeated the local sages, scholars, and sannyasis. In Vrindavana, he studied Srimad Bhagavatam under Srila Vishvanatha Cakravarti Thakura and worshipped Radha-Syamasundara.

In 1706 A.D. Vishvanatha Cakravarti Thakura sent him to Guha (near Jaipur,Rajasthan) to uphold the credibility of Mahaprabhu's movement. The local Ramanandis (a branch of Sri Vaishnavas) were claiming that the Bengali Vaishnavas had no right to worship Govindaji they had no commentary on the Vedanta-sutra.

Lord Govindaji Himself directly revealed the Govinda-bhasya (a Vaishnava commentary on Vedanta) to Baladeva Vidyabhusana. Using it, Baladeva solidly established Gaudiya Vaishnavism as an independent philosophy. He also reinstated the Bengali Vaishnavas in Govindaji's service in Jaipura. Govinda-bhasya is the only bhakti commentary' on Vedanta-sutra.

Sri Baladeva Vidyabhusana was a niskincana-parama bhagavata, fully-renounced topmost Devotee of Lord Krishna. His more than twenty-four books and commentaries have helped thousands of Vaishnavas understand the sublime philosophy of Krishna consciousness and the intimate writings of the six Goswamis. Since he was devoid of false prestige, he never wrote about his birth, parents, lineage, personal life. According to Sri Bhaktivinoda Thakura in Navadvipa-dhama mahatyam, in Chaitanya lila Baladeva Vidyabhusana is Sri Gopinatha Acarya, the brother-in-law of Sri Sarvabhauma Bhattacarya. In Vraja he serves as Sri Radha's eternal maidservant Ratnavali Devi.

## About Bhanu Swami

His Holiness Bhanu Swami was born in Canada on the 26th December 1948 to the most fortunate Japanese parents. He is one of the senior disciples of His Divine Grace A.C Bhaktivedanta Swami Prabhupada, Founder-Acarya of the International Society for Krishna Consciousness (ISKCON). He holds a BA Degree in Oriental Fine Arts History from the University of British Columbia. He joined the Hare Krishna movement in India in 1970. Initiated in 1971 by Srila Prabhupada, he took sannyasa vows in 1984. Bhanu Swami was personally instructed in the art of Deity worship by Srila Prabhupada, and within ISKCON he has become an authority on the topic. He is a great inspiration for many devotees around the world and he preaches Krishna consciousness in India, Japan, Malaysia, Australia and Russia.

By 1972, His Holiness Bhanu Swami Maharaja had already earned credit from Srila Prabhupada for his exact Sanskrit pronunciation, expertise in cooking and excellence in Deity worship.

A scholar in Sanskrit and Bengali, Bhanu Swami has translated more than hundred significant works of the Gaudiya Vaisnava canon. Many of these works are commentaries from primary members of the Gaudiya Vaisnava sampradaya.

Bhanu Swami is a quiet achiever and has studied a variety of disciplines including martial arts, Reiki healing, Carnatic music (specifically veena). He is a reputed astrologer.

Bhanu Swami’s depth of scholarship has enabled him to create presentations on topics like Bhagavad Gita, Srimad Bhagavatam, karma theory, reincarnation, yoga, mysteries of sound, astrology, etc., He continues with this translation service to this day, giving us the nectar from the Bengali and Sanskrit works of the previous Vaisnava acaryas to enhance our understanding of the Gaudiya Vaisnava philosophy. He is also a member of the Governing Body Commission (GBC) ofISKCON.
